```js
    host => renderContentGroup(host,{ id:'delivery-address', label:'Address' },[ groupHost => renderTextInput(groupHost,{ id:'delivery-street', label:'Street' }) ])
]);
```

### Files

| File | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `contentGroupIndex.js` | Public entry point; the only import surface. |
| `contentGroupConfig.js` | Defaults, allowed values, normalization, developer validation. |
| `contentGroupComponent.js` | Lifecycle, child rendering and ownership, semantic checks, runtime API. |
| `contentGroupHTML.js` | Group shell markup. |
| `contentGroupErrors.js` | Developer error and warning catalog. |
| `contentGroup.css` | Presentation. |
| `contentGroupTESTS.md` | Test plan: the cases that prove this README (automatic ones in `tests/components/contentGroup.test.mjs`). |


<!-- ===== source/components-js/copyArea/copyAreaREADME.md ===== -->

# CopyArea

## For business

### Overview

CopyArea shows content with a Copy button that puts it on the clipboard in one click: code, a value such as an IBAN or an API key, or formatted content such as a standard reply or a table. Typical uses: code examples and install commands, account and payment details, invitation links, order and ticket numbers, texts to paste into an email or a document.

### When to use

- Use it when people need to take content from the screen into another place (a terminal, a payment form, an email, a spreadsheet) without selecting it by hand.
- Use it for one value inside a sentence ("Your order #100482 is on its way") as well as for a block of code or formatted content.
- Use Message for a confirmation that is not tied to copying, and Tooltip for a hint without an action.

### Key features

- One click copies the whole area; the button confirms with "Copied".
- Copies a different value from what is shown when needed, e.g. the full API key behind a masked one, or an IBAN without spaces.
- Formatted content keeps its formatting when pasted into a document or an email, and becomes plain text in a plain field.
- Leaves out hidden parts and controls, and parts the application marks, or copies only a marked part.
- Code in a fixed-width font, with optional line numbers; long content scrolls.
- When the browser refuses the copy, the content is selected so it can be copied with Ctrl+C.

### Dependencies

| Dependency | Needed when | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Design system (`design-system.css`) | Always | Colours, sizes, typography and the CopyArea tokens. |
| CopyArea styles (`copyArea.css`) | Always | Layout, code and content box. |
| Button component and `button.css` | Always | The Copy button. |
| Font Awesome icon library | Always | Copy and check icons. Loaded by the application page. |
| Tooltip component and `tooltip.css` | `tooltipMode` `TOOLTIP` | Name of the icon button on hover and keyboard focus (the Tooltip module is loaded only then). |

### Not included

The application provides the content (and builds formatted content itself), the value to copy when it differs from what is shown, and any colouring of code by language. Copying needs a page served over https (or localhost); elsewhere the browser refuses and the content is selected instead.

## For designers

### Structure

```text
div#{id}.ui-copy-area.ui-copy-area-{code|plain|content}.ui-copy-area-button-{icon|text}[.ui-copy-area-line-numbers]   (span for plain)
├── pre.ui-copy-area-body[role="region"][tabindex="0"][dir="ltr"] > code                    (code; lines: span.ui-copy-area-line)
│   or span.ui-copy-area-text                                                        (plain)
│   or div.ui-copy-area-body[role="region"][tabindex="0"] → the application's content  (content)
├── span.ui-copy-area-action[data-button="copy"] → Button (TERTIARY, SMALL)
├── span.ui-copy-area-message[hidden]                                                 (failed copy; code.ui-copy-area-fallback with copyValue)
└── span.ui-copy-area-status.ui-copy-area-visually-hidden[role="status"]
```

Code and content are one bordered box with the button in its top corner; code has its own background. Plain text has no box: the button follows the text on the same line.

### Visual options

| Option | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Shown content | Code, plain text, content | `ui-copy-area-code`, `ui-copy-area-plain`, `ui-copy-area-content` |
| Line numbers | Off, on (code) | `ui-copy-area-line-numbers`, `span.ui-copy-area-line` |
| Copy button | Icon, text | `ui-copy-area-button-icon`, `ui-copy-area-button-text` |

### States

| State | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Copied | "Copied" with a check on the button for two seconds | The Button's label or name and icon |
| Copy failed | Message below the area, content selected | `.ui-copy-area-message` without `hidden` |

### Styling contract

`copyArea.css` has three parts, marked in the stylesheet. Restyle by writing the same selector with a new value in your own stylesheet, inside `@layer overrides` (preferred: library updates keep your changes), or by changing a value in your copy of the stylesheet. After each token come the parts it styles, named by their class without `ui-copy-area-` (as in Structure), with the option or state in brackets (joined by “+” when they apply together). Text uses the typography roles of `design-system.css`; border sides are physical (top, right, bottom, left).

**1. Appearance — change freely** (colours, type, borders, corners, motion: only the look changes)

- Colours
  - `--c-border`: copy area (code, content)
  - `--copy-area-bg`: copy area (code)
  - `--copy-area-color`: copy area (code)
  - `--c-text`: copy area (content), text, fallback
  - `--c-muted`: line
  - `--c-danger-text`: message
- Typography
  - `--font-code`: body (code), fallback
  - `--fw-ui`: body (code), text, message
  - `--lh-body`: body (code), text, message
  - `--font-ui`: text, message
  - `--fs-control`: text
  - `--fs-label`: message
- Borders and corners
  - `--border-thin`: copy area (code, content)
  - `--radius-panel`: copy area (code, content)

**2. Dimensions — change with care** (sizes and spacing: the component keeps working, its size changes)

- Spacing
  - `--space-md-3`: body (code), line, message (code, content)
  - `--gap-inline-items`: body (code, content), copy area (plain)
  - `--padding-card`: body (content)
  - `--space-sm-2`: action (code, content)
  - `--gap-tight`: message
- Sizes
  - `--copy-area-max-height`: body (code, content)

**3. Structure — don't change** (layout, behaviour, states, accessibility)

- States and motion
  - `--focus-outline`: body (focus)
  - `--focus-offset`: body (focus)

## For AI-assisted development

### Instructions

- Read this README before writing code. Import only from `copyAreaIndex.js`.
- Use `text` for code and single values (`textStyle:'PLAIN'` for values such as an IBAN, an order number or a link), and `content` only for formatted content the application renders.
- Set `copyValue` when what should be pasted differs from what is shown (a masked key, an IBAN without spaces); never show a secret just to copy it.
- Mark parts of formatted content with `data-copy="skip"` (left out) or `data-copy="only"` (copied alone); hidden parts, buttons and fields are left out automatically.
- Give a `label` that says what is copied ("Install command", "IBAN"), so screen-reader users hear "Copy, IBAN".
- React to `onCopy` only for analytics or follow-up actions; the component shows and announces the result itself.
- Give each area a unique, DOM-safe `id` and call `destroy()` before rendering into the same container again.

### Safety

- `text` and `copyValue` are displayed and copied as text; do not pass HTML in them.
- Build formatted content with your own trusted markup or framework components in the `content` function; never insert untrusted HTML there.
- Do not remove the status region or the region names: they announce the result and make long content reachable by keyboard.

### Example prompts

```text
Show the install command "npm install ui-catalog" in a CopyArea labelled "Install command".
```

```text
On the account page, show the IBAN with spaces and a "Copy" text button that copies it without spaces.
```

```text
Show our standard reply to password questions as formatted content with a Copy button; leave the internal note out of the copy.
```

## For developers

### Business analysis

> **Component**: the CopyArea itself. **Consumer**: the developer who configures the CopyArea in the application's code. **App**: the running application that uses the CopyArea; it provides the data, performs the actions and stores the changes.

**Content**

- Consumer provides a text: code, or a single value such as an IBAN or an order number. <!-- BA-01 -->
- Component displays code in a fixed-width font on its own background, exactly as provided. <!-- BA-02 -->
  - Component displays line numbers (optional). <!-- BA-03 -->
  - Component scrolls code that is taller than the maximum height. <!-- BA-04 -->
- Component displays a single value in the text font, with the Copy button right after it. <!-- BA-05 -->
- Consumer provides content the App renders, e.g. a formatted reply or a table (optional). <!-- BA-06 -->
- Consumer provides a value that is copied instead of what is shown, e.g. the full API key behind a masked one (optional). <!-- BA-07 -->
- App changes the text or the copied value. <!-- BA-08 -->
  - Component displays the change in place. <!-- BA-09 -->

**Copy**

- User clicks the Copy button. <!-- BA-10 -->
  - Component sends the content to the clipboard. <!-- BA-11 -->
  - Component changes the button to "Copied" with a check for two seconds. <!-- BA-12 -->
  - Component announces "Copied". <!-- BA-13 -->
  - Component reports the result to the App. <!-- BA-14 -->
- Component sends formatted content both as formatted text and as plain text, so headings, lists, links and tables stay when pasted into a document and plain text arrives in a plain field. <!-- BA-15 -->
- Component removes hidden parts, buttons and fields from the copy. <!-- BA-16 -->
- Consumer chooses parts of the content that are left out of the copy, e.g. an internal note (optional). <!-- BA-17 -->
- Consumer chooses the only part of the content that is copied, e.g. the table under a title (optional). <!-- BA-18 -->

**Copy refused**

- Component displays "Couldn't copy. The content is selected: press Ctrl+C (Cmd+C on a Mac) to copy it." when the browser refuses the copy, e.g. on a page not served over https. <!-- BA-19 -->
  - Component selects the content. <!-- BA-20 -->
  - Component displays the value to copy in the message and selects it, when it differs from what is shown. <!-- BA-21 -->
  - Component announces the message. <!-- BA-22 -->
  - Component hides the message after the next successful copy. <!-- BA-23 -->

**Button**

- Consumer chooses an icon button or a button with the text "Copy" (optional, icon by default). <!-- BA-24 -->
- Consumer provides a label that names the area and describes the button, e.g. "Install command" (optional). <!-- BA-25 -->

**Tooltips**

- Consumer chooses how the name of the icon button shows on hover and keyboard focus: the browser's tooltip, a Tooltip or none (optional, on by default with the browser). <!-- BA-26 -->

### Contracts

**Contracts:** Styling: three parts (Styling contract) · Form field: no (container: `getChildren()`) · Actions: no · Shared behaviour: yes, additions under Accessibility

### Public API

```js
import { renderCopyArea, DEFAULT_COPY_AREA_CONFIG, COPY_AREA_TEXT_STYLES, COPY_AREA_BUTTONS, COPY_AREA_TOOLTIP_MODES } from './copyAreaIndex.js';

const area = renderCopyArea(container, config, onCopy); // null after a developer error
```

| Member | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | The configured id. |
| `getElement()` | Element | The CopyArea element. |
| `getError()` | object \| null | A copy of the current error (`{ errorLabel, message }`) or `null`. |
| `setText(text)` | — | Changes the shown and copied text (code or plain text; ignored with `content`, `OPTION_IGNORED`). |
| `setCopyValue(value)` | — | Sets the value copied instead of the shown content, or removes it (`null`). |
| `getChildren()` | array | The instance returned by the `content` function (a copy of the list; empty without one). |
| `destroy()` | — | Stops the feedback timer, destroys the Copy button and the content's instance, clears the container. |

### Configuration

| Parameter | Type | Default | Allowed values / format | Applies when | Usage / description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | — | Starts with a letter; letters, digits, `_ : . -`; unique in the document | Always | Required. |
| `text` | string | `''` | Text (kept exactly, line breaks and spaces included) | not `content` | What is shown and copied. Required unless `content` is set. |
| `textStyle` | string | `'CODE'` | `CODE`, `PLAIN` | `text` | `CODE`: fixed-width font in a box that scrolls; `PLAIN`: a single value in the text font, with the button after it (can stand inside running text). |
| `lineNumbers` | boolean | `false` | — | `textStyle:CODE` | Numbers each line (not selected, not copied). |
| `content` | function | `null` | `(host, instance) => instance \| null` | Always | Renders formatted content into `host`; copied as plain text and HTML without hidden parts, buttons, fields and `[data-copy="skip"]`; only the `[data-copy="only"]` parts when there are any. A returned instance is destroyed with the CopyArea. |
| `copyValue` | string | `null` | Text (numbers are converted) | Always | Copied instead of the shown content (as plain text); shown in the message only when the copy fails. |
| `label` | string | `''` | Text | Always | Names the code or content area (default `texts.region`) and describes the Copy button for screen readers. |
| `copyButton` | string | `'ICON'` | `ICON`, `TEXT` | Always | Icon button named "Copy", or a text button "Copy" with the icon. |
| `tooltipMode` | string | `'TITLE'` | `NONE`, `TITLE`, `TOOLTIP` | `copyButton:ICON` | How the icon button's name shows on hover and keyboard focus: not at all, the browser's tooltip (`title`, mouse only) or a Tooltip (also on keyboard focus; needs `tooltip.css`, the Tooltip module is loaded only then). |
| `texts.copy` | string | `'Copy'` | Text | Always | Name or label of the button. |
| `texts.copied` | string | `'Copied'` | Text | Always | Name or label after a successful copy; also announced. |
| `texts.failed` | string | `'Couldn't copy. The content is selected: press Ctrl+C (Cmd+C on a Mac) to copy it.'` | Text | Always | Message when the browser refuses the copy; also announced. |
| `texts.region` | string | `'Content to copy'` | Text | Always | Name of the code or content area when there is no `label`. |
| `onCopy` | function | `null` | `(result, instance) => {}` | Always | Takes precedence over the third argument. |

`text` together with `content`: `content` is shown (`OPTIONS_CONFLICT`). `textStyle` with `content`, `lineNumbers` without `textStyle:CODE` and `tooltipMode` with `copyButton:TEXT` are ignored (`OPTION_IGNORED`). Invalid enum values fall back to the default (`INVALID_OPTION`).

### Callbacks

| Callback | Arguments | Fires when | Does not fire when |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `onCopy` | `({ copied, text, errorLabel? }, instance)` | The user clicks the Copy button: `copied:true` after a successful copy, `copied:false` and `errorLabel:'COPY_FAILED'` when the browser refuses it. `text` is the plain text that was (or would have been) copied. | `setText()` and `setCopyValue()`. |

### Errors

| Label | Default message | Trigger | Visibility | Clearing |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `COPY_FAILED` | "Couldn't copy. The content is selected: press Ctrl+C (Cmd+C on a Mac) to copy it." (`texts.failed`) | The browser refuses the copy (no clipboard access, e.g. not https). | corrective: below the area, announced; the content (or `copyValue`) is selected | The next successful copy. |

Developer errors prevent rendering; warnings are logged and rendering continues. Console format: `CopyArea "id" [LABEL]: message`.

| Label | Severity | Cause |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CONTAINER_REQUIRED` | error | No container passed. |
| `ID_REQUIRED` | error | `id` is empty. |
| `UNSAFE_ID` | error | `id` is not DOM-safe. |
| `DUPLICATE_ID` | error | An element with the same id already exists in the document. |
| `CONTENT_REQUIRED` | error | Neither a non-empty `text` nor a `content` function. |
| `OPTIONS_CONFLICT` | warning | `text` and `content` together; `content` is shown. |
| `INVALID_OPTION` | warning | Invalid `textStyle`, `copyButton`, `tooltipMode`, `content` (not a function) or `copyValue` (not text); also `setCopyValue()` with a value that is not text. |
| `OPTION_IGNORED` | warning | `textStyle` with `content`; `lineNumbers` without `textStyle:CODE`; `tooltipMode` with `copyButton:TEXT`; `setText()` with `content`. |

### Accessibility

- Code and content areas are named regions (`label`, else `texts.region`) reachable with Tab, so long content can be scrolled with the keyboard.
- The Copy button is named "Copy" and described by the label ("Copy, Install command"); after a copy its name is "Copied" and the focus stays on it.
- The result ("Copied", or the failure message) is announced through a polite status region.
- Line numbers are drawn by the stylesheet: they are not read, selected or copied.
- Code stays left-to-right on right-to-left pages; the button moves to the other side with the page.

### Examples

```js
// A masked API key: the full key is copied, never shown.
renderCopyArea(keyHost,{ id:'api-key', label:'API key', textStyle:'PLAIN', text:`${key.slice(0,8)}••••••••${key.slice(-4)}`, copyValue:key });

// Formatted content: only the table is copied, with its formatting.
renderCopyArea(reportHost,{ id:'q3-sales', label:'Sales table', copyButton:'TEXT', content:host =>
{
    host.innerHTML = `<p>Sales by region, Q3</p><table data-copy="only">${rowsHTML}</table>`;   // rowsHTML built from trusted data
    return null;
}, onCopy:( result ) => analytics.track('copy',{ copied:result.copied }) });
```

### Files

| File | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `copyAreaIndex.js` | Public entry point; the only import surface. |
| `copyAreaConfig.js` | Defaults, normalization, developer validation. |
| `copyAreaComponent.js` | Copy button, clipboard, cleaned copy of content, feedback, announcements, runtime API. |
| `copyAreaHTML.js` | Area, code lines and message markup. |
| `copyAreaErrors.js` | User error, developer error and warning catalog. |
| `copyArea.css` | Presentation. |
| `copyAreaTESTS.md` | Test plan: the cases that prove this README (automatic ones in `tests/components/copyArea.test.mjs`). |


<!-- ===== source/components-js/form/formREADME.md ===== -->

# Form

## For business

### Overview

Form turns a set of input fields into one unit the user can submit, or into a filter panel that updates results. It collects the values, checks all fields at once, shows one clear list of problems, prevents double submits and can warn before unsaved changes are lost. It never sends data itself: the application does that with the values Form hands over.

### When to use

- Use the submit mode for data the user enters and sends: registration, order, profile.
- Use the live mode for filters, settings, calculators and previews that update as the user changes them.
- Use ContentGroup inside a form to group fields, and a single field without Form when nothing is submitted.

### Key features

- Two modes: submit, and live (on Apply or after a short pause).
- One error summary at the top that names each field and jumps to it.
- Checks across fields and messages from the server next to the fields.
- No double submits, and a warning before unsaved changes are lost.
- Optional Reset, Clear all and Cancel buttons; fields in one to four columns.

### Dependencies

| Dependency | Needed when | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Design system (`design-system.css`) | Always | Colours, spacing and typography. |
| Form styles (`form.css`) | Always | Summary, layout and actions. |
| Button component and `button.css` | Always | Submit, Apply, Reset, Clear all and Cancel. |
| Message component and `message.css` | Always | Error summary, success and other messages, Reset/Clear confirmation. |
| Loader component and `loader.css` | `busyIndicator` `BUTTONS` or `OVERLAY` | What the user sees while the form saves. |
| Input and container components (TextInput, Calendar, ContentGroup, …) | For the fields placed in the form | Rendered by the application; Form does not import them. |

### Not included

The application sends the values to the server, returns server messages to Form, decides cross-field rules, shows filter results (and, if wanted, active filters as chips or in the page address) and handles navigation after submit or cancel. Very special forms (wizards with steps, fields that are not Form fields) are built by the application itself.

## For designers

### Structure

```text
form#{id}.ui-form.ui-form-mode-{submit|live}[.ui-labels-start][.ui-form-busy]   novalidate, size container "form"
├── div#{id}-summary.ui-form-summary   role="group", tabindex="-1"   (hidden without errors)
│   ├── h2.ui-form-summary-title
│   └── ul.ui-form-summary-list > li > a.ui-form-summary-link
├── p.ui-form-required-note                                  (optional)
├── div.ui-form-content   (grid of --ui-form-columns columns)
│   └── div.ui-form-item  (display:contents) → ContentGroup, input or static HTML
├── div.ui-form-actions.ui-form-actions-{start|end}
│   ├── span.ui-form-loader-host → Loader (RING, SMALL, "Saving…" after it)   (busyIndicator BUTTONS; not displayed while the Loader is hidden)
│   └── Buttons: Submit | Apply, Reset to initial values, Clear all, Cancel
└── div.ui-form-overlay-host → Loader (OVERLAY over the form, panel at the top)   (busyIndicator OVERLAY)
```

The summary has a danger border (thicker at the start), a soft danger background and underlined links in the danger text colour. Items use `display:contents`, so a ContentGroup's own column span applies to the form grid. Below a form width of 36rem the grid becomes one column. The class `ui-labels-start` is the shared switch that puts the labels of all fields inside on the left; fields follow it with `labelPosition:'INHERIT'`.

### Visual options

| Option | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Mode | Submit, live | `ui-form-mode-submit`, `ui-form-mode-live` |
| Columns | 1–4 | `style="--ui-form-columns:N"` |
| Label position | Top, left | —, `ui-labels-start` |
| Buttons alignment | Start, end | `ui-form-actions-start`, `ui-form-actions-end` |
| Busy indicator | Ring before the buttons, layer over the form, none | `.ui-form-loader-host`, `.ui-form-overlay-host`, — |

### States

| State | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Busy | On (the Loader shows after its delay) | `ui-form-busy`, `aria-busy="true"` |
| Error summary | Shown | `.ui-form-summary` without `hidden` |

### Styling contract

`form.css` has three parts, marked in the stylesheet. Restyle by writing the same selector with a new value in your own stylesheet, inside `@layer overrides` (preferred: library updates keep your changes), or by changing a value in your copy of the stylesheet. After each token come the parts it styles, named by their class without `ui-form-` (as in Structure), with the option or state in brackets (joined by “+” when they apply together). Text uses the typography roles of `design-system.css`; border sides are physical (top, right, bottom, left).

**1. Appearance — change freely** (colours, type, borders, corners, motion: only the look changes)

- Colours
  - `--c-muted`: required note
- Typography
  - `--font-ui`: form
  - `--fw-ui`: form
  - `--fs-label`: required note

**2. Dimensions — change with care** (sizes and spacing: the component keeps working, its size changes)

- Spacing
  - `--gap-block`: form
  - `--gap-toolbar`: content
  - `--gap-inline-items`: actions

**3. Structure — don't change** (layout, behaviour, states, accessibility)

- No tokens.

**Set by the component — don't change**

- Variables
  - `--ui-form-columns`: number of columns (from `columns`)

## For AI-assisted development

### Instructions

- Read this README before writing code. Import only from `formIndex.js`.
- Build every form and filter panel with Form; never write summary boxes, submit handling, value collection or double-submit protection by hand.
- Pass the content as `children` render functions (ContentGroups for sections, inputs inside them). Give every input a `name`; the values are `{ name: value }`.
- Leave the inputs' `labelPosition` on `INHERIT` and set `labelPosition` on the Form.
- Submit forms: put the saving in `onSubmit(values, form)` and return its promise (the form stays busy until it settles); show server messages with `form.showErrors([{ name, message }])`.
- Cross-field rules go in `onValidate(values)` returning `[{ name, message }]`; single-field rules stay in the inputs' own options.
- Filters: `mode:'LIVE'` with `onChange(values)`; keep the default Apply button, or `liveApply:'AUTO'` with `liveDelayMs` for instant results; offer `showClear` ("Clear all").
- Use `warnUnsavedChanges:true` for forms that edit data.
- Inputs that do not follow the form-field contract are not Form fields: handle them in the application.
- Give each form a unique, DOM-safe `id` and call `destroy()` before rendering into the same container again (it also destroys the children).

### Safety

- Never submit without `onSubmit`'s validation having run; never bypass the summary for errors in submit mode.
- String children are inserted as HTML: escape user-provided or external data first.
- Error messages are shown as text; do not pass HTML.
- Never add native `required`/`pattern` attributes; the form is `novalidate` and validation belongs to the inputs.

### Example prompts

```text
Build a registration Form with sections "Personal data" and "Contact" in two columns, labels on the left, mandatory fields marked with an asterisk and a "* Required field" note; check that both e-mail fields match, submit to the API, and show "e-mail already registered" from the server next to the field.
```

```text
Build a filter panel above the orders table with search, status (multiple choice), period (date range with quick choices) and "only mine"; apply the filters with the Apply button, offer "Clear all", and reload the table with the values.
```

## For developers

### Business analysis

> **Component**: the Form itself. **Consumer**: the developer who configures the Form in the application's code. **App**: the running application that uses the Form; it provides the data, performs the actions and stores the changes.

**Submit mode**

- User clicks Submit. <!-- BA-01 -->
  - Component checks all fields. <!-- BA-02 -->
  - Component reports the values to the App when all fields are valid. <!-- BA-03 -->
  - App sends the values to the server. <!-- BA-04 -->
- Component prevents a second submit while the App saves, and displays the form as busy. <!-- BA-05 -->
  - Component displays a small turning ring with "Saving…" before the buttons when saving takes longer than a short delay (optional, on by default). <!-- BA-06 -->
  - Consumer chooses a layer over the whole form instead, which prevents changes while the App saves (optional). <!-- BA-07 -->
- Component displays a success message after a successful submit, e.g. "Your changes were saved.". <!-- BA-08 -->

**Error summary**

- Component displays a box at the top, "There is a problem", when a field has an error. <!-- BA-09 -->
  - Component displays every problem as a link that names its field, e.g. "E-mail: Required.". <!-- BA-10 -->
  - Component moves the focus to the box, so screen-reader users hear it. <!-- BA-11 -->
- User clicks a link in the summary. <!-- BA-12 -->
  - Component moves the user to the field. <!-- BA-13 -->

**Checks across fields and server messages**

- App provides checks across fields, e.g. "The e-mail addresses do not match.". <!-- BA-14 -->
- App provides messages returned by the server, e.g. "This e-mail address is already registered.". <!-- BA-15 -->
  - Component displays them next to the field and in the summary. <!-- BA-16 -->
  - Component clears them when the user changes the field. <!-- BA-17 -->

**Live mode**

- User changes a field. <!-- BA-18 -->
  - Component reports the values when the user clicks Apply, or after a short pause chosen by the Consumer. <!-- BA-19 -->
  - Component displays problems next to the fields only, and reports nothing until they are corrected. <!-- BA-20 -->

**Buttons**

- Consumer enables "Reset to initial values", "Clear all" and Cancel (optional), aligned at the start or the end. <!-- BA-21 -->
- User clicks Reset or Clear all while there are unsaved changes. <!-- BA-22 -->
  - Component asks "Discard your changes?", with "Keep editing" selected first. <!-- BA-23 -->
  - Component resets or clears without displaying "Required." errors until the user changes a field or submits. <!-- BA-24 -->

**Messages**

- Consumer chooses where general messages appear: above the fields (default), as a pop-up in a screen corner, or in another component, e.g. under the application header. <!-- BA-25 -->
  - Component closes a pop-up after 6 seconds and displays a thin bar with the time left (optional, on by default). <!-- BA-26 -->
  - Component keeps danger messages until the user closes them. <!-- BA-27 -->
- App provides its own messages, e.g. warnings, for the same place. <!-- BA-28 -->

**Layout**

- Consumer chooses one to four columns. <!-- BA-29 -->
  - Component displays one column on narrow screens. <!-- BA-30 -->
- Consumer chooses labels on top or on the left for all fields. <!-- BA-31 -->
  - Component moves the labels on top when there is not enough room. <!-- BA-32 -->
- Component displays a "* Required field" note when the fields use the asterisk. <!-- BA-33 -->

**Unsaved changes** (optional)

- User leaves the page with changes that were not submitted. <!-- BA-34 -->
  - Component asks the browser to confirm leaving the page. <!-- BA-35 -->

### Contracts

**Contracts:** Styling: three parts (Styling contract) · Form field: coordinates the fields · Actions: no · Shared behaviour: yes, additions under Accessibility

### Public API

```js
import { renderForm, DEFAULT_FORM_CONFIG, FORM_MODES, FORM_LIVE_APPLY, FORM_LABEL_POSITIONS, FORM_BUTTONS_ALIGN, FORM_REQUIRED_NOTES, FORM_BUSY_INDICATORS } from './formIndex.js';

const form = renderForm(container, config, children); // null after a developer error
```

`container` is a dedicated, consumer-owned element. Rendering replaces its content; `destroy()` clears it and destroys the children. `children` is an ordered array of static HTML strings or functions `(host, form) => instance`, like ContentGroup.

| Member | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | The configured id. |
| `getChildren()` | array | Top-level child instances. |
| `getFields()` | array | Fields found among the children and inside containers (`getChildren()`), first per name. |
| `getValues()` | object | `{ name: value }` of all fields (copies; files from UploadFiles are the `File` objects themselves). |
| `setValues(values)` | — | Sets the named fields programmatically (e.g. editing a saved record); other fields stay. |
| `submit()` | boolean | Submit mode: validates and submits like the Submit button; live mode: validates and applies. Returns whether it went through. |
| `validate()` | `{ valid, errors }` | Validates fields and cross-field rules; shows the summary in submit mode; `errors` is `[{ name, message }]`. |
| `showErrors(list)` | — | Shows server errors `[{ name, message }]` next to the fields (`setError`) and, in submit mode, in the summary. |
| `showMessage(message)` | — | Shows a non-field Message configuration (`{ type, title?, text, link?, … }`, any type) at `externalMessage.placement`. |
| `clearMessage()` | — | Removes the message shown above the form. |
| `clearErrors()` | — | Removes the errors Form set (cross-field and server) and hides the summary. |
| `reset()` | — | Returns every field to its value at render time; live mode reports the result. |
| `clear()` | — | Empties every field (`''`, `[]`, `false`, `null` or an object of empty members); live mode reports the result. |
| `setBusy(busy)` | — | Blocks Submit/Apply, sets `aria-busy` and runs or hides the Loader (`busyIndicator`). |
| `isDirty()` | boolean | Whether the values differ from the last submit, apply or reset. |
| `focus()` | boolean | Focuses the summary when it shows errors, otherwise the first field. |
| `destroy()` | — | Removes listeners, timers, Buttons and children, clears the container. |

### Form-field contract

Form finds fields by duck typing, never by importing or inspecting them. A field is any child instance (at any depth through `getChildren()`) with `getValue()`, `setValue()`, `validate()` and `focus()`; it needs a `name` to be included. Form also uses `getError()` and `getLabel()` (summary entries "{label}: {message}"), `getLabelPosition()` (mixed-position warning), `getMandatoryState()` (automatic required-field note) and, when present, `setError()` / `clearError()` (cross-field and server errors). The full contract is in the guidelines (§10.1). TextInput, TextArea, Select, CheckboxRadio, Toggle, Calendar and SearchBox follow it; SearchBox has no `setError()`, so its external errors appear in the summary only. Lazy CollapsiblePanel content is found only after the panel was first expanded.

### Configuration

Enumerated values are canonical UPPER_CASE and accepted case-insensitively. An invalid value produces an `INVALID_OPTION` warning and the default is used.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Allowed values / format | Applies when | Usage / description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | — | Starts with a letter; letters, digits, `_ : . -`; unique in the document | Always | Required. Id of the `<form>`. |
| `mode` | string | `'SUBMIT'` | `SUBMIT`, `LIVE` | Always | Submit with summary, or live reporting of changes. |
| `columns` | number | `1` | Integer 1–4 | Always | Grid columns (one column below a form width of 36rem). |
| `labelPosition` | string | `'TOP'` | `TOP`, `START` | Always | `START` adds the shared class `ui-labels-start`: labels of all `INHERIT` fields on the left. |
| `liveApply` | string | `'BUTTON'` | `BUTTON`, `AUTO` | `LIVE` | Report on the Apply button, or automatically after `liveDelayMs`. |
| `liveDelayMs` | number | `300` | Integer 0–10000 | `LIVE` + `AUTO` | Pause after the last change before reporting. |
| `showSubmit` | boolean | `true` | — | `SUBMIT` | Submit button. |
| `showReset` | boolean | `false` | — | Always | "Reset to initial values" button. |
| `showClear` | boolean | `false` | — | Always | "Clear all" button. |
| `showCancel` | boolean | `false` | — | Always | Cancel button (`onCancel`). |
| `buttonsAlign` | string | `'END'` | `START`, `END` | Always | Alignment of the buttons. |
| `warnUnsavedChanges` | boolean | `false` | — | Always | The browser asks for confirmation before leaving the page while `isDirty()` (the browser shows its own text). |
| `requiredNote` | string | `'AUTO'` | `AUTO`, `ALWAYS`, `NEVER` (`true`/`false` = `ALWAYS`/`NEVER`) | Always | "* Required field" note above the fields: `AUTO` shows it when at least one field shows the mandatory asterisk (`getMandatoryState()`), also for fields rendered later. |
| `confirmReset` | boolean | `true` | — | Always | Reset and Clear ask before discarding unsaved changes (WARNING modal; "Keep editing" focused). |
| `quietReset` | boolean | `true` | — | Always | Reset and Clear set values without validating (`setValue(value, { quiet:true })`): no errors until the user changes a field or submits. |
| `showSubmitSuccess` | boolean | `true` | — | `SUBMIT` | After a successful submit (a returned promise resolves, and `onSubmit` did not return / resolve `false`), shows `texts.submitSuccess` as a SUCCESS message. |
| `busyIndicator` | string | `'BUTTONS'` | `BUTTONS`, `OVERLAY`, `NONE` | Always | What the user sees while the form is busy (a pending `onSubmit` promise, `setBusy(true)`), after the Loader's delay (0.4 s): `BUTTONS` a small ring with `texts.busy` before the buttons (after the content when there are no buttons); `OVERLAY` a Loader layer over the form that also blocks it (focus moves into the layer and back); `NONE` only the disabled main button. |
| `externalMessage` | object | `{ placement:'ABOVE', remainingIndicator:'BAR' }` | `{ placement, toastArea?, onMessage?, remainingIndicator? }` | Always | Where non-field messages (submit success, `showMessage()`) appear: `ABOVE` the fields, `TOAST` (in `toastArea`), or `EXTERNAL` — handed to `onMessage(message, form)` for another component to show (e.g. `appHeader.showAnnouncement(message)`). `remainingIndicator` (`NONE`, `BAR`, `TEXT`, `BAR_AND_TEXT`; default `BAR`, TOAST only): how a toast that closes by itself (6 s; not DANGER) shows the time left, through Message's `remainingIndicator`; use `NONE` where an indicator is not wanted (e.g. very frequent, minor confirmations). |
| `texts.*` | string | English defaults | Text | Always | `submit`, `apply`, `reset` ("Reset to initial values"), `clear` ("Clear all"), `cancel`, `summaryTitle` ("There is a problem"), `summaryText` ("Correct the following and try again."), `submitSuccess` ("Your changes were saved."), `confirmTitle`, `confirmText`, `confirmDiscard`, `confirmKeep`, `summaryItem` ("{label}: {message}", one summary entry), `requiredNote` ("* Required field"), `busy` ("Saving…", the Loader's label). |
| `onSubmit` | function | `null` | `(values, form) => void \| Promise` | `SUBMIT` | Called with valid values; a returned promise keeps the form busy until it settles. |
| `onChange` | function | `null` | `(values, form) => void` | `LIVE` | Called with valid values on Apply or after the pause. |
| `onValidate` | function | `null` | `(values, form) => [{ name, message }] \| null` | Always | Cross-field rules, run after all fields are valid. |
| `onReset` / `onClear` / `onCancel` | function | `null` | `(form) => void` | Always | Called after reset, after clear, or on Cancel. |

Live-only options in submit mode, submit-only options in live mode and `liveDelayMs` with `liveApply:'BUTTON'` are ignored with `OPTION_IGNORED`.

With the default `requiredNote:'AUTO'`, the note appears only when a field shows the asterisk. Summary entries name their field: "E-mail: Required." (label from `getLabel()`; entries for unknown fields show the message alone). Reset and Clear ask first when the values differ from the last submitted, applied or reset ones (`confirmReset`); programmatic `reset()` and `clear()` never ask. With `quietReset` (default) they call `setValue(value, { quiet:true })` on each field, so no errors appear; with `quietReset:false` fields validate and empty mandatory fields show their error at once. Both also remove the error summary and the message above the form.

### Callbacks

| Callback | Arguments | Fires when | Does not fire when |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `onSubmit` | `(values, form)` | Submit button, Enter in a single-line field or `submit()`, with all fields and cross-field rules valid. | Errors exist (the summary is shown instead); the form is busy. |
| `onChange` | `(values, form)` | Live mode: Apply, the pause after a change (`AUTO`), reset or clear — with all fields valid. | Errors exist (shown next to the fields); the form is busy. |
| `onValidate` | `(values, form)` | During submit, apply or `validate()`, after all fields are valid. | Any field is invalid. |
| `onReset` / `onClear` / `onCancel` | `(form)` | The matching button or method. | — |

### Errors

Form has no user errors of its own: it shows its fields' errors, cross-field errors from `onValidate` and server errors from `showErrors()`. Before each submit or apply, the cross-field and server errors that Form set are removed and checked again. Developer errors prevent rendering (`renderForm()` returns `null`); warnings are logged and rendering continues. Console format: `Form "id" [LABEL]: message`.

| Label | Severity | Cause |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CONTAINER_REQUIRED` | error | No container passed. |
| `ID_REQUIRED` | error | `id` is empty. |
| `UNSAFE_ID` | error | `id` is not DOM-safe. |
| `DUPLICATE_ID` | error | An element with the same id already exists in the document. |
| `INVALID_OPTION` | warning | Invalid enumerated value or number; the default is used. |
| `MESSAGE_TARGET_MISSING` | warning | `externalMessage.placement` `TOAST` without `toastArea`, or `EXTERNAL` without `onMessage`; messages are shown above the form. |
| `OPTION_IGNORED` | warning | Option that does not apply to the mode. |
| `INVALID_CHILD` | warning | A child is neither a string nor a function; ignored. |
| `FIELD_WITHOUT_NAME` | warning | A field without `name`; not included in the values. |
| `DUPLICATE_FIELD_NAME` | warning | Two fields with the same name; only the first is used. |
| `MIXED_LABEL_POSITIONS` | warning | Fields report different label positions. |
| `UNKNOWN_FIELD` | warning | An `onValidate` or `showErrors` entry names no field; shown in the summary only. |

### Accessibility

- A real `<form novalidate>`; Enter in a single-line field submits (or applies) through the Submit/Apply Button.
- The error summary is a DANGER Message (an alert): on a failed submit, focus moves to it so screen readers read it once, and each entry is a link that moves focus to its field. Success and other messages are announced politely (Message); the Reset/Clear confirmation is a modal dialog with "Keep editing" focused. Fields show their own messages linked through `aria-describedby`.
- `aria-busy` while saving; the main button is disabled so it cannot be pressed twice; the Loader announces "Saving…" when it appears (`OVERLAY` also makes the form inert).
- Label position and columns fall back to a single, labels-on-top layout in narrow containers.
- Field names and messages should be specific ("Enter your e-mail address"), because the summary shows the fields' messages as they are.

### Examples

Registration with sections, cross-field rule, server errors and busy state:

```js
const form = renderForm(formHost,
{
    id:'signup', columns:2, labelPosition:'START', showReset:true, warnUnsavedChanges:true,
    onValidate:( values ) => ( values.email !== values.emailConfirm ? [ { name:'emailConfirm', message:'The e-mail addresses do not match.' } ] : null ),
    onSubmit:async ( values, form ) =>
    {
        const response = await api.register(values);
        if ( response.errors ) { form.showErrors(response.errors); }   // e.g. [{ name:'email', message:'This e-mail address is already registered.' }]
    }
},
[
    host => renderContentGroup(host,{ id:'personal', label:'Personal data' },[
        h => renderTextInput(h,{ id:'first-name', name:'firstName', label:'First name', mandatoryIndicator:'MANDATORY_ASTERISK', texts:{ errors:{ REQUIRED:'Enter your first name.' } } }),
        h => renderCalendar(h,{ id:'birth-date', name:'birthDate', label:'Birth date', mandatory:false })
    ]),
    host => renderContentGroup(host,{ id:'contact', label:'Contact' },[
        h => renderTextInput(h,{ id:'email', name:'email', label:'E-mail', type:'EMAIL', mandatoryIndicator:'MANDATORY_ASTERISK' }),
        h => renderTextInput(h,{ id:'email-confirm', name:'emailConfirm', label:'Repeat e-mail', type:'EMAIL', mandatoryIndicator:'MANDATORY_ASTERISK' })
    ])
]);
```

Filter panel (live mode) reloading a table:

```js
renderForm(filterHost,{ id:'order-filters', mode:'LIVE', columns:4, showClear:true, showReset:true, onChange:( values ) => loadOrders(values) },
[
    host => renderSearchBox(host,{ id:'filter-q', name:'q', label:'Search', searchMode:'ON_DEMAND' }),
    host => renderSelect(host,{ id:'filter-status', name:'status', label:'Status', mandatory:false, selectionMode:'MULTIPLE', presentation:'CUSTOM', options:statusOptions }),
    host => renderCalendar(host,{ id:'filter-period', name:'period', label:'Period', range:true, mandatory:false, quickRanges:[ 'LAST_7_DAYS', 'LAST_1_MONTH' ] }),
    host => renderToggle(host,{ id:'filter-mine', name:'onlyMine', label:'Only mine' })
]);
```

The same live mode serves settings pages, calculators and previews: set `liveApply:'AUTO'` for instant results.

Success message in the application header (any non-field message can go the same way):

```js
renderForm(formHost,{ id:'profile', externalMessage:{ placement:'EXTERNAL', onMessage:( message ) => header.showAnnouncement(message) },
    onSubmit:values => api.saveProfile(values) },children);
```

### Files

| File | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `formIndex.js` | Public entry point; the only import surface. |
| `formConfig.js` | Defaults, allowed values, normalization, developer validation. |
| `formComponent.js` | Field discovery, values, validation, summary, submit/apply, reset/clear, busy state with the Loader, change detection, unsaved-changes warning, Buttons. |
| `formHTML.js` | Form shell, button and Loader hosts. |
| `formEvents.js` | Submit, summary links, change detection and unsaved-changes listeners. |
| `formErrors.js` | Developer error and warning catalog. |
| `form.css` | Presentation. |
| `formTESTS.md` | Test plan: the cases that prove this README (automatic ones in `tests/components/form.test.mjs`). |


<!-- ===== source/components-js/loader/loaderREADME.md ===== -->

# Loader

## For business

### Overview

Loader shows that a long action is running (an upload, an export, a report, a server check) and, when the application knows it, how far it has got. Typical uses are saving, importing and exporting data, and reloading a table or a form.

### When to use

- Use it for actions that take longer than about half a second; quicker actions finish before it appears.
- Use it as a layer over a table, form or panel when the user must not change that region while it reloads or saves.
- Use Stepper to show the steps of a task the user goes through; use Message for the result of an action (e.g. "Saved") that the user must read later.

### Key features

- A bar or a ring, small, medium or large, that moves while the duration is unknown and fills when the application reports the progress ("45%", "12 of 30" or its own text).
- Appears only when the action takes longer than a short delay and then stays long enough to be seen, so it never flashes.
- Ends with done, failed or cancelled, shown with a symbol, a colour and a text; a failure stays until the application hides it.
- In the page, as a thin line along the top of a region, or as a layer that covers and blocks a region while it loads or saves.
- An optional Cancel button; the application decides whether the action stops.

### Dependencies

| Dependency | Needed when | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Design system (`design-system.css`) | Always | Colours, type, motion and spacing; `--progress-sweep-duration` and `--scrim-bg`. |
| Loader styles (`loader.css`) | Always | Bar, ring, texts, layer and panel. |
| Button component and `button.css` | `cancellable` | The Cancel button. |
| Font Awesome icon library | Always | Symbols of the end statuses. Loaded by the application page. |

### Not included

The application runs the action, reports its progress, decides what Cancel does and shows the outcome that must stay on the screen (e.g. with Message). Several actions at once in one list, buffered progress (as in video players) and blocking the whole page (a dialog) are not part of this version.

## For designers

### Structure

```text
div#{id}.ui-loader.ui-loader-{bar|ring}.ui-loader-size-{small|medium|large}.ui-loader-placement-{inline|edge|overlay}.ui-loader-label-{above|below|end|hidden}[.ui-loader-indicator-{center|top}][.ui-loader-indeterminate][.ui-loader-shown][.ui-loader-blocking]  data-status="{IDLE|RUNNING|DONE|ERROR|CANCELLED}"
├── div.ui-loader-frame [hidden]                                (hidden while nothing is shown)
│   ├── div.ui-loader-scrim                                     (OVERLAY)
│   └── div.ui-loader-panel
│       ├── div.ui-loader-body
│       │   ├── div.ui-loader-indicator  role="progressbar"  aria-valuenow  aria-valuetext
│       │   │   ├── span.ui-loader-track > span.ui-loader-fill                      (BAR)
│       │   │   └── svg.ui-loader-circle > circle.ui-loader-circle-track, circle.ui-loader-circle-arc ; i.ui-loader-symbol   (RING)
│       │   └── div.ui-loader-text                              (visually hidden with labelPlacement HIDDEN)
│       │       ├── i.ui-loader-symbol                          (BAR; end statuses)
│       │       ├── span.ui-loader-label
│       │       └── span.ui-loader-value                        (known progress)
│       └── span.ui-loader-cancel[data-button="cancel"] → Button   (cancellable; hidden when not running)
├── div.ui-loader-live                                          (polite announcements)
└── div.ui-loader-alert                                         (failure, announced at once)
On the covered element (target): .ui-loader-target [.ui-loader-target-static] (EDGE while shown, OVERLAY while blocking), aria-busy="true" (OVERLAY)
```

The bar is a muted track with an accent fill; while the progress is unknown a band grows from the start and shrinks towards the end. The ring is a muted circle with an accent arc that turns, or fills when the progress is known. At the end the fill takes the success colour (done, with a check), the danger colour (failed, with an exclamation mark, the text in red) or the muted colour (cancelled, with a crossed circle); a ring is replaced by its symbol at the same size. OVERLAY dims the region with the scrim and shows the indicator in a panel with a border.

### Visual options

| Option | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Shape | Bar, ring | `ui-loader-bar`, `ui-loader-ring` |
| Size | Small (thin line, icon-sized ring), medium, large | `ui-loader-size-small`, `-medium`, `-large` |
| Placement | In the page flow, line along the top of a region, layer covering a region | `ui-loader-placement-inline`, `-edge`, `-overlay` |
| Label placement | Above, below, after the indicator, hidden (screen readers only) | `ui-loader-label-above`, `-below`, `-end`, `-hidden` |
| Panel position (layer) | Middle of the region, top of its visible part | `ui-loader-indicator-center`, `-top` |
| Cancel button | Off, on | —, `.ui-loader-cancel` |

### States

| State | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Loader | Hidden, shown | `.ui-loader-frame[hidden]`, `ui-loader-shown` |
| Progress | Unknown (moving), known (filling) | `ui-loader-indeterminate`, — |
| Status | Idle, running, done, failed, cancelled | `[data-status="IDLE"]`, `"RUNNING"`, `"DONE"`, `"ERROR"`, `"CANCELLED"` |
| Covered region (layer) | Blocked | `ui-loader-blocking`; on the region `.ui-loader-target`, `[aria-busy="true"]` |

### Styling contract

`loader.css` has three parts, marked in the stylesheet. Restyle by writing the same selector with a new value in your own stylesheet, inside `@layer overrides` (preferred: library updates keep your changes), or by changing a value in your copy of the stylesheet. After each token come the parts it styles, named by their class without `ui-loader-` (as in Structure), with the option or state in brackets (joined by “+” when they apply together). Text uses the typography roles of `design-system.css`; border sides are physical (top, right, bottom, left).

**1. Appearance — change freely** (colours, type, borders, corners, motion: only the look changes)

- Colours
  - `--c-text`: loader
  - `--c-muted`: value, fill (status cancelled), symbol (status cancelled)
  - `--c-surface-muted`: track, circle track
  - `--c-accent`: fill, circle arc
  - `--c-success`: fill (status done)
  - `--c-success-text`: symbol (status done)
  - `--c-danger`: fill (status error)
  - `--c-danger-text`: symbol (status error), label (status error)
  - `--scrim-bg`: scrim
  - `--c-surface`: panel (placement overlay)
  - `--c-border`: panel (placement overlay)
- Typography
  - `--font-ui`: loader
  - `--fw-ui`: loader
  - `--fs-label`: loader
  - `--lh-compact`: loader
  - `--fs-caption`: loader (size small)
  - `--fs-control`: loader (size large)
  - `--fw-ui-strong`: label
- Borders and corners
  - `--radius-pill`: track, fill
  - `--border-thin`: panel (placement overlay)
  - `--radius-panel`: panel (placement overlay)
- Shadows
  - `--shadow-md`: panel (placement overlay)
- States and motion
  - `--transition-1`: fill, circle arc, frame (placement overlay)
  - `--progress-sweep-duration`: fill (indeterminate)
  - `--spinner-duration`: circle (indeterminate)

**2. Dimensions — change with care** (sizes and spacing: the component keeps working, its size changes)

- Spacing
  - `--gap-inline-items`: panel
  - `--gap-tight`: body, text
  - `--padding-card`: frame (placement overlay), panel (placement overlay, indicator top)
  - `--page-sticky-offset`: panel (indicator top)
- Sizes
  - `--space-md-1`: track
  - `--space-sm-2`: track (size small)
  - `--space-md-3`: track (size large)
  - `--icon-size-medium`: symbol (bar, ring + size small), circle (ring + size small)
  - `--size-md-1`: indicator (bar + label end)
  - `--space-lg-3`: circle, symbol (ring)
  - `--space-xl-3`: circle (ring + size large), symbol (ring + size large)
  - `--size-md-2`: panel (placement overlay + bar)

**3. Structure — don't change** (layout, behaviour, states, accessibility)

- States and motion
  - `--focus-outline`: indicator (focus)
  - `--focus-offset`: indicator (focus)
  - `--opacity-muted`: fill (indeterminate + reduced motion)

**Set by the component — don't change**

- Variables
  - `--ui-loader-progress`: share done, from 0 to 1 (`setValue()`; 1 at `DONE`); sizes the bar's fill

## For AI-assisted development

### Instructions

- Read this README before writing code. Import only from `loaderIndex.js`.
- Check the configuration before adding code; configure instead of building spinners, progress bars, delays, overlays or focus handling.
- Keep business logic (running the action, what Cancel stops, the message after a failure) in the application; don't modify the component for application needs.
- Prefer `track(promise)` for actions without progress; use `start()`, `setValue()` and `setStatus()` when the application knows the progress or the end comes from elsewhere (e.g. a server event).
- Use `OVERLAY` only when the region must not be changed while the action runs (a reload, a save); put the Loader's container inside that region (its last child) and pass the region as `target` when it is not the container's parent.
- Respect conditional options: `EDGE` is always a small bar without visible text or Cancel; `indicatorPosition` needs `OVERLAY`; `onCancel` needs `cancellable`; `value` needs `running`.
- `onCancel` reports the user's request; call `setStatus('CANCELLED')` yourself once the action has stopped.
- Use unique ids, and call `destroy()` before rendering into the same container again (it also releases a blocked region).

### Safety

- Labels and texts are inserted as text.
- Don't remove the progress-bar role, its label or the live regions; don't hide the Loader with your own styles while it blocks a region.
- Don't rely on the layer for security: the server must still refuse changes made during an action.

### Example prompts

```text
While the orders table reloads after a filter change, cover it with a Loader layer and keep the filter bar usable.
```

```text
Show the progress of the CSV export with a Loader bar "Exporting report…" with Cancel; update it from the export's progress events and show "Report exported" at the end.
```

## For developers

### Business analysis

> **Component**: the Loader itself. **Consumer**: the developer who configures the Loader in the application's code. **App**: the running application that uses the Loader; it provides the data, performs the actions and stores the changes.

**Action**

- App performs a long action. <!-- BA-01 -->
  - Component displays a moving indicator with a label ("Loading…") after a short delay. <!-- BA-02 -->
  - Component keeps the indicator hidden when the action ends within the delay. <!-- BA-03 -->
  - Component keeps the indicator on the screen for a minimum time once displayed. <!-- BA-04 -->
- App provides the progress of the action (optional). <!-- BA-05 -->
  - Component changes the indicator to the share done. <!-- BA-06 -->
  - Component displays the value as a percentage, as "12 of 30", or as the App's own text. <!-- BA-07 -->
- App changes the label while the action runs. <!-- BA-08 -->
- App marks the action as done, failed or cancelled. <!-- BA-09 -->
  - Component displays the end with a symbol, a colour and a text. <!-- BA-10 -->
  - Component hides the indicator after a short time when the action is done or cancelled. <!-- BA-11 -->
  - Component keeps a failed action on the screen until the App hides it or starts again. <!-- BA-12 -->
  - Component displays a failure even when it comes within the delay. <!-- BA-13 -->
- Component marks the action as done or failed when the App's pending result arrives (optional). <!-- BA-14 -->
- App decides to hide the indicator at any time. <!-- BA-15 -->

**Cancel**

- Consumer enables a Cancel button (optional). <!-- BA-16 -->
  - User clicks Cancel. <!-- BA-17 -->
    - Component disables Cancel. <!-- BA-18 -->
    - Component reports the request to the App. <!-- BA-19 -->
    - App decides whether the action stops. <!-- BA-20 -->

**Look**

- Consumer chooses a bar or a ring. <!-- BA-21 -->
- Consumer chooses the size: small, medium or large. <!-- BA-22 -->
- Consumer chooses the label above, below or after the indicator, or hidden. <!-- BA-23 -->
- Consumer chooses the value as a percentage, as a count or none. <!-- BA-24 -->

**Placement**

- Consumer chooses the indicator in the page flow (on by default). <!-- BA-25 -->
- Consumer chooses a thin line along the top edge of a region (optional). <!-- BA-26 -->
- Consumer chooses a layer that covers a region (optional). <!-- BA-27 -->
  - Component prevents clicks, typing and screen-reader access to the region from the start of the action. <!-- BA-28 -->
  - Component prevents access to content the App adds to the region while it is blocked. <!-- BA-29 -->
  - Component displays the region dimmed and the indicator in a panel after the delay. <!-- BA-30 -->
  - Component moves the focus into the layer when it was inside the region. <!-- BA-31 -->
  - Consumer chooses the panel in the middle of the region or at the top of its visible part. <!-- BA-32 -->
  - Component keeps the region blocked until the indicator hides. <!-- BA-33 -->
  - Component moves the focus back to where it was, or to the start of the region. <!-- BA-34 -->

**Screen readers**

- Component exposes the indicator as a progress bar with its label and value. <!-- BA-35 -->
- Component announces the label when the indicator is displayed. <!-- BA-36 -->
- Component announces the progress at every quarter (optional, on by default). <!-- BA-37 -->
- Component announces the end; a failure interrupts other speech. <!-- BA-38 -->
- Component exposes the covered region as busy. <!-- BA-39 -->

### Contracts

**Contracts:** Styling: three parts (Styling contract) · Form field: no · Actions: no · Shared behaviour: yes, additions under Accessibility

### Public API

```js
import { renderLoader, DEFAULT_LOADER_CONFIG, LOADER_SHAPES, LOADER_SIZES, LOADER_PLACEMENTS, LOADER_LABEL_PLACEMENTS, LOADER_VALUE_TEXTS, LOADER_INDICATOR_POSITIONS, LOADER_END_STATUSES } from './loaderIndex.js';

const loader = renderLoader(container, config); // null after a developer error
```

`container` is a dedicated, consumer-owned element. Rendering replaces its content; `destroy()` clears it. Nothing is visible until `start()`, `track()` or `running:true`.

| Member | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | The configured id. |
| `start(label?)` | — | Starts the action: `RUNNING`, progress unknown, shown after `showDelayMs`; `OVERLAY` blocks the target at once. Also restarts a running or ended Loader. `label` replaces the configured label for this action. |
| `setValue(value, text?)` | boolean | Sets the progress (clamped to 0–`max`) and an optional value text that replaces "45%" or "12 of 30"; `null` makes the progress unknown again. `false` with `INVALID_VALUE` (not a number) or `NOT_RUNNING`. |
| `setLabel(text)` | — | Changes the label (empty: the configured label or `texts.loading`). |
| `setStatus(status, text?)` | boolean | Ends the action with `'DONE'`, `'ERROR'` or `'CANCELLED'` and an optional text (default `texts.done`, `texts.error`, `texts.cancelled`). `false` with `INVALID_STATUS` or `NOT_RUNNING`. |
| `hide()` | — | Hides the Loader (after the rest of `minVisibleMs`) and releases the target; a running action becomes `IDLE`, and a pending `track()` no longer changes it. |
| `track(promise, texts?)` | Promise | `start(texts.label)`, then `DONE` (`texts.done`) when the Promise resolves or `ERROR` (`texts.error`) when it is rejected; returns the same Promise. Ignored after a later `start()`, `setStatus()` or `hide()`. Not a Promise: `INVALID_PROMISE`. |
| `getState()` | object | `{ status, visible, value, max, label }`: `status` `IDLE`, `RUNNING`, `DONE`, `ERROR` or `CANCELLED`; `value` `null` while the progress is unknown; `label` the text shown (the end text after the end). |
| `destroy()` | — | Clears the timers, releases the target, removes the Cancel Button, clears the container. |

### Configuration

| Parameter | Type | Default | Allowed values / format | Applies when | Usage / description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | — | Starts with a letter; letters, digits, `_ : . -`; unique in the document | Always | Required. Root element id. |
| `shape` | string | `'BAR'` | `BAR`, `RING` | Not `EDGE` | Bar or ring. |
| `size` | string | `'MEDIUM'` | `SMALL`, `MEDIUM`, `LARGE` | Not `EDGE` | Bar thickness, ring size and text size. `SMALL`: a thin line, or a ring of icon size. |
| `placement` | string | `'INLINE'` | `INLINE`, `EDGE`, `OVERLAY` | Always | `INLINE`: in the container, in the page flow. `EDGE`: a thin line along the top of the target, taking no space (always `BAR`, `SMALL`, label `HIDDEN`, no Cancel). `OVERLAY`: a layer that covers and blocks the target. |
| `target` | Element | the container's parent | An element that contains the container | Not `INLINE` | The region covered (`OVERLAY`) or edged (`EDGE`). Not an element, or not containing the container: `INVALID_TARGET` (nothing rendered). |
| `label` | string | `texts.loading` | Text | Always | The label while the action runs; `start(label)` and `track(promise, { label })` replace it for one action. |
| `labelPlacement` | string | `'ABOVE'` (`BAR`), `'END'` (`RING`) | `ABOVE`, `BELOW`, `END`, `HIDDEN` | Not `EDGE` | Where the label and the value go. `HIDDEN`: for screen readers only. |
| `valueText` | string | `'PERCENT'` | `PERCENT`, `COUNT`, `NONE` | Not `EDGE` | The visible value of known progress: "45%", "12 of 30" (`value` of `max`) or none. Screen readers always get the value. |
| `max` | number | `100` | Greater than 0 | Always | The value of a complete action (e.g. the number of files). |
| `running` | boolean | `false` | — | Always | Starts at once when rendered (e.g. the first load of a page), as `start()`. |
| `value` | number | `null` | 0–`max` | `running` | The progress at the start; `null`: unknown. |
| `cancellable` | boolean | `false` | — | Not `EDGE` | Shows a Cancel button while the action runs. Without `onCancel` it is not shown (`CANCEL_HANDLER_MISSING`). |
| `indicatorPosition` | string | `'CENTER'` | `CENTER`, `TOP` | `OVERLAY` | Panel in the middle of the target, or at the top of its visible part (below a sticky page header) for tall, scrolled regions. |
| `showDelayMs` | number | `400` | 0 or more | Always | Time before the Loader appears; actions that end sooner are never shown (a failure is shown at once). The `OVERLAY` blocking starts at once. |
| `minVisibleMs` | number | `600` | 0 or more | Always | Shortest time on the screen once shown. |
| `hideAfterMs` | number | `1500` | 0 or more | Always | Time the end is shown after `DONE` or `CANCELLED`; `ERROR` stays until `hide()` or `start()`. |
| `announceEvery` | number | `25` | 0–100 | Always | Progress announced to screen readers every this many percent; `0`: only the start and the end. |
| `texts.*` | object | English defaults | Text; `{value}`, `{max}` placeholders | Always | `loading`, `done`, `error`, `cancelled`, `cancel`, `percent` (`'{value}%'`), `count` (`'{value} of {max}'`). |
| `onCancel` | function | `null` | `(loader) => {}` | `cancellable` | See Callbacks. |

`OVERLAY` blocks the target from `start()` to the hiding: the layer takes the pointer, everything else in the target becomes `inert` (also content added meanwhile), the target gets `aria-busy="true"` and focus inside it moves into the layer (to Cancel once shown). When the target is not positioned, the component makes it `position:relative` while it blocks or edges it (`.ui-loader-target-static`); a positioned element between the container and the target takes the layer instead (`POSITIONED_ANCESTOR`). Options that do not apply are ignored with `OPTION_IGNORED`.

### Callbacks

| Callback | Arguments | Fires when | Does not fire when |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `onCancel` | `(loader)` | The user presses Cancel while the action runs (once per action: Cancel is then disabled). | `setStatus('CANCELLED')`; `hide()`; a Loader that is not running. |

### Errors

Loader has no user-facing errors: the failure of the action is shown with `setStatus('ERROR', text)` or `track()`. Developer errors prevent rendering; warnings are logged and rendering continues. Console format: `Loader "id" [LABEL]: message`.

| Label | Severity | Cause |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CONTAINER_REQUIRED` | error | No container passed. |
| `ID_REQUIRED` | error | `id` is empty. |
| `UNSAFE_ID` | error | `id` is not DOM-safe. |
| `DUPLICATE_ID` | error | An element with the same id already exists in the document. |
| `INVALID_TARGET` | error | `EDGE` or `OVERLAY` without a target that contains the container (also a container without a parent). |
| `INVALID_OPTION` | warning | Invalid enumerated value or number; the default is used. |
| `OPTION_IGNORED` | warning | An option that does not apply (see Applies when), e.g. `RING`, a size or a label placement with `EDGE`. |
| `POSITIONED_ANCESTOR` | warning | A positioned element between the container and the target; the layer covers that element. |
| `CANCEL_HANDLER_MISSING` | warning | `cancellable` without `onCancel`; Cancel is not shown. |
| `INVALID_VALUE` | warning | `value` or `setValue()` with something that is not a number. |
| `INVALID_STATUS` | warning | `setStatus()` with a status other than `DONE`, `ERROR`, `CANCELLED`. |
| `NOT_RUNNING` | warning | `setValue()` or `setStatus()` while the Loader is not running. |
| `INVALID_PROMISE` | warning | `track()` without a Promise. |

### Accessibility

- The indicator is a progress bar named by the label; known progress sets `aria-valuenow` and `aria-valuetext` ("45%", "12 of 30" or the application's text); unknown progress has no value.
- The label is announced politely when the Loader appears (not for actions that end before), the progress every `announceEvery` percent and the end; a failure is announced assertively.
- `OVERLAY` makes the target `inert` and `aria-busy`, so keyboard and screen-reader users cannot change it either; focus moves into the layer (the indicator, then Cancel) and back to the element that had it, or to the first focusable element of the target.
- End statuses use a symbol and a text besides the colour.
- With reduced motion the moving band becomes a still, lighter bar and the ring stops turning.

### Examples

Saving with a ring next to the button bar:

```js
const saving = renderLoader(document.getElementById('save-status'), { id:'save-status', shape:'RING', size:'SMALL' });
saveButton.onclick = () => saving.track(api.saveProfile(),{ label:'Saving…', done:'Saved', error:'Could not save. Try again.' });
```

Export with progress and Cancel:

```js
const exporting = renderLoader(host,
{
    id:'export', label:'Exporting report…', cancellable:true,
    onCancel:loader => job.cancel().then(() => loader.setStatus('CANCELLED'))
});
exporting.start();
job.onProgress = ( done, total ) => exporting.setValue(done / total * 100);
job.onEnd = ok => exporting.setStatus(ok ? 'DONE' : 'ERROR',ok ? 'Report exported' : 'The export failed');
```

A layer over the orders table while it reloads (the container is the last child of the table's section):

```js
const reloading = renderLoader(document.getElementById('orders-busy'), { id:'orders-busy', placement:'OVERLAY', indicatorPosition:'TOP', label:'Loading orders…' });
filter.onchange = () => reloading.track(loadOrders(filter.value).then(rows => table.setData(rows)));
```

### Files

| File | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `loaderIndex.js` | Public entry point; the only import surface. |
| `loaderConfig.js` | Defaults, allowed values, normalization, developer validation, the target. |
| `loaderComponent.js` | Lifecycle, timing (delay, minimum time, hiding), statuses, `track()`, blocking of the target and focus, announcements, Cancel Button, runtime API. |
| `loaderState.js` | Status, visibility, value, texts, timers and the token of the tracked Promise. |
| `loaderHTML.js` | Indicator (bar or ring), texts, Cancel host, scrim and live regions. |
| `loaderErrors.js` | Developer error and warning catalog. |
| `loader.css` | Presentation of the bar, ring, texts, end statuses, line, layer and panel. |
| `loaderTESTS.md` | Test plan: the cases that prove this README (automatic ones in `tests/components/loader.test.mjs`). |


<!-- ===== source/components-js/message/messageREADME.md ===== -->

# Message

## For business

### Overview

Message tells users something about the system or their work: that something succeeded, needs attention, failed, or is simply useful to know. The same message can appear in five ways — a line of text, a box, a strip across the page, a small pop-up in a corner, or a window in the middle of the screen that asks for a decision.

### When to use

- Use it to tell the user that something succeeded, needs attention, failed, or is useful to know.
- Use the modal layout only when the user must read or decide, e.g. "Delete 12 orders?".
- Use a field's own error for input mistakes, Notification for a count on an icon, and Loader for an action that is still running.

### Key features

- Five types with their own colour and icon: information, success, warning, danger and custom.
- Five layouts: inline line, box, page-wide banner, toast in a screen corner, and modal window.
- Optional title, link, list of details and action buttons.
- Permanent, closable or temporary messages, with an optional countdown.
- New messages announced to screen readers: urgent ones at once, others politely.

### Dependencies

| Dependency | Needed when | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Design system (`design-system.css`) | Always | Colours of the types, spacing and typography. |
| Message styles (`message.css`) | Always | Layouts. |
| Button component and `button.css` | Close button or actions | Buttons. |
| Font Awesome icon library | Always | Type icons. Loaded by the application page. |
| Tooltip component and `tooltip.css` | `tooltipMode` `TOOLTIP` | Tooltips (the Tooltip module is loaded only then). |

### Not included

The application decides what to say and when, performs the actions (Undo, Retry, Delete), and provides the area where toasts appear (once per page). Remembering closed announcements is done by the application with `onClose`.

## For designers

### Structure

```text
div#{id}.ui-message.ui-message-{inline|block|banner|toast|modal}.ui-message-type-{info|success|warning|danger|custom}  [role="status|alert"]
├── span.ui-message-icon > i                         (type icon; aria-hidden)
├── div.ui-message-body
│   ├── p.ui-message-title                           (optional)
│   ├── p.ui-message-text (+ a.ui-message-link)
│   ├── ul.ui-message-details > li [> a.ui-message-detail-link]   (optional; not in INLINE)
│   ├── div.ui-message-actions > span.ui-message-action → Button   (optional; not in INLINE)
│   └── div.ui-message-remaining                     (remainingIndicator: bar and/or text, aria-hidden; one visually hidden sentence)
└── span.ui-message-close-host → Button (×)          (closable)

MODAL: the same inside a native <dialog> (with a dimmed ::backdrop).
TOAST: inside div.ui-message-region.ui-message-region-{top-left|top-right|bottom-left|bottom-right} in the application's toast area.
```

The title is bold at the control size; the text, its link and the details are one step smaller (`--fs-label`). Block, toast and modal have a thicker coloured start edge and rounded corners; with `bordered` they also have a thin border on the other sides, and `cornerRadius:'NONE'` makes the corners square; banners span the full width with a bottom border; inline has no box. The modal uses the surface colour with the type colour on its edge and icon. Toast regions sit below the application's sticky header (`--page-sticky-offset`) at the top, above other content.

### Visual options

| Option | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Type | Info, success, warning, danger, custom | `ui-message-type-info`, `-success`, `-warning`, `-danger`, `-custom` (custom colours via `--ui-message-bg/-color/-border`) |
| Layout | Inline, block, banner, toast, modal | `ui-message-inline`, `-block`, `-banner`, `-toast`, `-modal` |
| Toast corner | Top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right | `ui-message-region-top-left`, … |
| Border (block, toast, modal) | Coloured start edge only (default), full border | `ui-message-bordered` |
| Corners (block, toast, modal) | Rounded (default), square | `ui-message-square` |
| Remaining time (temporary messages) | None (default), bar, text, bar and text | `ui-message-remaining`, `-bar`, `-text` |

### States

| State | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Remaining time | Paused | `ui-message-remaining-paused` |

### Styling contract

`message.css` has three parts, marked in the stylesheet. Restyle by writing the same selector with a new value in your own stylesheet, inside `@layer overrides` (preferred: library updates keep your changes), or by changing a value in your copy of the stylesheet. After each token come the parts it styles, named by their class without `ui-message-` (as in Structure), with the option or state in brackets (joined by “+” when they apply together). Text uses the typography roles of `design-system.css`; border sides are physical (top, right, bottom, left).

**1. Appearance — change freely** (colours, type, borders, corners, motion: only the look changes)

- Colours
  - `--c-info-text`: message
  - `--c-info`: message (block, toast, banner, modal), icon (modal)
  - `--c-info-soft`: message (block, toast, banner)
  - `--c-success-text`: message (type success)
  - `--c-success`: message (block + type success, toast + type success, banner + type success, modal + type success), icon (modal + type success)
  - `--c-success-soft`: message (block + type success, toast + type success, banner + type success)
  - `--c-warning-text`: message (type warning)
  - `--c-warning`: message (block + type warning, toast + type warning, banner + type warning, modal + type warning), icon (modal + type warning)
  - `--c-warning-soft`: message (block + type warning, toast + type warning, banner + type warning)
  - `--c-danger-text`: message (type danger)
  - `--c-danger`: message (block + type danger, toast + type danger, banner + type danger, modal + type danger), icon (modal + type danger)
  - `--c-danger-soft`: message (block + type danger, toast + type danger, banner + type danger)
  - `--c-surface`: message (modal)
  - `--c-text`: message (modal)
  - `--c-border`: message (modal)
  - `--shadow-color`: message (modal + backdrop)
- Typography
  - `--font-ui`: message
  - `--fw-ui`: message
  - `--fs-control`: message
  - `--lh-body`: message
  - `--fs-label`: message (inline), text, details
  - `--fw-ui-strong`: title, link
  - `--fs-caption`: remaining
  - `--fs-block-title`: title (modal)
- Borders and corners
  - `--border-thick`: message (block, toast, modal)
  - `--radius-control`: message (block, toast, modal)
  - `--border-thin`: bordered, message (banner)
  - `--radius-pill`: remaining (bar, fill)
- Shadows
  - `--shadow-md`: message (toast, modal)
- States and motion
  - `--opacity-disabled`: remaining (fill + remaining paused)
- Sizes
  - `--icon-size-medium`: icon

**2. Dimensions — change with care** (sizes and spacing: the component keeps working, its size changes)

- Spacing
  - `--gap-inline-items`: message (also block, toast, modal, banner), actions (also modal), region, remaining
  - `--gap-tight`: body (also banner), actions, remaining
  - `--gap-block`: details, message (block, toast, modal, banner), body (banner), region
  - `--space-sm-2`: close host, remaining (bar)
- Sizes
  - `--size-md-4`: region, message (modal)
  - `--size-md-1`: remaining (text)

**3. Structure — don't change** (layout, behaviour, states, accessibility)

- Typography
  - `--fs-control`: icon
  - `--lh-body`: icon (also inline, modal)
  - `--fs-label`: icon (also inline)
  - `--fs-block-title`: icon (modal)
- States and motion
  - `--focus-outline`: link (focus), detail link (focus), message (focus)
  - `--focus-offset`: link (focus), detail link (focus), message (focus)
- Spacing
  - `--page-sticky-offset`: region (top left, top right)

**Set by the component — don't change**

- Variables
  - `--ui-message-bg`, `--ui-message-color`, `--ui-message-border`: custom colours (from `backgroundToken`, `colorToken`, `borderToken`)
  - `--ui-message-remaining`: remaining part of the display time, from 1 to 0

## For AI-assisted development

### Instructions

- Read this README before writing code. Import only from `messageIndex.js`.
- Choose the layout by importance: INLINE for small notes, BLOCK for results with next steps, BANNER for page- or application-wide announcements (AppHeader's `announcement`), TOAST for short feedback, MODAL only when the user must read or decide.
- Choose the type by meaning, not colour; never make DANGER temporary.
- For toasts, add one empty element to the page (the toast area) and pass it as the container of every toast; give each toast a unique id.
- Application buttons follow the shared actions contract (guidelines §10.2): pass `actions` (`{ key, label, icon?, iconOnly?, hierarchy?, disabled? }`) and handle `onAction(key)`; never create Buttons yourself inside the component.
- For confirmations, use MODAL with two actions (the confirming one first, then Cancel with key `cancel` or `cancel:true`) and act in `onAction(key)`; Escape reports `onClose('ESCAPE')`, which means "cancel". In DANGER confirmations Cancel has the focus when the modal opens, so pressing Enter by mistake does not confirm.
- Update a visible message with `update()` instead of rendering a new one.
- Call `destroy()` when the message is no longer needed.

### Safety

- All texts are displayed as text; do not pass HTML. Build link addresses from trusted routes only.
- Do not use temporary messages for information the user must keep (errors, codes, instructions).
