- Keep modal messages rare; never open several at once.

### Example prompts

```text
Show a success toast "Order sent" for 5 seconds with an Undo action, in the top-right corner.
```

```text
Before deleting the selected orders, ask with a danger modal "Delete 12 orders?" with Delete and Cancel, and delete only on Delete.
```

## For developers

### Business analysis

> **Component**: the Message itself. **Consumer**: the developer who configures the Message in the application's code. **App**: the running application that uses the Message; it provides the data, performs the actions and stores the changes.

**Type and layout**

- Consumer chooses the type: information, success, warning, danger or custom. <!-- BA-01 -->
  - Component displays the colour and the icon of the type. <!-- BA-02 -->
- Consumer chooses the layout: inline, block, banner, toast or modal. <!-- BA-03 -->
  - Component displays a toast in a corner of the screen and stacks several toasts. <!-- BA-04 -->
  - Component displays a modal window in the middle of the screen and blocks the page behind it. <!-- BA-05 -->

**Content**

- Consumer provides the text, and a title, a link, a list of details and action buttons (optional). <!-- BA-06 -->
- User clicks an action button. <!-- BA-07 -->
  - Component reports the action to the App. <!-- BA-08 -->
  - App performs the action. <!-- BA-09 -->
  - Component closes a modal message. <!-- BA-10 -->
- User presses Escape in a modal message. <!-- BA-11 -->
  - Component closes it and reports the cancel to the App. <!-- BA-12 -->
- Component selects "Cancel" first in a dangerous confirmation, so an accidental Enter never confirms. <!-- BA-13 -->

**Visibility**

- Consumer chooses permanent, closable, temporary, or closable and temporary. <!-- BA-14 -->
- User clicks the close button of a closable message. <!-- BA-15 -->
  - Component hides the message and reports the close to the App. <!-- BA-16 -->
- Component hides a temporary message after the set time. <!-- BA-17 -->
  - Component keeps it visible while the mouse is over it or it has the keyboard focus. <!-- BA-18 -->
  - Component displays the time left as a bar, a text ("Closes in 4 s"), or both (optional). <!-- BA-19 -->
- Component keeps a danger message visible until the user or the App closes it. <!-- BA-20 -->

**Screen readers**

- Component announces information and success messages politely, and warnings and danger messages at once. <!-- BA-21 -->
- Component exposes messages that are already on the page when it opens, without announcing them. <!-- BA-22 -->

**Changes**

- App changes the type and the text of a message. <!-- BA-23 -->
  - Component displays the change in place and announces it when the message is visible. <!-- BA-24 -->

**Tooltips**

- Consumer chooses how the close button and icon-only actions show their names on hover and keyboard focus: the browser's tooltip, a Tooltip or none (optional). <!-- BA-25 -->

### Contracts

**Contracts:** Styling: three parts (Styling contract) · Form field: no · Actions: yes (`actions`, `onAction`; adds `cancel`) · Shared behaviour: yes, additions under Accessibility

### Public API

```js
import { renderMessage, DEFAULT_MESSAGE_CONFIG, MESSAGE_TOOLTIP_MODES, MESSAGE_TYPES, MESSAGE_LAYOUTS, MESSAGE_CORNERS } from './messageIndex.js';

const message = renderMessage(container, config); // null after a developer error
```

`container` is a dedicated, consumer-owned element; rendering replaces its content and `destroy()` clears it. **Exception — TOAST:** `container` is the shared toast area provided once by the application; each toast is added to a corner region inside it (nothing is replaced) and `destroy()` removes only that toast (and the region when empty).

| Member | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | The configured id. |
| `show()` | — | Shows the message (again): announced, timer restarted; a MODAL opens. |
| `hide()` | — | Hides the message (not reported through `onClose`). |
| `isVisible()` | boolean | Whether the message is visible. |
| `focus()` | boolean | Moves focus to the message (e.g. an error summary after a failed submit). |
| `setActionDisabled(key, disabled)` | boolean | Enables or disables an action Button; `false` (with `UNKNOWN_ACTION`) for an unknown key. |
| `update(changes)` | — | Changes `type`, `title`, `text`, `details`, `link` or `icon` in place; announced when visible. |
| `destroy()` | — | Removes timers, listeners and Buttons; removes the message. |

### Configuration

| Parameter | Type | Default | Allowed values / format | Applies when | Usage / description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | — | Starts with a letter; letters, digits, `_ : . -`; unique in the document | Always | Required. |
| `type` | string | `'INFO'` | `INFO`, `SUCCESS`, `WARNING`, `DANGER`, `CUSTOM` | Always | Meaning, colour and default icon. |
| `layout` | string | `'BLOCK'` | `INLINE`, `BLOCK`, `BANNER`, `TOAST`, `MODAL` | Always | How the message is shown. |
| `title` | string | `''` | Text | Always | Optional title (names the MODAL). |
| `text` | string | — | Text | Always | Required. |
| `details` | array | `[]` | Strings, or `{ label, href?, onClick? }` | Not `INLINE` | Short list under the text; entries with `href` or `onClick` are links (e.g. to form fields in an error summary). `onClick(event, instance)`; without `href` the link does not navigate. |
| `link` | object | `null` | `{ href, label }` | Always | Link after the text. |
| `actions` | array | `[]` | `{ key, label, icon?, iconOnly?, hierarchy?, disabled?, cancel? }` | Not `INLINE` | Application buttons (guidelines §10.2; `onAction`); MODAL without actions gets "OK". Default hierarchy: first MODAL action primary, others secondary. `iconOnly` shows only the icon (the label is its name). Message's own extension: `cancel:true` marks the safe choice (also assumed for key `cancel`). Without `onAction` the Buttons are disabled (`ACTION_HANDLER_MISSING`), except in a MODAL, where pressing closes it. |
| `defaultAction` | string | `''` | An action `key` | `MODAL` | Action focused when the modal opens. Default: for `DANGER` the cancel action (`cancel:true`, or key `cancel`; otherwise the last action), for other types the first button. |
| `closable` | boolean | `false` | — | Not `MODAL` | Close Button (×); reported as `onClose('USER')`. |
| `bordered` | boolean | `false` | — | `BLOCK`, `TOAST`, `MODAL` | `true`: a thin border around the box as well; `false`: only the thicker coloured start edge. |
| `cornerRadius` | string | `'ROUNDED'` | `NONE`, `ROUNDED` | `BLOCK`, `TOAST`, `MODAL` | `ROUNDED`: corners with the `--radius-control` token; `NONE`: square corners. |
| `duration` | number | `0` | Milliseconds (0 = permanent) | Not `MODAL`, not `DANGER` | Temporary: hides after this time, paused while hovered or focused; reported as `onClose('TIMEOUT')`. |
| `remainingIndicator` | string | `'NONE'` | `NONE`, `BAR`, `TEXT`, `BAR_AND_TEXT` | `duration`, not `INLINE` | Shows the remaining time: a bar that shrinks, a text (`texts.remaining`, `texts.paused` while paused), or both. Screen readers hear `texts.closesIn` once, with the message. |
| `visible` | boolean | `true` | — | Always | Initial visibility (`show()` later). |
| `corner` | string | `'TOP_LEFT'` | `TOP_LEFT`, `TOP_RIGHT`, `BOTTOM_LEFT`, `BOTTOM_RIGHT` | `TOAST` | Corner of the toast region. |
| `icon` | string | per type | Font Awesome classes | Always | Replaces the type icon. |
| `backgroundToken` / `colorToken` / `borderToken` | string | INFO colours | Design-token names | `CUSTOM` | Custom colours. |
| `tooltipMode` | string | `'NONE'` | `NONE`, `TITLE`, `TOOLTIP` | Always | How the close button and icon-only actions show their names on hover and keyboard focus: not at all, the browser's tooltip (`title`, mouse only) or a Tooltip (also on keyboard focus; needs `tooltip.css`, the Tooltip module is loaded only then). |
| `texts.close` / `texts.ok` | string | `'Close message'` / `'OK'` | Text | Always | Close Button name; default MODAL action. |
| `texts.remaining` / `texts.paused` / `texts.closesIn` | string | `'Closes in {seconds} s'` / `'Paused'` / `'Closes by itself in {seconds} seconds.'` | Text; `{seconds}` is replaced | `remainingIndicator` | Visible remaining time; shown while paused; sentence for screen readers. |
| `onClose` | function | `null` | `(reason, instance) => {}` | Always | `USER`, `TIMEOUT`, `ESCAPE` (MODAL: means cancel) or `ACTION` (MODAL closed by an action). |
| `onAction` | function | `null` | `(key, instance) => {}` | `actions` | An action Button was pressed (a MODAL then closes). |

### Callbacks

| Callback | Arguments | Fires when | Does not fire when |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `onClose` | `(reason, instance)` | The user closes it, the time runs out, Escape closes a MODAL, or a MODAL action closes it. | `hide()` or `destroy()` by code. |
| `onAction` | `(key, instance)` | An action Button is pressed. | — |

### Errors

Message has no user errors of its own. Developer errors prevent rendering; warnings are logged and rendering continues. Console format: `Message "id" [LABEL]: message`.

| Label | Severity | Cause |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CONTAINER_REQUIRED` | error | No container (for TOAST: no toast area). |
| `ID_REQUIRED` | error | `id` is empty. |
| `UNSAFE_ID` | error | `id` is not DOM-safe. |
| `DUPLICATE_ID` | error | An element with the same id already exists in the document. |
| `TEXT_REQUIRED` | error | `text` is empty. |
| `TEMPORARY_DANGER` | warning | `duration` with `DANGER`; ignored. |
| `INVALID_TOKEN` | warning | A custom colour that is not a design-token name. |
| `INVALID_ACTION` | warning | An action without key or label; dropped. |
| `DUPLICATE_ACTION_KEY` | warning | A duplicate action key; the later action is dropped. |
| `UNKNOWN_ACTION` | warning | `setActionDisabled()` names no action. |
| `ACTION_HANDLER_MISSING` | warning | Actions without `onAction`; their Buttons are rendered disabled. |
| `INVALID_ICON_CLASS` | warning | An action icon with invalid class tokens; they are dropped. |
| `INVALID_OPTION` | warning | Invalid type, layout, corner, cornerRadius, remainingIndicator or duration; the default is used. |
| `OPTION_IGNORED` | warning | Option that does not apply (e.g. `closable`/`duration` with MODAL, `corner` without TOAST, `bordered`/`cornerRadius` with INLINE or BANNER, `remainingIndicator` without `duration` or with INLINE, colours without CUSTOM, details/actions with INLINE). |

### Accessibility

- New messages (shown with `show()`, updated while visible, and every toast) are live regions: `role="status"` (polite) for INFO, SUCCESS and CUSTOM, `role="alert"` (immediate) for WARNING and DANGER. Messages visible when the page is rendered are not announced; they are read in place.
- The type is conveyed by icon and wording as well as colour.
- Temporary messages pause while hovered or focused, so they can be read and their buttons used (WCAG timing).
- Remaining time (`remainingIndicator`): the bar and the changing text are hidden from assistive technology (they would be read every second); instead the message includes one visually hidden sentence, `texts.closesIn` ("Closes by itself in 6 seconds."), read with it. With reduced motion the bar moves in whole seconds.
- MODAL uses the native `<dialog>`: focus moves into it (to Cancel in DANGER confirmations, to `defaultAction` when given, otherwise to the first button) and stays there, the page behind is inert, focus returns afterwards; it is named by its title and described by its text; Escape closes it (reported as `ESCAPE`, i.e. cancel); a click outside does not close it.
- Close and action controls are Buttons with names ("Close message").

### Examples

Toast area (once per page) and a temporary success toast with Undo:

```js
// <div id="toast-area"></div> somewhere in the page
renderMessage(document.querySelector('#toast-area'),{ id:`toast-${Date.now()}`, type:'SUCCESS', layout:'TOAST', corner:'TOP_RIGHT',
    text:'Order ORD-1042 sent.', duration:5000, closable:true, actions:[ { key:'undo', label:'Undo' } ] },
);
```

Confirmation before a dangerous action:

```js
renderMessage(dialogHost,{ id:'confirm-delete', type:'DANGER', layout:'MODAL', title:'Delete 12 orders?', text:'This cannot be undone.',
    actions:[ { key:'delete', label:'Delete 12 orders' }, { key:'cancel', label:'Cancel' } ],   // Cancel is focused (DANGER)
    onAction:( key ) => { if ( key === 'delete' ) { deleteOrders(selection); } } });
```

Announcement in AppHeader:

```js
renderAppHeader(headerHost,{ id:'app-header', appName:'Orders',
    announcement:{ type:'WARNING', text:'Planned maintenance tonight 22:00–23:00.', link:{ href:'/status', label:'Details' }, onClose:() => rememberClosed('maintenance-0930') } });
```

### Files

| File | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `messageIndex.js` | Public entry point; the only import surface. |
| `messageConfig.js` | Defaults, allowed values, normalization, developer validation. |
| `messageComponent.js` | Rendering per layout, toast regions, show/hide, timer, announcements, modal, Buttons. |
| `messageHTML.js` | Message and body markup. |
| `messageEvents.js` | Timer pause and modal Escape listeners. |
| `messageErrors.js` | Developer error and warning catalog. |
| `message.css` | Presentation. |
| `messageTESTS.md` | Test plan: the cases that prove this README (automatic ones in `tests/components/message.test.mjs`). |


<!-- ===== source/components-js/notification/notificationREADME.md ===== -->

# Notification

## For business

### Overview

Notification is a small round element — an icon, a picture or a short text — with an optional marker in one corner that draws attention: a number ("3 new messages"), a coloured dot ("online", "something new") or a short word ("NEW"). It can be a button (e.g. the bell that opens notifications) or just a display (e.g. a person's photo with an "online" dot).

### When to use

- Use it for an icon, a picture or initials with a marker that draws attention: the bell with "3", a photo with an "online" dot.
- Use Badge when a name or role goes next to the picture.
- Use Chip for labels and statuses inside text.

### Key features

- An icon, a picture or short text, as a circle (or a pill for longer text).
- An optional corner marker: a count ("99+" above 99), a dot in four shapes, or a short text.
- Marker colours for information, success, warning, danger, or the product's own.
- Clickable, like a small icon button, or display only.
- Count and marker updated in place.

### Dependencies

| Dependency | Needed when | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Design system (`design-system.css`) | Always | Colours, sizes and typography. |
| Notification styles (`notification.css`) | Always | Shapes, sizes, marker. |
| Font Awesome icon library | Icon content | Icons. Loaded by the application page. |
| Tooltip component and `tooltip.css` | `tooltipMode` `TOOLTIP` | Tooltips (the Tooltip module is loaded only then). |

### Not included

The application decides what the marker shows (e.g. the number of unread notifications, a person's presence) and what happens on click (e.g. opening a notifications panel). Inline labels, statuses and tags are BadgeChip's job. AppHeader's bell and user avatar will switch to Notification in a later update.

## For designers

### Structure

```text
button#{id}.ui-notification.ui-notification-content-{icon|image|text}.ui-notification-size-{small|medium|large}.{ui-notification-circle|ui-notification-pill-main}[.ui-notification-bordered]
  aria-label="{label}[, {marker meaning}]"                       (display only: span[role="img"])
├── span.ui-notification-shape                                   (the visible shape: background, border, corners, focus ring)
│   └── span.ui-notification-icon > i  |  img.ui-notification-image  |  span.ui-notification-text   (aria-hidden)
└── span.ui-notification-indicator.ui-notification-indicator-{count|dot|text}.ui-notification-type-{…}.ui-notification-corner-{…}
      [.ui-notification-pill]  [.ui-notification-shape-{circle|triangle|square|diamond}]            (aria-hidden)
```

Clickable notifications look like tertiary icon buttons: transparent, accent-coloured icon, hover background, focus outline, reduced opacity when disabled. Text content sits on the selected (soft accent) background. Per-instance colours (`colorToken`, `backgroundToken`) replace these for icon and text content; on hover they darken slightly. The marker overlaps its corner by a third of its size and has a ring in the surface colour so it stays distinct from the content. A pill marker at a right corner starts where a round marker starts and grows outwards: the notification is wider by the pill's extra length (a round marker or dot changes nothing). At a left corner a pill starts at the corner and grows over the shape.

### Visual options

| Option | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Main content | Icon, image, text | `ui-notification-content-icon`, `-image`, `-text` |
| Main shape | Circle, pill (text longer than 3 characters) | `ui-notification-circle`, `ui-notification-pill-main` |
| Size | Small, medium, large | `ui-notification-size-small`, `-medium`, `-large` |
| Border | Without, with | —, `ui-notification-bordered` |
| Main colours | Default, per instance | —, `--ui-notification-color` / `--ui-notification-bg` (from `colorToken` / `backgroundToken`) |
| Marker kind | Count, dot, text | `ui-notification-indicator-count`, `-dot`, `-text` |
| Marker shape (text) | Circle, pill | —, `ui-notification-pill` |
| Marker shape (dot) | Circle, triangle, square, diamond | `ui-notification-shape-circle`, `-triangle`, `-square`, `-diamond` |
| Marker colour | Info, success, warning, danger, custom | `ui-notification-type-*` (custom: `--ui-notification-indicator-bg/-color`) |
| Corner | Top-right, top-left, bottom-right, bottom-left | `ui-notification-corner-top-right`, … |

### States

No states of its own.

### Styling contract

`notification.css` has three parts, marked in the stylesheet. Restyle by writing the same selector with a new value in your own stylesheet, inside `@layer overrides` (preferred: library updates keep your changes), or by changing a value in your copy of the stylesheet. After each token come the parts it styles, named by their class without `ui-notification-` (as in Structure), with the option or state in brackets (joined by “+” when they apply together). Text uses the typography roles of `design-system.css`; border sides are physical (top, right, bottom, left).

**1. Appearance — change freely** (colours, type, borders, corners, motion: only the look changes)

- Colours
  - `--c-accent`: shape (also hover)
  - `--c-border`: shape (bordered)
  - `--c-selected`: shape (content text)
  - `--c-text`: shape (content text, hover), type warning
  - `--c-surface-hover`: shape (hover)
  - `--c-danger`: indicator, type danger
  - `--c-on-accent`: indicator
  - `--c-surface`: indicator
  - `--c-info`: type info
  - `--c-success`: type success
  - `--c-warning`: type warning
- Typography
  - `--font-ui`: notification
  - `--fw-ui`: notification
  - `--fs-label`: text
  - `--fw-ui-strong`: text, indicator
  - `--fs-caption`: text (size small)
- Borders and corners
  - `--border-thin`: shape (also diamond)
  - `--radius-pill`: shape (pill main)
  - `--tag-radius`: indicator
  - `--border-thick`: indicator
- States and motion
  - `--transition-1`: shape
  - `--opacity-disabled`: notification (disabled)

**2. Dimensions — change with care** (sizes and spacing: the component keeps working, its size changes)

- Spacing
  - `--gap-inline-items`: notification (size small, size large), shape (pill main)
  - `--space-sm-1`: shape (content image + bordered)
- Sizes
  - `--control-height`: notification (also size small, size large)
  - `--icon-size-medium`: notification
  - `--icon-size-small`: notification (size small)
  - `--icon-size-large`: notification (size large)

**3. Structure — don't change** (layout, behaviour, states, accessibility)

- Borders and corners
  - `--border-thin`: corner top right, corner top left, corner bottom right, corner bottom left, pill (corner top right, corner bottom right)
- States and motion
  - `--focus-outline`: shape (focus)
  - `--focus-offset`: shape (focus)
- Sizes
  - `--ui-notification-size` (defined in this stylesheet): notification, shape (also circle)
  - `--ui-notification-indicator-size` (defined in this stylesheet): indicator (also dot), pill (also corner top right, corner bottom right), corner top right, corner top left, corner bottom right, corner bottom left, shape (triangle)

**Set by the component — don't change**

- Variables
  - `--ui-notification-bg`, `--ui-notification-color`: main colours (from `backgroundToken`, `colorToken`)
  - `--ui-notification-indicator-bg`, `--ui-notification-indicator-color`: marker colours (from the marker's `backgroundToken`, `colorToken`)

## For AI-assisted development

### Instructions

- Read this README before writing code. Import only from `notificationIndex.js`.
- Always give a `label` naming the thing, not the marker ("Notifications", "Ana Pop"); the marker's meaning is added automatically ("3 new") or from `indicator.description` ("Online").
- Use `clickable:false` for pure displays (e.g. an avatar in a list); use the default clickable version when it opens something.
- Use counts for quantities, dots for states (always with a `description`), short text for labels such as "NEW".
- Update the marker with `setCount()` or `setIndicator()` instead of rendering again.
- Give each notification a unique, DOM-safe `id` and call `destroy()` before rendering into the same container again.

### Safety

- Texts are displayed as text; do not pass HTML. Use image addresses from trusted sources.
- Do not rely on colour or shape alone: give dots a `description`.
- With `colorToken`/`backgroundToken`, choose a pair with enough contrast (at least 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for icons).

### Example prompts

```text
Add a bell Notification to the header with the number of unread notifications (danger count, 99+ above 99) that opens the notifications panel on click.
```

```text
Show each team member as a display-only Notification with their photo (or initials) and a green circle dot "Online" or a grey square "Away" at the bottom-right.
```

## For developers

### Business analysis

> **Component**: the Notification itself. **Consumer**: the developer who configures the Notification in the application's code. **App**: the running application that uses the Notification; it provides the data, performs the actions and stores the changes.

**Content**

- Consumer provides an icon, a picture or a short text, e.g. initials. <!-- BA-01 -->
  - Component displays an icon or a picture as a circle. <!-- BA-02 -->
  - Component displays text up to three characters as a circle, and longer text as a pill. <!-- BA-03 -->
- Consumer chooses one of three sizes. <!-- BA-04 -->
  - Component adapts the marker to the size. <!-- BA-05 -->
- Consumer enables a thin border around the shape (optional). <!-- BA-06 -->
- Consumer chooses own colours for the icon and the text, e.g. white initials on the brand colour (optional). <!-- BA-07 -->

**Marker** (optional)

- Consumer chooses a count, a dot or a short text. <!-- BA-08 -->
  - Component displays a count of one digit as a circle and longer counts as a pill. <!-- BA-09 -->
  - Component displays "99+" for counts above 99, and hides the marker at 0. <!-- BA-10 -->
  - Component displays a dot as a circle, a triangle, a square or a diamond. <!-- BA-11 -->
- Consumer chooses the marker colour: information, success, warning, danger or own colours. <!-- BA-12 -->
- Component displays the marker in the top-right corner, or in another corner chosen by the Consumer. <!-- BA-13 -->
  - Component displays a long marker at a right corner outside the shape, so the notification becomes wider. <!-- BA-14 -->

**Interaction**

- Consumer chooses clickable or display only. <!-- BA-15 -->
- User clicks a clickable notification. <!-- BA-16 -->
  - Component reports the click to the App. <!-- BA-17 -->
  - App performs the action, e.g. opens a notifications panel. <!-- BA-18 -->

**Changes**

- App changes the count or the marker. <!-- BA-19 -->
  - Component displays the change in place. <!-- BA-20 -->

**Screen readers**

- Component announces the name together with the meaning of the marker, e.g. "Notifications, 3 new". <!-- BA-21 -->

**Tooltips**

- Consumer chooses how the label of a clickable notification shows on hover and keyboard focus: the browser's tooltip, a Tooltip or none (optional, on by default with the browser). <!-- BA-22 -->

### Contracts

**Contracts:** Styling: three parts (Styling contract) · Form field: no · Actions: no · Shared behaviour: yes, additions under Accessibility

### Public API

```js
import { renderNotification, DEFAULT_NOTIFICATION_CONFIG, NOTIFICATION_TOOLTIP_MODES, NOTIFICATION_SIZES, NOTIFICATION_INDICATOR_KINDS, NOTIFICATION_SHAPES, NOTIFICATION_TYPES, NOTIFICATION_CORNERS } from './notificationIndex.js';

const notification = renderNotification(container, config, onClick); // null after a developer error
```

| Member | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | The configured id. |
| `getElement()` | Element | The button (clickable) or span (display only). |
| `setIndicator(changes)` | — | Changes the marker (partial object, merged with the current one) or removes it (`null`). |
| `setCount(count)` | — | Sets a count marker (0 hides it). A count marker keeps its settings; a dot or text marker is replaced by a new count (only its corner stays). |
| `getIndicator()` | object \| null | Copy of the current marker. |
| `getIndicatorSpeech()` | string | The marker's spoken meaning ("3 new", "Online") or `''`; for components that show a Notification inside their own accessible name (e.g. Badge). |
| `setDisabled(disabled)` | — | Enables or disables a clickable notification. |
| `destroy()` | — | Removes listeners, clears the container. |

### Configuration

| Parameter | Type | Default | Allowed values / format | Applies when | Usage / description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | — | Starts with a letter; letters, digits, `_ : . -`; unique in the document | Always | Required. |
| `label` | string | — | Text | Always | Required accessible name (also the tooltip of clickable ones). |
| `icon` / `image` / `text` | string | — | Font Awesome classes / image URL / text (≤ 12 characters) | Always | Main content, one of the three is required (priority image, icon, text; `CONTENT_CONFLICT`). Text of 1–3 characters is a circle, longer a pill. |
| `size` | string | `'MEDIUM'` | `SMALL`, `MEDIUM`, `LARGE` | Always | Same sizes as icon Buttons; the marker scales. |
| `clickable` | boolean | `true` | — | Always | Native button (tertiary look) or display only (`role="img"`). |
| `disabled` | boolean | `false` | — | `clickable` | Disables the button. |
| `border` | boolean | `false` | — | Always | Thin border (border colour) around the main shape; same size with or without. |
| `colorToken` | string | — | Design-token name (e.g. `'--c-on-accent'`) | `icon`, `text` | Colour of the icon or text; default accent (icon) or text colour (text). |
| `backgroundToken` | string | — | Design-token name (e.g. `'--c-accent'`) | `icon`, `text` | Background of the main shape; default transparent (icon) or selected (text). |
| `indicator` | object | `null` | See Indicator | Always | Corner marker. |
| `tooltipMode` | string | `'TITLE'` | `NONE`, `TITLE`, `TOOLTIP` | Always | How the label of a clickable notification shows on hover and keyboard focus: not at all, the browser's tooltip (`title`, mouse only) or a Tooltip (also on keyboard focus; needs `tooltip.css`, the Tooltip module is loaded only then). |
| `texts.count` | string | `'{count} new'` | Text with `{count}` | `indicator` | Spoken meaning of counts. |
| `onClick` | function | `null` | `(event, instance) => {}` | `clickable` | Takes precedence over the third argument. |

### Indicator

| Field | Default | Allowed values | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `'COUNT'` | `COUNT`, `DOT`, `TEXT` | What the marker shows. |
| `value` | `0` / `''` | Number (COUNT) or short text (TEXT) | Hidden for 0 or empty text; DOT has no value. |
| `max` | `99` | Integer ≥ 1 | Counts above it show "{max}+". |
| `shape` | `'CIRCLE'` | `CIRCLE`, `TRIANGLE`, `SQUARE`, `DIAMOND` | DOT only; text markers are circles (one character) or pills. |
| `type` | `'DANGER'` | `INFO`, `SUCCESS`, `WARNING`, `DANGER`, `CUSTOM` | Colour, same types as Chip and Message. |
| `backgroundToken` / `colorToken` | — | Design-token names | CUSTOM colours. |
| `corner` | `'TOP_RIGHT'` | `TOP_RIGHT`, `TOP_LEFT`, `BOTTOM_RIGHT`, `BOTTOM_LEFT` | Position (logical: mirrored in right-to-left). |
| `description` | — | Text | Spoken meaning; required in practice for dots ("Online"); for counts it replaces `texts.count`. |

### Callbacks

| Callback | Arguments | Fires when | Does not fire when |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `onClick` | `(event, instance)` | A clickable notification is activated (click, Enter, Space). | Display-only or disabled notifications. |

### Errors

Notification has no user errors of its own. Developer errors prevent rendering; warnings are logged and rendering continues. Console format: `Notification "id" [LABEL]: message`.

| Label | Severity | Cause |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CONTAINER_REQUIRED` | error | No container passed. |
| `ID_REQUIRED` | error | `id` is empty. |
| `UNSAFE_ID` | error | `id` is not DOM-safe. |
| `DUPLICATE_ID` | error | An element with the same id already exists in the document. |
| `LABEL_REQUIRED` | error | `label` is empty. |
| `CONTENT_REQUIRED` | error | No icon, image or text. |
| `CONTENT_CONFLICT` | warning | Several main contents; one is used. |
| `TEXT_TOO_LONG` | warning | Main text longer than 12 characters. |
| `INVALID_TOKEN` | warning | A colour (`colorToken`, `backgroundToken`, indicator tokens) that is not a design-token name; the default is used. |
| `INVALID_OPTION` | warning | Invalid size, kind, shape, type or corner; the default is used. |
| `OPTION_IGNORED` | warning | `disabled` without `clickable`; `shape` for COUNT or TEXT markers; `colorToken`/`backgroundToken` with image content. |

### Accessibility

- Clickable: a native `<button>` named by `aria-label` = label plus the marker's meaning ("Notifications, 3 new"); keyboard and focus outline as any button; the label is also the tooltip.
- Display only: `role="img"` with the same accessible name.
- The main content and the marker are hidden from assistive technology (`aria-hidden`); their meaning is in the name.
- Marker changes update the name; they are not announced by themselves (announce important changes with Message if needed).
- Colour and shape are never the only information: give dots a `description`.

### Examples

```js
const bell = renderNotification(bellHost,{ id:'bell', label:'Notifications', icon:'fa-solid fa-bell', indicator:{ kind:'COUNT', value:unread } },() => openNotificationsPanel());
bell.setCount(unread + 1);

renderNotification(avatarHost,{ id:`user-${user.id}`, label:user.name, image:user.photo, clickable:false, size:'LARGE',
    indicator:{ kind:'DOT', shape:'CIRCLE', type:'SUCCESS', corner:'BOTTOM_RIGHT', description:'Online' } });
```

### Files

| File | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `notificationIndex.js` | Public entry point; the only import surface. |
| `notificationConfig.js` | Defaults, content and indicator normalization, developer validation. |
| `notificationComponent.js` | Rendering, accessible name, indicator updates, click. |
| `notificationHTML.js` | Element and indicator markup, count text, spoken meaning. |
| `notificationEvents.js` | Click listener. |
| `notificationErrors.js` | Developer error and warning catalog. |
| `notification.css` | Presentation. |
| `notificationTESTS.md` | Test plan: the cases that prove this README (automatic ones in `tests/components/notification.test.mjs`). |


<!-- ===== source/components-js/notificationsPanel/notificationsPanelREADME.md ===== -->

# NotificationsPanel

## For business

### Overview

NotificationsPanel is the bell that tells users something new happened — and, when they click it, shows the latest notifications in a small panel: "Order ORD-1042 was paid", "Ana approved your invoice". Users open a notification to go to its item, mark everything as read, or go to the full list. It is usually placed in the application header (AppHeader), but can be used anywhere.

### When to use

- Use it in the application header to tell users that something new happened and to show the latest notifications.
- Use Notification for a bell or icon with a counter that opens something else, and Message for feedback about the user's own actions.

### Key features

- A bell with the number of unread notifications ("99+" above 99).
- A panel with the latest notifications: icon, text, time, unread ones highlighted.
- Opening a notification marks it as read and leads to its item.
- "Mark all as read" and an optional "See all notifications" link.
- New notifications added while the page is open.

### Dependencies

| Dependency | Needed when | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Design system (`design-system.css`) | Always | Colours, spacing and typography. |
| NotificationsPanel styles (`notificationsPanel.css`) | Always | Panel and list. |
| Notification and `notification.css` | Always | The bell with the count. |
| Button and `button.css` | Always | "Mark all as read". |
| Font Awesome icon library | Always | Bell and notification icons. Loaded by the application page. |
| Tooltip component and `tooltip.css` | `tooltipMode` `TOOLTIP` | Tooltips (the Tooltip module is loaded only then). |

### Not included

The application loads the notifications (e.g. from its server), decides what "read" means and saves it, navigates when one is opened, and provides the full notifications page. Grouping ("Today", "Earlier") is not part of the component: the application decides the order.

## For designers

### Structure

```text
div#{id}.ui-notifications-panel
├── span.ui-notifications-panel-bell-host → Notification (bell, unread count)  aria-haspopup="dialog", aria-expanded
└── div#{id}-panel.ui-notifications-panel-popup  role="dialog"  [hidden]
    ├── div.ui-notifications-panel-header: h2.ui-notifications-panel-title + Button "Mark all as read"
    ├── ul.ui-notifications-panel-list
    │   ├── li > a.ui-notifications-panel-item[.ui-notifications-panel-unread]  (icon, text, time, hidden ", unread")
    │   └── li.ui-notifications-panel-empty                                       (no notifications)
    └── div.ui-notifications-panel-footer > a.ui-notifications-panel-see-all       (seeAllHref / onSeeAll)
```

The panel opens below the bell, aligned to its end, as a card with a shadow. When it would not fit in the window, it is aligned to the bell's start instead, opens above the bell when there is no room below, and as a last resort is kept inside the window (with a shorter, scrolling list). Unread notifications have the selected background, bold text and a small accent dot; times are small and muted; icons sit in a soft circle.

### Visual options

| Option | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Footer | With or without "See all" | `.ui-notifications-panel-footer` |

### States

| State | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Notification | Read, unread | `.ui-notifications-panel-item`, `.ui-notifications-panel-unread` |
| List | Notifications, empty | `li > a`, `.ui-notifications-panel-empty` |

### Styling contract

`notificationsPanel.css` has three parts, marked in the stylesheet. Restyle by writing the same selector with a new value in your own stylesheet, inside `@layer overrides` (preferred: library updates keep your changes), or by changing a value in your copy of the stylesheet. After each token come the parts it styles, named by their class without `ui-notifications-panel-` (as in Structure), with the option or state in brackets (joined by “+” when they apply together). Text uses the typography roles of `design-system.css`; border sides are physical (top, right, bottom, left).

**1. Appearance — change freely** (colours, type, borders, corners, motion: only the look changes)

- Colours
  - `--c-border`: popup, header, footer
  - `--c-surface`: popup
  - `--c-text`: popup
  - `--c-surface-hover`: item (hover)
  - `--c-selected`: unread
  - `--c-accent`: unread, icon, see all
  - `--c-surface-muted`: icon
  - `--c-muted`: time, empty
- Typography
  - `--font-ui`: popup, title
  - `--fw-ui`: popup, time
  - `--fs-control`: title
  - `--fw-ui-strong`: title, unread, see all
  - `--lh-body`: title, text
  - `--fs-label`: text, empty, see all
  - `--fs-caption`: time
- Borders and corners
  - `--border-thin`: popup, header, footer
  - `--radius-control`: popup
  - `--radius-control-small`: item, see all
- Shadows
  - `--shadow-md`: popup

**2. Dimensions — change with care** (sizes and spacing: the component keeps working, its size changes)

- Spacing
  - `--gap-tight`: popup, header, list, footer
  - `--gap-inline-items`: header, item, unread
  - `--gap-block`: header, item, empty, footer
  - `--space-sm-2`: unread
- Sizes
  - `--size-md-4`: popup
  - `--space-sm-3`: unread
  - `--size-sm-1`: icon

**3. Structure — don't change** (layout, behaviour, states, accessibility)

- Borders and corners
  - `--border-thick`: item (focus), see all (focus)
- States and motion
  - `--focus-outline`: item (focus), see all (focus)

## For AI-assisted development

### Instructions

- Read this README before writing code. Import only from `notificationsPanelIndex.js`.
- Load the notifications in the application and pass them in the order to show (newest first): `{ id, text, time?, icon?, href?, unread? }`; `time` is display text ("5 minutes ago", e.g. from Calendar's `formatCalendarValue`).
- Save "read" in `onOpen` and `onMarkAllRead`; push new notifications with `addNotification()`.
- In single-page applications call `event.preventDefault()` in `onOpen` and route yourself.
- Inside AppHeader, pass the same configuration (without `id`) as `notifications`.
- Give each panel a unique, DOM-safe `id` and call `destroy()` before rendering into the same container again.

### Safety

- Texts are displayed as text; do not pass HTML. Build links from trusted routes only.
- Only show notifications the user is allowed to see (filter on the server).

### Example prompts

```text
Add a NotificationsPanel to the header with the user's latest 5 notifications from the API, marking a notification as read on the server when it is opened and linking "See all" to /notifications.
```

## For developers

### Business analysis

> **Component**: the NotificationsPanel itself. **Consumer**: the developer who configures the NotificationsPanel in the application's code. **App**: the running application that uses the NotificationsPanel; it provides the data, performs the actions and stores the changes.

**Bell**

- Component displays the number of unread notifications on the bell, "99+" above 99, and nothing when all are read. <!-- BA-01 -->
- User clicks the bell. <!-- BA-02 -->
  - Component opens the panel and moves the focus to the first notification. <!-- BA-03 -->
- User presses Escape, clicks outside the panel, or leaves it with the keyboard. <!-- BA-04 -->
  - Component closes the panel and moves the focus back to the bell. <!-- BA-05 -->

**Panel**

- App provides the notifications in the order to display, usually newest first. <!-- BA-06 -->
- Component displays the latest notifications, 5 by default (the number is chosen by the Consumer), each with an icon, a text and a time, e.g. "5 minutes ago". <!-- BA-07 -->
- Component displays unread notifications highlighted. <!-- BA-08 -->
- Component displays "You have no notifications." when the list is empty. <!-- BA-09 -->

**Reading**

- User clicks a notification. <!-- BA-10 -->
  - Component marks it as read (optional, on by default) and reports it to the App. <!-- BA-11 -->
  - App opens its item. <!-- BA-12 -->
- User clicks "Mark all as read". <!-- BA-13 -->
  - Component marks all notifications as read and reports it to the App. <!-- BA-14 -->
  - App stores the read state. <!-- BA-15 -->
- Consumer provides a link to the full list, "See all notifications" (optional). <!-- BA-16 -->

**New notifications**

- App adds a notification while the page is open. <!-- BA-17 -->
  - Component displays the new count and list. <!-- BA-18 -->

**Tooltips**

- Consumer chooses how the bell's label shows on hover and keyboard focus: the browser's tooltip, a Tooltip or none (optional, on by default with the browser). <!-- BA-19 -->

### Contracts

**Contracts:** Styling: three parts (Styling contract) · Form field: no · Actions: no · Shared behaviour: yes, additions under Accessibility

### Public API

```js
import { renderNotificationsPanel, DEFAULT_NOTIFICATIONS_PANEL_CONFIG, NOTIFICATIONS_PANEL_TOOLTIP_MODES } from './notificationsPanelIndex.js';

const panel = renderNotificationsPanel(container, config); // null after a developer error
```

| Member | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | The configured id. |
| `setNotifications(items)` | — | Replaces the notifications. |
| `addNotification(item)` | — | Adds one at the top (replacing one with the same id). |
| `markRead(id)` / `markAllRead()` | — | Marks as read (no callback). |
| `getUnreadCount()` | number | Unread notifications. |
| `getNotifications()` | array | Copies of the notifications. |
| `open()` / `close()` | — | Opens or closes the panel. |
| `getBell()` | instance | The bell Notification. |
| `destroy()` | — | Removes listeners and child components, clears the container. |

### Configuration

| Parameter | Type | Default | Allowed values / format | Applies when | Usage / description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | — | Starts with a letter; letters, digits, `_ : . -`; unique in the document | Always | Required. |
| `items` | array | `[]` | `{ id, text, time?, icon?, href?, unread? }` | Always | Notifications in display order; ids unique. |
| `maxItems` | number | `5` | Integer ≥ 1 | Always | How many are shown in the panel. |
| `markReadOnOpen` | boolean | `true` | — | Always | Opening a notification marks it as read. |
| `seeAllHref` | string | `''` | URL | Always | "See all notifications" link (also shown with `onSeeAll` only). |
| `bell` | object | `{}` | Notification options (e.g. `colorToken`, `size`) | Always | Look of the bell; `id`, `clickable` and the indicator are set by the panel. |
| `tooltipMode` | string | `'TITLE'` | `NONE`, `TITLE`, `TOOLTIP` | Always | How the bell's label shows on hover and keyboard focus: not at all, the browser's tooltip (`title`, mouse only) or a Tooltip (also on keyboard focus; needs `tooltip.css`, the Tooltip module is loaded only then). Passed to the bell (a Notification) unless `bell.tooltipMode` sets it. |
| `texts.*` | string | English defaults | Text | Always | `label` ("Notifications", bell name), `title`, `unreadCount` ("{count} unread"), `unread`, `markAllRead`, `seeAll`, `empty`. |
| `onOpen` | function | `null` | `(item, event, instance) => {}` | Always | A notification was opened (after marking it read); links navigate unless `event.preventDefault()`. |
| `onMarkAllRead` | function | `null` | `(instance) => {}` | Always | "Mark all as read" was pressed. |
| `onSeeAll` | function | `null` | `(event, instance) => {}` | Always | "See all" was chosen. |
| `onToggle` | function | `null` | `(open, instance) => {}` | Always | The panel opened or closed. |

### Callbacks

| Callback | Arguments | Fires when | Does not fire when |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `onOpen` | `(item, event, instance)` | A notification is chosen. | `markRead()` by code. |
| `onMarkAllRead` | `(instance)` | "Mark all as read" is pressed. | `markAllRead()` by code. |
| `onSeeAll` | `(event, instance)` | "See all" is chosen. | — |
| `onToggle` | `(open, instance)` | The panel opens or closes. | — |

### Errors

NotificationsPanel has no user-facing errors. Developer errors prevent rendering; warnings are logged and rendering continues. Console format: `NotificationsPanel "id" [LABEL]: message`.

| Label | Severity | Cause |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CONTAINER_REQUIRED` | error | No container passed. |
| `ID_REQUIRED` | error | `id` is empty. |
| `UNSAFE_ID` | error | `id` is not DOM-safe. |
| `DUPLICATE_ID` | error | An element with the same id already exists in the document. |
| `INVALID_ITEM` | warning | A notification without id or text; dropped. |
| `DUPLICATE_ITEM_ID` | warning | Duplicate notification id; the later one is dropped. |
| `INVALID_OPTION` | warning | Invalid `maxItems`; the default is used. |

### Accessibility

- The bell is a button named with the unread count ("Notifications, 3 unread"), with `aria-haspopup="dialog"`, `aria-controls` and `aria-expanded`.
- The panel is a non-modal dialog labelled by its title; opening moves focus to the first notification, Escape closes it and returns focus to the bell; leaving it with Tab or clicking outside closes it.
- Notifications are links; unread ones add ", unread" for screen readers (not only colour and bold).

### Examples

```js
const panel = renderNotificationsPanel(bellHost,
{
    id:'inbox', seeAllHref:'/notifications',
    items:( await api.notifications({ limit:5 }) ).map(n => ({ id:n.id, text:n.title, time:formatCalendarValue(n.createdAt,{ type:'DATETIME', displayMode:'RELATIVE' }), href:n.link, unread:!n.read })),
    onOpen:( item ) => api.markRead(item.id),
    onMarkAllRead:() => api.markAllRead()
});
socket.on('notification',n => panel.addNotification({ id:n.id, text:n.title, time:'just now', href:n.link, unread:true }));
```

### Files

| File | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `notificationsPanelIndex.js` | Public entry point; the only import surface. |
| `notificationsPanelConfig.js` | Defaults, notification normalization, developer validation. |
| `notificationsPanelComponent.js` | Bell, panel, read state, focus, reports. |
| `notificationsPanelHTML.js` | Shell and list markup. |
| `notificationsPanelEvents.js` | Item, "See all", Escape, focus and outside-press listeners. |
| `notificationsPanelErrors.js` | Developer error and warning catalog. |
| `notificationsPanel.css` | Presentation. |
| `notificationsPanelTESTS.md` | Test plan: the cases that prove this README (automatic ones in `tests/components/notificationsPanel.test.mjs`). |


<!-- ===== source/components-js/pagination/paginationREADME.md ===== -->

# Pagination

## For business

### Overview

Pagination lets the user move through long lists (orders, customers, search results) page by page. It reports which page the user wants; the application loads that page.

### When to use

- Use it to move through long lists page by page: orders, customers, search results.
- Use Table's built-in pagination for tables; use this component for other lists.
- Use scrolling with "Load more" in the application when pages do not matter to the user.

### Key features

- Page numbers with the first and last page always visible and "…" for skipped pages.
- Previous and next arrows for longer lists.
- An optional "Go to page" field for very long lists.
- Hidden when everything fits on one page.

### Dependencies

| Dependency | Needed when | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Design system (`design-system.css`) | Always | Colours, spacing and typography. |
| Pagination styles (`pagination.css`) | Always | Page buttons, go-to-page field. |
| Button component and `button.css` | Always | Previous and next arrows. |
| Font Awesome icon library | Always | Chevron icons. Loaded by the application page. |
| Tooltip component and `tooltip.css` | `tooltipMode` `TOOLTIP` | Tooltips (the Tooltip module is loaded only then). |

### Not included

The application (e.g. Table) loads the requested page, decides how many items a page shows (an "items per page" choice belongs to it), shows range texts such as "26–50 of 143" if wanted, and announces the new page content.

## For designers

### Structure

```text
nav#{id}.ui-pagination  aria-label="{label}"                      (hidden with 0–1 pages)
├── div.ui-pagination-pages
│   ├── button.ui-pagination-page[.ui-pagination-current]         (aria-current="page" on the current page)
│   └── span.ui-pagination-ellipsis  "…"                          (aria-hidden)
├── div.ui-pagination-arrows → Buttons (tertiary icon, chevrons): previous, next   (hidden below arrowVisibilityThreshold)
└── div.ui-pagination-go-to                                        (showGoToPage; hidden below goToPageThreshold)
    ├── label.ui-pagination-go-to-label "Go to page"
    ├── input.ui-pagination-go-to-input  type="text" inputmode="numeric"
    └── span.ui-pagination-go-to-error                             (hidden when there is no error)
```

Page buttons are round, transparent, with a hover background; the current page has a muted background and bold text; keyboard focus draws the focus outline. The go-to-page input has the pagination's control height and a width of about four digits, with the error border when invalid.

### Visual options

| Option | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Arrows | Shown, hidden | `.ui-pagination-arrows`, `[hidden]` below `arrowVisibilityThreshold` |
| Go to page | Off, shown, hidden | —, `.ui-pagination-go-to`, `[hidden]` below `goToPageThreshold` |

### States

| State | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Current page | — | `.ui-pagination-current`, `aria-current="page"` |
| Invalid go-to page | Shown | `.ui-pagination-go-to-input[aria-invalid="true"]`, visible `.ui-pagination-go-to-error` |

### Styling contract

`pagination.css` has three parts, marked in the stylesheet. Restyle by writing the same selector with a new value in your own stylesheet, inside `@layer overrides` (preferred: library updates keep your changes), or by changing a value in your copy of the stylesheet. After each token come the parts it styles, named by their class without `ui-pagination-` (as in Structure), with the option or state in brackets (joined by “+” when they apply together). Text uses the typography roles of `design-system.css`; border sides are physical (top, right, bottom, left).

**1. Appearance — change freely** (colours, type, borders, corners, motion: only the look changes)

- Colours
  - `--c-text`: page, go to input
  - `--c-surface-hover`: page (hover)
  - `--c-surface-muted`: current
  - `--c-muted`: ellipsis, go to label
  - `--c-border`: go to input
  - `--c-surface`: go to input
  - `--c-accent`: go to input (focus)
  - `--c-danger`: go to input (invalid)
  - `--c-danger-text`: go to error
- Typography
  - `--font-ui`: pagination
  - `--fw-ui`: pagination
  - `--fs-control`: page, ellipsis, go to input
  - `--lh-compact`: page
  - `--fw-ui-strong`: current, go to error
  - `--fs-label`: go to label, go to error
- Borders and corners
  - `--radius-pill`: page
  - `--border-thin`: go to input
- States and motion
  - `--transition-1`: page

**2. Dimensions — change with care** (sizes and spacing: the component keeps working, its size changes)

- Spacing
  - `--gap-inline-items`: pagination, pages, arrows, go to, page, go to input
  - `--padding-panel`: pagination
  - `--gap-form-field`: pagination
- Sizes
  - `--control-height`: page, ellipsis, go to input

**3. Structure — don't change** (layout, behaviour, states, accessibility)

- States and motion
  - `--focus-outline`: page (focus), go to input (focus)
  - `--focus-offset`: page (focus), go to input (focus)

## For AI-assisted development

### Instructions

- Read this README before writing code. Import only from `paginationIndex.js`.
- Render Pagination once; when the user picks a page, load it and call `pagination.update({ currentPage:page })`; when the list changes (filters, new items per page), call `update({ totalItems, itemsPerPage, currentPage })`. Never re-render Pagination for a page change.
- Pagination never changes data: all loading, sorting and filtering stays in the consumer.
- Keep "items per page" in the consumer (e.g. Table) and pass the number to Pagination.
- Give each pagination a distinct `label` when several are on one page (e.g. "Orders pages, top").
- Enable `showGoToPage` for lists that can have many pages.
- Give each pagination a unique, DOM-safe `id` and call `destroy()` before rendering into the same container again.

### Safety

- Never remove `aria-current`, the navigation label or the arrow names.
- Do not rely on Pagination to validate pages for data access; check requested pages on the server as well.

### Example prompts

```text
Add a Pagination below the customers table with 25 items per page, a "Go to page" field for more than 10 pages, and reload the table when the page changes.
```

```text
Show the same pagination above and below a long results list, with the names "Results pages, top" and "Results pages, bottom", keeping both on the same page.
```

## For developers

### Business analysis

> **Component**: the Pagination itself. **Consumer**: the developer who configures the Pagination in the application's code. **App**: the running application that uses the Pagination; it provides the data, performs the actions and stores the changes.

**Pages**

- App provides the number of pages and the current page. <!-- BA-01 -->
- Component displays the first and the last page, a window of pages around the current one, and "…" where pages are skipped, e.g. "1 … 33 34 35 36 37 … 100". <!-- BA-02 -->
- Component displays the current page highlighted and announces it as the current page. <!-- BA-03 -->
- Component hides itself when everything fits on one page. <!-- BA-04 -->
- User clicks a page number. <!-- BA-05 -->
  - Component reports the requested page to the App. <!-- BA-06 -->
  - App provides the page. <!-- BA-07 -->

**Arrows**

- Component displays previous and next arrows once the list has a set number of pages (6 by default). <!-- BA-08 -->
- Component disables the previous arrow on the first page and the next arrow on the last page. <!-- BA-09 -->
- User clicks an arrow. <!-- BA-10 -->
  - Component reports the previous or next page to the App. <!-- BA-11 -->

**Go to page** (optional)

- Component displays a "Go to page" field once the list has a set number of pages. <!-- BA-12 -->
- User types a page number and presses Enter. <!-- BA-13 -->
  - Component reports the page to the App. <!-- BA-14 -->
  - Component displays "Enter a page from 1 to 100." for an impossible number. <!-- BA-15 -->

**Layout**

- Component displays the bar at the end of the line. <!-- BA-16 -->
- Consumer provides a different name for each pagination on a page, e.g. above and below a table. <!-- BA-17 -->

**Tooltips**

- Consumer chooses how the previous and next arrows show their names on hover and keyboard focus: the browser's tooltip, a Tooltip or none (optional). <!-- BA-18 -->

### Contracts

**Contracts:** Styling: three parts (Styling contract) · Form field: no · Actions: no · Shared behaviour: yes, additions under Accessibility

### Public API

```js
import { renderPagination, DEFAULT_PAGINATION_CONFIG, PAGINATION_TOOLTIP_MODES } from './paginationIndex.js';

const pagination = renderPagination(container, config, onPageChange); // null after a developer error
```

`container` is a dedicated, consumer-owned element. Rendering replaces its content; `destroy()` clears it.

| Member | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | The configured id. |
| `getPage()` | number | Current page (1 when there are no pages). |
| `getTotalPages()` | number | Number of pages. |
| `update(numbers)` | — | Applies `{ totalItems, itemsPerPage, currentPage }` (each optional) and redraws; a page beyond the last becomes the last page. |
| `focus()` | boolean | Focuses the current page button (or the first control). |
| `destroy()` | — | Removes listeners and Buttons, clears the container. |

### Configuration

| Parameter | Type | Default | Allowed values / format | Applies when | Usage / description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | — | Starts with a letter; letters, digits, `_ : . -`; unique in the document | Always | Required. Id of the `<nav>`. |
| `label` | string | `texts.navigation` | Text | Always | Accessible name of the navigation landmark; make it distinct when several paginations are on one page. |
| `totalItems` | number | `0` | Integer ≥ 0 | Always | Number of items being paged. |
| `itemsPerPage` | number | `25` | Integer ≥ 1 | Always | Items per page (decided by the consumer). |
| `currentPage` | number | `1` | Integer ≥ 1 | Always | Current page; beyond the last page it becomes the last page (`PAGE_OUT_OF_RANGE`). |
| `visiblePageCount` | number | `5` | Integer ≥ 3 | Always | Pages shown around the current page (first and last are always shown). |
| `arrowVisibilityThreshold` | number | `6` | Integer ≥ 2 | Always | Previous/next arrows appear from this number of pages. |
| `showGoToPage` | boolean | `false` | — | Always | Adds the go-to-page field. |
| `goToPageThreshold` | number | `6` | Integer ≥ 2 | `showGoToPage` | The field appears from this number of pages. |
| `locale` | string | page language | BCP 47 tag, e.g. `'en'`, `'de'`, `'sv'` | Always | Optional. The language whose rules Pagination uses to write the page numbers. When empty, the page language (`<html lang>`), then the browser language. For example: page 1250 is written “1,250” in English (`en`), “1.250” in German (`de`) and “1 250” in Swedish (`sv`). Table passes its own `locale`. |
| `tooltipMode` | string | `'NONE'` | `NONE`, `TITLE`, `TOOLTIP` | Always | How the previous and next arrows show their names on hover and keyboard focus: not at all, the browser's tooltip (`title`, mouse only) or a Tooltip (also on keyboard focus; needs `tooltip.css`, the Tooltip module is loaded only then). |
| `texts.navigation` / `page` / `previous` / `next` / `goToPage` | string | `'Pagination'` / `'Page {page}'` / `'Previous page'` / `'Next page'` / `'Go to page'` | Text (`{page}` in `page`) | Always | Landmark name, page button names, arrow names, go-to label. |
| `texts.errors.INVALID_PAGE` | string | `'Enter a page from 1 to {totalPages}.'` | Text with `{totalPages}` | `showGoToPage` | Go-to-page error. |
| `onPageChange` | function | `null` | `(page, instance) => {}` | Always | Takes precedence over the third `renderPagination()` argument. |

Invalid numbers produce an `INVALID_OPTION` warning and the default (or, in `update()`, the previous value) is used. `goToPageThreshold` without `showGoToPage` is ignored with `OPTION_IGNORED`.

### Callbacks

| Callback | Arguments | Fires when | Does not fire when |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `onPageChange` | `(page, instance)` | The user picks a valid, different page: page button, previous/next, go-to-page with Enter. | The current page is clicked, a disabled arrow, an invalid go-to value, `update()`. |

Pagination does not move to the page by itself: the consumer loads the page and calls `update({ currentPage })`, so the display never shows a page that failed to load.

### Errors

| Label | Default message | Trigger | Visibility |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `INVALID_PAGE` | Enter a page from 1 to {totalPages}. | Enter in the go-to-page field with a non-number or a page outside 1…totalPages. | Corrective (cleared when the input changes or a valid page is entered) |

Developer errors prevent rendering (`renderPagination()` returns `null`); warnings are logged and rendering continues. Console format: `Pagination "id" [LABEL]: message`.

| Label | Severity | Cause |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CONTAINER_REQUIRED` | error | No container passed. |
| `ID_REQUIRED` | error | `id` is empty. |
| `UNSAFE_ID` | error | `id` is not DOM-safe. |
| `DUPLICATE_ID` | error | An element with the same id already exists in the document. |
| `INVALID_OPTION` | warning | Invalid number (the default or previous value is used) or `locale` tag (the page language is used). |
| `OPTION_IGNORED` | warning | `goToPageThreshold` without `showGoToPage`. |
| `PAGE_OUT_OF_RANGE` | warning | A `currentPage` passed by the consumer is beyond the last page; the last page is used. |

### Accessibility

- A `<nav>` landmark with a configurable name; page buttons are native buttons named "Page N", the current one with `aria-current="page"`; "…" is hidden from screen readers.
- Previous/next are Buttons with names ("Previous page", "Next page"), disabled at the ends; icons mirror in right-to-left languages.
- The go-to-page field has a visible label; an invalid value sets `aria-invalid` and links the message through `aria-describedby`.
- Visible focus on every control. Announcing the new page content is the consumer's task.

### Examples

A list reloading on page change, with go-to-page for long lists:

```js
let currentPage = 1;

const pagination = renderPagination(pagesHost,
{
    id:'customer-pages', label:'Customer pages', totalItems:total, itemsPerPage:25, currentPage,
    showGoToPage:true, goToPageThreshold:10
},async ( page, instance ) =>
{
    const rows = await loadCustomers(page);     // the consumer loads the page …
    renderRows(rows);
    currentPage = page;
    instance.update({ currentPage:page });      // … and then moves the pagination
});

// Filters changed: new total, back to page 1.
function onFiltersChanged( newTotal ) { pagination.update({ totalItems:newTotal, currentPage:1 }); }
```

### Files

| File | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `paginationIndex.js` | Public entry point; the only import surface. |
| `paginationConfig.js` | Defaults, normalization, developer validation. |
| `paginationComponent.js` | Lifecycle, page requests, go-to-page, update, arrow Buttons. |
| `paginationHTML.js` | Navigation shell and page list markup. |
| `paginationEvents.js` | Page-button and go-to-page listeners. |
| `paginationState.js` | Per-instance numbers and the page-window calculation. |
| `paginationErrors.js` | Go-to-page error and developer error and warning catalog. |
| `pagination.css` | Presentation. |
| `paginationTESTS.md` | Test plan: the cases that prove this README (automatic ones in `tests/components/pagination.test.mjs`). |


<!-- ===== source/components-js/searchBox/searchBoxREADME.md ===== -->

# SearchBox

## For business

### Overview

SearchBox is the field where a user types what to look for. It looks and behaves the same in every browser and every screen of the product. It collects the query and reports it; the application runs the search and shows the results.

### When to use

- Use it where the user types what to look for: a list, a table, the whole application.
- Use Form in live mode for filters with several fields, and TextInput for values that are not searches.

### Key features

- Search while typing (after a short pause) or on request (Enter or a Search button).
- A minimum number of characters, with a hint below it.
- A clear button and Escape to empty the field.
- An optional search scope, e.g. "All fields", "Name", "Company".
- A busy indicator while the application searches.

### Dependencies

| Dependency | Needed when | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Design system (`design-system.css`) | Always | Colors, spacing, typography, focus and spinner timing. |
| Message component and `message.css` | `setMessage()` | Feedback under the field. |
| SearchBox styles (`searchBox.css`) | Always | Search box appearance. |
| Button component and `button.css` | Always | Clear button and optional Search button. |
| CheckboxRadio and Chip components, `checkboxRadio.css`, `chip.css` | Scopes are used | Scope choice shown as chips. |
| Font Awesome icon library | Always | Magnifier, clear and busy icons. Loaded by the application page. |
| Tooltip component and `tooltip.css` | `tooltipMode` `TOOLTIP` | Tooltips (the Tooltip module is loaded only then). |

### Not included

The application runs the search, cancels outdated requests, shows results, result counts, empty and error states, sorting and pagination, keeps the query in the URL and announces the number of results to screen-reader users. Filters belong to FiltersForm. The application decides the feedback text (e.g. "No results") and shows it under the field with `setMessage()`.

## For designers

### Structure

```text
div#{id}.ui-search-box.ui-search-box-width-{width}[.ui-search-box-busy]  (role="search" when used as the page's search landmark)
├── label.ui-search-box-label[.ui-search-box-visually-hidden]
├── div.ui-search-box-row
│   ├── div.ui-search-box-control
│   │   ├── input#{id}-input.ui-search-box-input  type="search"
│   │   ├── span.ui-search-box-busy-icon > i   (spinner while busy; aria-hidden)
│   │   └── span.ui-search-box-clear-host → Button (icon "×")   (hidden while empty)
│   └── span.ui-search-box-button-host → Button ("Search", optional magnifier) or icon Button (magnifier)   (optional)
├── div.ui-search-box-scopes-host → CheckboxRadio (single choice, chips)   (optional)
└── div#{id}-help.ui-search-box-help           (hint, scope description or minimum-length hint; hidden when empty)
```

The browser's own clear button and search decoration are hidden, so every browser shows the same clear button. The field uses the same tokens as TextInput: accent border while focused, focus outline for keyboard users, muted background when disabled. Clear, Search and scope chips keep the appearance of Button and CheckboxRadio.

### Visual options

| Option | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Label position | Top, left | `ui-search-box-label-top`, `ui-search-box-label-start`, or `INHERIT` inside an element with `ui-labels-start` |
| Label | Visible, visually hidden | —, `ui-search-box-visually-hidden` |
| Search button | Without, with; primary, secondary, tertiary; text (with or without magnifier) or icon only | —, `span.ui-search-box-button-host` (Button hierarchy and variant) |
| Width | Small, medium, large, full, fit content | `ui-search-box-width-small`, `-medium`, `-large`, `-full`, `-fit-content` |
| Scopes | Without, with | —, `div.ui-search-box-scopes-host` |

### States

| State | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Busy | Off, on | —, `ui-search-box-busy` (spinner at the end of the field; static with reduced motion) |

### Styling contract

`searchBox.css` has three parts, marked in the stylesheet. Restyle by writing the same selector with a new value in your own stylesheet, inside `@layer overrides` (preferred: library updates keep your changes), or by changing a value in your copy of the stylesheet. After each token come the parts it styles, named by their class without `ui-search-box-` (as in Structure), with the option or state in brackets (joined by “+” when they apply together). Text uses the typography roles of `design-system.css`; border sides are physical (top, right, bottom, left).

**1. Appearance — change freely** (colours, type, borders, corners, motion: only the look changes)

- Colours
  - `--c-text`: label, input
  - `--c-border`: control
  - `--c-surface`: control
  - `--c-accent`: control (focus)
  - `--c-surface-muted`: control (disabled)
  - `--c-muted`: input (disabled), label (disabled), busy icon, help
- Typography
  - `--font-ui`: search box, input
  - `--fw-ui`: search box, input
  - `--fs-label`: label, help
  - `--fw-ui-strong`: label
  - `--lh-compact`: label
  - `--fs-control`: input
  - `--lh-body`: help
- Borders and corners
  - `--border-thin`: control, input
- States and motion
  - `--transition-1`: control
  - `--spinner-duration`: icon
- Sizes
  - `--icon-size-medium`: busy icon
  - `--control-height`: input

**2. Dimensions — change with care** (sizes and spacing: the component keeps working, its size changes)

- Borders and corners
  - `--border-thin`: control
- Spacing
  - `--gap-tight`: search box, busy icon, clear host, message host
  - `--gap-inline-items`: row
  - `--padding-control`: input
- Sizes
  - `--control-height`: control
  - `--percentage-s`: search box (width small)
  - `--percentage-m`: search box (width medium)
  - `--percentage-l`: search box (width large)
  - `--percentage-full`: search box (width full)

**3. Structure — don't change** (layout, behaviour, states, accessibility)

- States and motion
  - `--focus-outline`: control (focus)
  - `--focus-offset`: control (focus)
- Spacing
  - `--gap-toolbar`: search box (label on the left, label on the left + width small, label on the left + width medium, label on the left + width large)
- Sizes
  - `--percentage-full`: search box (also label on the left + width small, label on the left + width medium, label on the left + width large)
  - `--form-label-width`: search box (label on the left, label on the left + width small, label on the left + width medium, label on the left + width large)
  - `--percentage-s`: search box (label on the left + width small)
  - `--percentage-m`: search box (label on the left + width medium)
  - `--percentage-l`: search box (label on the left + width large)

## For AI-assisted development

### Instructions

- Inside a Form, give the field a `name` (the key of its value) and leave `labelPosition` on `INHERIT`, so the Form (or a ContentGroup with the class `ui-labels-start`) decides label placement for all fields.
- Read this README before writing code. Import only from `searchBoxIndex.js`.
- Use SearchBox for every keyword search; never build search fields, clear buttons or magnifier icons by hand, and do not use TextInput for search.
- SearchBox reports `{ query, scopes }` through `onSearch`; implement matching, requests, results and URL handling in the page.
- Use `searchMode:'LIVE'` for fast, local searches and `'ON_DEMAND'` (with `showSearchButton:true`) for expensive server searches.
- Call `setBusy(true)` when a request starts and `setBusy(false)` when it ends; ignore responses of outdated requests in the page.
- Restore a query (e.g. from the URL) with `setValue()`; it fires no callback, so run that search yourself.
- Announce the number of results in the page (a polite live region), not in SearchBox.
- Give each search box a unique, DOM-safe `id` and call `destroy()` before rendering into the same container again.

### Safety

- Never remove the label: with `labelVisible:false` it is still the accessible name.
- Never treat the query as trusted: escape it before inserting it into HTML, and encode it in URLs and requests.
- Do not rely on browser-specific search features (native "×", the `search` event).

### Example prompts

```text
Add a SearchBox "Search people" above the users table with scopes All fields, Name and Company. Filter the table in memory while the user types, and announce "N results" in a polite live region.
```

```text
Add an on-demand SearchBox with a Search button for the product catalogue. Call the search API on search, show the busy indicator during the request, and keep the query in the URL so reloading restores it.
```

## For developers

### Business analysis

> **Component**: the SearchBox itself. **Consumer**: the developer who configures the SearchBox in the application's code. **App**: the running application that uses the SearchBox; it provides the data, performs the actions and stores the changes.

**Searching**

- User types in the field. <!-- BA-01 -->
  - Component reports the search to the App after a short pause (while-typing mode). <!-- BA-02 -->
- User presses Enter or clicks the Search button. <!-- BA-03 -->
  - Component reports the search to the App (on-request mode, and in both modes for Enter). <!-- BA-04 -->
  - App performs the search and displays the results. <!-- BA-05 -->
- Component removes spaces at the start or end of the search. <!-- BA-06 -->
- Component prevents repeating the same search. <!-- BA-07 -->
- Component prevents a search below a minimum number of characters. <!-- BA-08 -->
  - Component displays a short hint with the number of characters needed. <!-- BA-09 -->
- Component prevents Enter from submitting a surrounding form. <!-- BA-10 -->

**Field**

- Consumer provides the label, a hint text and a placeholder (optional). <!-- BA-11 -->
- Component displays a clear button ("×") as soon as the field has text. <!-- BA-12 -->
  - User clicks it, or presses Escape. <!-- BA-13 -->
  - Component clears the field and keeps the cursor in it. <!-- BA-14 -->
- App marks the search as busy. <!-- BA-15 -->
  - Component displays a busy indicator at the end of the field. <!-- BA-16 -->
- App provides a message under the field, e.g. "No results". <!-- BA-17 -->
- Component displays the browser's suggestions of earlier entries (optional). <!-- BA-18 -->
- Consumer chooses the width: small, medium, large, full (default) or fitted to the content. <!-- BA-19 -->

**Scope** (optional)

- Consumer provides the scopes, e.g. "All fields", "Name", "Company". <!-- BA-20 -->
- User selects a scope. <!-- BA-21 -->
  - Component displays the hint text of the scope. <!-- BA-22 -->
  - Component reports the current search again with the new scope. <!-- BA-23 -->

**Search button** (optional)

- Consumer chooses the emphasis: primary, secondary or tertiary. <!-- BA-24 -->
- Consumer chooses the text "Search", with a magnifying glass before it (optional), or the magnifying glass only. <!-- BA-25 -->

**Tooltips**

- Consumer chooses how the clear button and the icon search button show their names on hover and keyboard focus: the browser's tooltip, a Tooltip or none (optional). <!-- BA-26 -->

### Contracts

**Contracts:** Styling: three parts (Styling contract) · Form field: yes · Actions: no · Shared behaviour: yes, additions under Accessibility

### Public API

```js
import { renderSearchBox, DEFAULT_SEARCH_BOX_CONFIG, SEARCH_BOX_TOOLTIP_MODES, SEARCH_BOX_MODES } from './searchBoxIndex.js';

const search = renderSearchBox(container, config, onSearch); // null after a developer error
```

`container` is a dedicated, consumer-owned element. Rendering replaces its content; `destroy()` clears it.

| Member | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | The configured id. |
| `name` | string | The configured `name` (the key of the value in a Form). |
| `getLabelPosition()` | `'TOP'` \| `'START'` | Effective label position (`INHERIT` resolved from the surroundings). |
| `getLabel()` | string | The visible label; Form prefixes error-summary entries with it. |
| `getMandatoryState()` | object | `{ mandatory, indicator }`; Form shows "* Required field" when an asterisk is shown. |
| `validate()` | `{ valid:true, errorLabel:null }` | Always valid (form-field contract). |
| `getError()` | `null` | SearchBox never has an error (form-field contract). |
| `getValue()` | `{ query, scopes }` | The current effective search (what a search now would report). |
| `setValue({ query, scopes })` | — | Sets text and/or scope programmatically (either may be omitted); fires no callback. |
| `setValue(value, options)` | — | `options` (e.g. `{ quiet:true }` from Form's quiet reset) are accepted for the form-field contract; SearchBox never shows errors. |
| `clear()` | — | Empties the field programmatically; fires no callback. |
| `setMessage(message)` | — | Shows a Message under the field (INLINE): a string (INFO) or a Message configuration `{ type, text, … }`; `null` removes it. Announced when it appears. For results feedback such as "No results for 'xyz'." or "Search failed." |
| `focus()` | boolean | Moves focus to the field; returns whether it received focus. |
| `setBusy(busy)` | — | Shows or hides the busy indicator and sets `aria-busy`. |
| `destroy()` | — | Removes listeners, timers, Buttons and the scope list, clears the container. |

### Configuration

Enumerated values are canonical UPPER_CASE and accepted case-insensitively. An invalid value produces an `INVALID_OPTION` warning and the default is used.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Allowed values / format | Applies when | Usage / description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | — | Starts with a letter; letters, digits, `_ : . -`; unique in the document | Always | Required. Root id; the input is `{id}-input`. |
| `label` | string | — | Text | Always | Required. Label and accessible name. |
| `labelVisible` | boolean | `true` | — | Always | `false` hides the label visually only. |
| `placeholder` | string | `''` | Text | Always | Example text inside the empty field. |
| `help` | string | `''` | Text | Always | Hint below the field; replaced by the selected scope's `description` when it has one. |
| `searchMode` | string | `'LIVE'` | `LIVE`, `ON_DEMAND` | Always | `LIVE`: search while typing (debounced) and on Enter. `ON_DEMAND`: search on Enter or the Search button. |
| `debounceMs` | number | `300` | Integer 0–5000 | `LIVE` | Pause after typing before the search is reported. |
| `minLength` | number | `1` | Integer 1–50 | Always | Shorter queries count as empty (`''`) and show `texts.minLength`. |
| `showSearchButton` | boolean | `false` | — | Always | Adds a Search Button; recommended with `ON_DEMAND`. |
| `searchButtonVariant` | string | `'BUTTON'` | `BUTTON`, `ICON_BUTTON` | `showSearchButton` | `BUTTON`: the text `texts.search`; `ICON_BUTTON`: the magnifying glass only, named by `texts.search`. |
| `searchButtonHierarchy` | string | `'PRIMARY'` | `PRIMARY`, `SECONDARY`, `TERTIARY` | `showSearchButton` | Button hierarchy. |
| `searchButtonIcon` | boolean | `false` | — | `showSearchButton` + `BUTTON` | Shows the magnifying glass before the text. |
| `autocomplete` | string | `'off'` | `'off'`, `'on'` or another native token list | Always | Native `autocomplete`: `'off'` asks the browser not to suggest earlier entries; `'on'` lets it suggest previous searches from its history. Browsers may partly ignore `'off'`. |
| `scopes` | array | `[]` | `{ value, label, description? }` | Always | Where to search; shown as single-choice chips. Invalid or duplicate entries are dropped with a warning. |
| `defaultScope` | string | first scope | A scope `value` | `scopes` | Initially selected scope; unknown values fall back to the first scope (`UNKNOWN_SCOPE`). |
| `landmark` | boolean | `false` | — | Always | Adds `role="search"`; use it only for the page's main search. |
| `labelPosition` | string | `'INHERIT'` | `TOP`, `START`, `INHERIT` | Always | Label above the field (`TOP`), on its left (`START`), or as set by the surrounding Form/ContentGroup (`INHERIT`: left inside an element with the class `ui-labels-start`, otherwise on top). `START` needs a surrounding container at least 36rem wide (Form, ContentGroup, CollapsiblePanel, or any element with `container-type:inline-size`); narrower, the label moves on top. |
| `width` | string | `'FULL'` | `SMALL`, `MEDIUM`, `LARGE`, `FULL`, `FIT_CONTENT` | Always | Width of the search box, as TextInput (with the label on the left, SMALL / MEDIUM / LARGE size the field column). |
| `disabled` | boolean | `false` | — | Always | Disables field, buttons and scopes. |
| `tooltipMode` | string | `'NONE'` | `NONE`, `TITLE`, `TOOLTIP` | Always | How the clear button and the icon search button show their names on hover and keyboard focus: not at all, the browser's tooltip (`title`, mouse only) or a Tooltip (also on keyboard focus; needs `tooltip.css`, the Tooltip module is loaded only then). |
| `texts.clear` | string | `'Clear search'` | Text | Always | Clear button name. |
| `texts.search` | string | `'Search'` | Text | `showSearchButton` | Search button label (the name of the icon button). |
| `texts.scopeLabel` | string | `'Search in'` | Text | `scopes` | Scope group label. |
