| `texts.minLength` | string | `'Type at least {minLength} characters.'` | Text with `{minLength}` | not `minLength:1` | Minimum-length hint. |
| `onSearch` | function | `null` | `({ query, scopes }, instance) => {}` | Always | Search callback; takes precedence over the third `renderSearchBox()` argument. |
| `onInput` | function | `null` | `(text, instance) => {}` | Always | Every user edit of the raw text, including clearing. |

`debounceMs` with `ON_DEMAND`, `defaultScope` without scopes, the `searchButton*` options without `showSearchButton`, and `searchButtonIcon` with `ICON_BUTTON` are ignored with an `OPTION_IGNORED` warning.

### Callbacks

| Callback | Arguments | Fires when | Does not fire when |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `onSearch` | `({ query, scopes }, instance)`; `query` trimmed, `''` below `minLength` or after clearing; `scopes` `[]` or `[value]` | A user action changes the effective search: typing (`LIVE`, after the pause), Enter, the Search button, the clear button or Escape, a scope change while a query is present. | The effective search is unchanged (repeated Enter, extra spaces); during IME composition; `setValue()`, `clear()`. |
| `onInput` | `(text, instance)` | Every user edit of the raw text, including the clear button and Escape. | Programmatic `setValue()` or `clear()`. |

### Errors

SearchBox has no user-facing errors. Developer errors prevent rendering (`renderSearchBox()` returns `null`); warnings are logged and rendering continues. Console format: `SearchBox "id" [LABEL]: message`.

| Label | Severity | Cause |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CONTAINER_REQUIRED` | error | No container passed. |
| `ID_REQUIRED` | error | `id` is empty. |
| `UNSAFE_ID` | error | `id` is not DOM-safe. |
| `DUPLICATE_ID` | error | An element with the same id already exists in the document. |
| `LABEL_REQUIRED` | error | `label` is empty. |
| `INVALID_OPTION` | warning | Invalid `searchMode`, `debounceMs`, `minLength`, `autocomplete`, `width`, `searchButtonVariant` or `searchButtonHierarchy`; the default is used. |
| `OPTION_IGNORED` | warning | `debounceMs` with `ON_DEMAND`, `defaultScope` without scopes, `searchButton*` without `showSearchButton`, or `searchButtonIcon` with `ICON_BUTTON`. |
| `INVALID_SCOPE` | warning | A scope without `value` or `label`; dropped. |
| `DUPLICATE_SCOPE_VALUE` | warning | Duplicate scope value; dropped. |
| `UNKNOWN_SCOPE` | warning | `defaultScope` or `setValue()` names a scope that does not exist; the first scope is used. |

### Accessibility

- Native `input type="search"` (announced as a search field) with a real `label`, visible or visually hidden.
- The hint, scope description and minimum-length hint are linked through `aria-describedby`.
- Clear and Search are real Buttons with translated names; the clear button is removed from the tab order while the field is empty, and focus returns to the field after clearing.
- Keyboard: Enter searches, Escape clears (when the field is empty, Escape is left to the page, e.g. to close a dialog).
- Busy state sets `aria-busy`; the spinner respects `prefers-reduced-motion`. The result count is announced by the page.
- `role="search"` only with `landmark:true`, so pages do not get duplicate search landmarks.

### Examples

Live search with scopes, busy indicator and protection against outdated responses:

```js
let requestId = 0;

const search = renderSearchBox(searchHost,
{
    id:'people-search',
    label:'Search people',
    placeholder:'Name or company',
    minLength:2,
    scopes:[ { value:'ALL', label:'All fields' }, { value:'NAME', label:'Name', description:'Searched in first name, last name and full name.' }, { value:'COMPANY', label:'Company' } ]
},async ( { query, scopes }, instance ) =>
{
    const current = ++requestId;
    instance.setBusy(true);
    const people = query ? await fetchPeople(query,scopes[0]) : [];
    if ( current !== requestId ) { return; }            // a newer search has started
    instance.setBusy(false);
    renderResults(people);
    resultStatus.textContent = `${people.length} results`;   // polite live region owned by the page
});

// Restore from the URL without firing onSearch, then run the search yourself:
const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
if ( params.has('q') ) { search.setValue({ query:params.get('q'), scopes:[ params.get('in') ] }); }
```

### Files

| File | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `searchBoxIndex.js` | Public entry point; the only import surface. |
| `searchBoxConfig.js` | Defaults, allowed values, normalization, scopes, developer validation. |
| `searchBoxComponent.js` | Lifecycle, effective query, debounce, reporting, clear, scope and busy state, Button/CheckboxRadio composition. |
| `searchBoxHTML.js` | Search box shell markup. |
| `searchBoxEvents.js` | Input, Enter, Escape and IME composition handling. |
| `searchBoxState.js` | Per-instance runtime state. |
| `searchBoxErrors.js` | Developer error and warning catalog. |
| `searchBox.css` | Presentation. |
| `searchBoxTESTS.md` | Test plan: the cases that prove this README (automatic ones in `tests/components/searchBox.test.mjs`). |


<!-- ===== source/components-js/select/selectREADME.md ===== -->

# Select

## For business

### Overview

Select lets a user choose one option, or several, from a predefined list: a country, a role, product colours. It comes in two looks: the browser's standard dropdown (the default, simplest and best on phones) and a custom list whose colours follow the design and which can include a search field.

### When to use

- Use it for one or several choices from a list that is too long to show at once: a country, a role, product colours.
- Use CheckboxRadio when the list is short and the options are better visible all the time.
- Use SearchBox for searching data, and TreeView for choices organised in levels.

### Key features

- Single or multiple choice, with options grouped under headings.
- The browser's standard dropdown (default, best on phones) or a custom list in the design's colours.
- An optional search field in the custom list that ignores case and accents ("sao" finds "São Tomé").
- Chosen options summarised in the closed field: "Red, Green, Blue +2".
- The device's own picker on phones and tablets (on by default).

### Dependencies

| Dependency | Needed when | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Design system (`design-system.css`) | Always | Colors (including the option highlight tokens), spacing and typography. |
| Select styles (`select.css`) | Always | Field and list appearance. |

### Not included

The application provides the options, business rules (e.g. "at most three colours"), the explanation of the asterisk, the form's error summary and translations. Loading options from a server, creating new options and minimum/maximum numbers of choices are not part of this version.

## For designers

### Structure

```text
div.ui-select-wrapper.ui-select-width-{width}.ui-select-{native|custom}
├── label.ui-select-label (native)  or  span.ui-select-label (custom)
│   └── span.ui-select-optional  or  span.ui-select-mandatory     (mandatory indicator)
├── NATIVE: div.ui-select-control
│   ├── select.ui-select-native-field[.ui-select-native-multiple]  (placeholder option for single; optgroup for groups)
│   └── span.ui-select-chevron                                      (single only)
├── CUSTOM: button.ui-select-trigger  role="combobox"
│   ├── span.ui-select-value[.ui-select-placeholder] + span.ui-select-more ("+2")   (aria-hidden)
│   ├── span.ui-select-visually-hidden                              (full value for screen readers)
│   └── span.ui-select-chevron
│   div.ui-select-popup  popover (top layer)
│   ├── input.ui-select-search                                      (searchable)
│   ├── div.ui-select-listbox  role="listbox"
│   │   ├── div.ui-select-option.ui-select-option-clear             (non-mandatory single)
│   │   └── div.ui-select-group > div.ui-select-group-label + div.ui-select-option[.ui-select-option-active]
│   │       └── span.ui-select-check + span.ui-select-option-label
│   └── div.ui-select-no-matches
├── div.ui-select-help                                              (help; native multiple hint)
└── div.ui-select-error                                             (hidden when there is no error)
```

View state renders `p.ui-select-label` and `p.ui-select-view-value` (labels joined by commas); hidden state renders nothing. Option colours come from four local properties mapped to design tokens (defaults below); the popover's position and height are set by the component (`--ui-select-popup-*`), capped by `--size-md-3`. Native selects use the browser's own option rendering: their option colours cannot be customised.

### Visual options

| Option | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Label position | Top, left | `ui-select-label-top`, `ui-select-label-start`, or `INHERIT` inside an element with `ui-labels-start` |
| Presentation | Native, custom | `ui-select-native`, `ui-select-custom` |
| Width | Small, medium, large, full | `ui-select-width-small`, `-medium`, `-large`, `-full` |

### States

| State | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Option under pointer or keyboard (custom) | Hover colours, outline for keyboard | `:hover`, `.ui-select-option-active` → `--ui-select-hover-bg`, `--ui-select-hover-color` |
| Chosen option (custom) | Selected colours, check mark | `[aria-selected="true"]` → `--ui-select-selected-bg`, `--ui-select-selected-color` |
| Unavailable option | Reduced opacity | `[aria-disabled="true"]` (custom), `option[disabled]` (native) |
| Error | Shown | `[aria-invalid="true"]` on the select or trigger, visible `.ui-select-error` |

### Styling contract

`select.css` has three parts, marked in the stylesheet. Restyle by writing the same selector with a new value in your own stylesheet, inside `@layer overrides` (preferred: library updates keep your changes), or by changing a value in your copy of the stylesheet. After each token come the parts it styles, named by their class without `ui-select-` (as in Structure), with the option or state in brackets (joined by “+” when they apply together). Text uses the typography roles of `design-system.css`.

The disabled rules use `:disabled`, so they also apply inside a disabled `fieldset`; the label and `*` of a disabled field use `--c-muted`.

**1. Appearance — change freely** (colours, type, borders, corners, motion: only the look changes)

- Colours
  - `--c-text`: label, view value, native field, trigger, popup, search
  - `--c-muted`: optional, help, native field (disabled), trigger (disabled), label (disabled), mandatory (disabled), chevron, placeholder, more, group label, option (clear), no matches
  - `--c-danger-text`: mandatory, error
  - `--c-border`: native field, trigger, popup, search
  - `--c-surface`: native field, trigger, popup, search
  - `--c-accent`: native field (focus), trigger (focus)
  - `--c-danger`: native field (invalid), trigger (invalid)
  - `--c-surface-muted`: native field (disabled), trigger (disabled)
- Typography
  - `--font-ui`: select, popup
  - `--fw-ui`: select, popup, optional
  - `--fs-label`: label, optional, help, error, group label, no matches
  - `--fw-ui-strong`: label, mandatory, error, more, group label
  - `--lh-compact`: label
  - `--lh-body`: help, error
  - `--fs-control`: view value, native field, trigger, search, option
  - `--font-italic`: option (clear)
- Borders and corners
  - `--border-thin`: native field, trigger, popup, search
  - `--border-thick`: chevron, check (selected)
  - `--radius-control`: popup
  - `--radius-control-small`: option
- Shadows
  - `--shadow-md`: popup
- States and motion
  - `--transition-1`: native field, trigger
  - `--opacity-disabled`: option (disabled)

**2. Dimensions — change with care** (sizes and spacing: the component keeps working, its size changes)

- Spacing
  - `--gap-tight`: select, trigger, popup (also open), group label, option, no matches
  - `--gap-section`: select
  - `--gap-inline-items`: label, native field, trigger, chevron, group label, option, check, no matches
  - `--padding-control`: native field, trigger, search
  - `--gap-toolbar`: check
- Sizes
  - `--control-height`: native field, trigger, search
  - `--size-md-3`: popup
  - `--percentage-s`: select (width small)
  - `--percentage-m`: select (width medium)
  - `--percentage-l`: select (width large)
  - `--percentage-full`: select (width full)

**3. Structure — don't change** (layout, behaviour, states, accessibility)

- Borders and corners
  - `--border-thin`: option (active)
- States and motion
  - `--focus-outline`: native field (focus), trigger (focus), search (focus), option (active)
  - `--focus-offset`: native field (focus), trigger (focus), search (focus)
- Spacing
  - `--gap-toolbar`: select (label on the left, label on the left + width small, label on the left + width medium, label on the left + width large)
- Sizes
  - `--percentage-full`: select (also label on the left + width small, label on the left + width medium, label on the left + width large)
  - `--ui-select-popup-limit` (defined in this stylesheet; the component reads it): popup
  - `--form-label-width`: select (label on the left, label on the left + width small, label on the left + width medium, label on the left + width large)
  - `--percentage-s`: select (label on the left + width small)
  - `--percentage-m`: select (label on the left + width medium)
  - `--percentage-l`: select (label on the left + width large)

**Set by the component — don't change**

- Variables
  - `--ui-select-hover-bg`, `--ui-select-hover-color`: colours of the option under the pointer (from `optionHoverBackgroundToken`, `optionHoverColorToken`)
  - `--ui-select-selected-bg`, `--ui-select-selected-color`: colours of the chosen option (from `optionSelectedBackgroundToken`, `optionSelectedColorToken`)
  - `--ui-select-popup-left`, `--ui-select-popup-top`, `--ui-select-popup-width`, `--ui-select-popup-max-height`: position and size of the list (measured)

**Used by the code** (the component's code names these tokens; change the token to change the result)

- Tokens
  - `--select-option-hover-bg`, `--select-option-hover-color`: default colours of the option under the pointer
  - `--select-option-selected-bg`, `--select-option-selected-color`: default colours of the chosen option

## For AI-assisted development

### Instructions

- Inside a Form, give the field a `name` (the key of its value) and leave `labelPosition` on `INHERIT`, so the Form (or a ContentGroup with the class `ui-labels-start`) decides label placement for all fields. Show server or cross-field messages with `setError(message)`; they clear when the user changes the value.
- Read this README before writing code. Import only from `selectIndex.js`.
- Use Select for every dropdown or list choice; never write `select` markup, listboxes or popups by hand. For 2–5 always-visible options consider CheckboxRadio instead.
- The value is always an array: `[]`, `['RO']` or `['RED', 'BLUE']`, also for single choice.
- Keep `presentation:'NATIVE'` unless option colours or search are required; then use `'CUSTOM'`. A native multiple select is always an open list box on desktop; for a collapsed one-line field with several choices use `'CUSTOM'`.
- Change option colours only through the four `option…Token` options with design-token names (e.g. `optionSelectedBackgroundToken:'--c-accent'` with `optionSelectedColorToken:'--c-on-accent'`), and always change background and text together for contrast.
- Use `searchable:true` for long lists (roughly more than 10 options).
- Fields are mandatory by default; set `mandatory:false` explicitly, normally with `mandatoryIndicator:'OPTIONAL_TEXT'`.
- On submit, call `validate()`, build the error summary from `getError()` and let each link call `focus()`.
- Give each select a unique, DOM-safe `id` and call `destroy()` before rendering into the same container again.

### Safety

- Never pass literal colours; only design-token names.
- Never pass HTML in labels or group names; they are displayed as text.
- Never remove `role`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-activedescendant`, `aria-selected` or the label association of the custom presentation.

### Example prompts

```text
Add a mandatory custom Select "Country" with the countries grouped by continent, searchable, marked with an asterisk, and validate it on submit.
```

```text
Add a multiple-choice custom Select "Colours" whose chosen options use the accent colour (accent background, on-accent text), and store the chosen values whenever they change.
```

## For developers

### Business analysis

> **Component**: the Select itself. **Consumer**: the developer who configures the Select in the application's code. **App**: the running application that uses the Select; it provides the data, performs the actions and stores the changes.

**Choice**

- Consumer provides the options, grouped under headings (optional), e.g. "Europe", "Americas". <!-- BA-01 -->
- Consumer chooses single choice or multiple choice. <!-- BA-02 -->
- Component displays "Select an option" while nothing is chosen. <!-- BA-03 -->
- User selects an option. <!-- BA-04 -->
  - Component reports the new value to the App. <!-- BA-05 -->
- User selects the empty option of a single choice that is not required. <!-- BA-06 -->
- Consumer disables single options (optional). <!-- BA-07 -->

**Standard look**

- Component displays the browser's own dropdown, or a list box for multiple choice. <!-- BA-08 -->
- Consumer provides a hint for multiple choice, e.g. "Hold Ctrl or Cmd to select several" (optional). <!-- BA-09 -->

**Custom look** (optional)

- User clicks the field. <!-- BA-10 -->
  - Component opens the list below the field, or above it when there is no room below. <!-- BA-11 -->
  - Component keeps the list visible over panels and scrolling areas. <!-- BA-12 -->
- Component displays the chosen options and the option under the mouse or the keyboard in design colours chosen by the Consumer. <!-- BA-13 -->
  - Component displays a check mark on chosen options and an outline on the keyboard position. <!-- BA-14 -->
- Component keeps the list open while the user chooses several options. <!-- BA-15 -->
- Component displays the chosen options in the closed field, shortened when space runs out, e.g. "Red, Green, Blue +2". <!-- BA-16 -->
- Consumer enables a search field at the top of the list (optional). <!-- BA-17 -->
  - User types in the search field. <!-- BA-18 -->
  - Component hides the options that do not match, ignoring upper and lower case and accents. <!-- BA-19 -->
  - Component displays "No matching options" when nothing matches. <!-- BA-20 -->
- User types the first letters of an option to move to it. <!-- BA-21 -->

**Phones and tablets**

- Component displays the device's own picker instead of the custom list (optional, on by default). <!-- BA-22 -->

**Required**

- Component checks that a required select has a value. <!-- BA-23 -->
  - Component displays the error message. <!-- BA-24 -->

**Display**

- Consumer chooses one of four widths. <!-- BA-25 -->

### Contracts

**Contracts:** Styling: three parts (Styling contract) · Form field: yes · Actions: no · Shared behaviour: yes, additions under Accessibility

### Public API

```js
import { renderSelect, DEFAULT_SELECT_CONFIG, SELECT_STATES, SELECT_WIDTHS, SELECT_SELECTION_MODES, SELECT_PRESENTATIONS, SELECT_TOUCH_PRESENTATIONS, SELECT_MANDATORY_INDICATORS } from './selectIndex.js';

const country = renderSelect(container, config, onValueChange, onValidation); // null after a developer error
```

`container` is a dedicated, consumer-owned element. Rendering replaces its content; `destroy()` clears it. The configuration is immutable; the initial selection stays in `config.options[].selected`.

| Member | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | The configured id. |
| `name` | string | The configured `name` (the key of the value in a Form). |
| `getLabelPosition()` | `'TOP'` \| `'START'` | Effective label position (`INHERIT` resolved from the surroundings). |
| `getLabel()` | string | The visible label; Form prefixes error-summary entries with it. |
| `getMandatoryState()` | object | `{ mandatory, indicator }`; Form shows "* Required field" when an asterisk is shown. |
| `setError(message)` | `{ valid, errorLabel }` | Shows an external error (server or cross-field rule, label `EXTERNAL`) until the user changes the value or `clearError()` is called; own validation errors take precedence. |
| `clearError()` | — | Removes an external error; own validation errors stay. |
| `getValue()` | array | New array with the selected values, in option order. |
| `getError()` | object \| null | Copy of the current error `{ errorLabel, message, source, severity, visibility }`. |
| `setValue(values)` | `{ valid, errorLabel }` | Sets the selection (array or single value; `SINGLE` keeps the first; unknown values ignored with `UNKNOWN_VALUE`), runs final validation. |
| `setValue(value, { quiet:true })` | object | Quiet variant used by Form's quiet reset: sets the value without validating, removes any shown error and the changed state. |
| `validate()` | `{ valid, errorLabel }` | Runs final validation, shows or clears the error. |
| `isDirty()` | boolean | Whether the user has changed the selection. |
| `focus()` | boolean | Moves focus to the select or combobox; `false` in view, hidden or inactive state. |
| `destroy()` | — | Closes the list, removes listeners, observers and timers, clears the container. |

### Configuration

Enumerated values are canonical UPPER_CASE and accepted case-insensitively. An invalid value produces an `INVALID_OPTION` warning and the default is used.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Allowed values / format | Applies when | Usage / description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | — | Starts with a letter; letters, digits, `_ : . -`; unique in the document | Always | Required. Id of the select or trigger. |
| `name` | string | value of `id` | Text | `NATIVE` | Native `name`. |
| `label` | string | `''` | Text | Always | Visible label and accessible name. |
| `help` | string | `''` | Text | `EDIT`, `INACTIVE` | Help text, linked through `aria-describedby`. |
| `state` | string | `'EDIT'` | `EDIT`, `VIEW`, `INACTIVE`, `INVISIBLE` | Always | Display mode. |
| `width` | string | `'FULL'` | `SMALL`, `MEDIUM`, `LARGE`, `FULL` | Always | Field width. |
| `selectionMode` | string | `'SINGLE'` | `SINGLE`, `MULTIPLE` | Always | One or several choices. |
| `presentation` | string | `'NATIVE'` | `NATIVE`, `CUSTOM` | Always | Browser dropdown or custom list. |
| `touchPresentation` | string | `'NATIVE'` | `NATIVE`, `AS_CONFIGURED` | `CUSTOM` | On touch-first devices (`pointer: coarse`), `NATIVE` uses the device picker; custom colours and search then do not apply. |
| `options` | array | `[]` | `{ value, label, disabled?, selected? }` or `{ group, options:[…] }` | Always | Required, at least one option. Values unique (duplicates dropped with a warning); with `SINGLE`, at most one `selected:true`. |
| `mandatory` | boolean | `true` | — | Always | `true`: an empty selection is a `REQUIRED` error; sets `aria-required`. |
| `mandatoryIndicator` | string | `'NONE'` | `NONE`, `OPTIONAL_TEXT`, `MANDATORY_ASTERISK` | `label` | Marker next to the label. |
| `labelPosition` | string | `'INHERIT'` | `TOP`, `START`, `INHERIT` | Always | Label above the field (`TOP`), on its left (`START`), or as set by the surrounding Form/ContentGroup (`INHERIT`: left inside an element with the class `ui-labels-start`, otherwise on top). `START` needs a surrounding container at least 36rem wide (Form, ContentGroup, CollapsiblePanel, or any element with `container-type:inline-size`); narrower, the label moves on top. |
| `searchable` | boolean | `false` | — | `CUSTOM` | Search field that filters options by label (case- and accent-insensitive). |
| `showMultipleHint` | boolean | `false` | — | `NATIVE` + `MULTIPLE` | Shows `texts.multipleHint` below the list box. |
| `autoFocus` | boolean | `false` | — | `EDIT` | Focuses the control once, after the first render. |
| `optionHoverBackgroundToken` / `optionHoverColorToken` | string | `'--select-option-hover-bg'` / `'--select-option-hover-color'` | Design-token name | `CUSTOM` | Colours of the option under the pointer or keyboard. |
| `optionSelectedBackgroundToken` / `optionSelectedColorToken` | string | `'--select-option-selected-bg'` / `'--select-option-selected-color'` | Design-token name | `CUSTOM` | Colours of chosen options. |
| `texts.placeholder` | string | `'Select an option'` | Text | Always | Shown while nothing is chosen. |
| `texts.optional` | string | `'(Optional)'` | Text | `mandatory:false` + `OPTIONAL_TEXT` | Optional marker. |
| `texts.clear` | string | `'Clear selection'` | Text | `CUSTOM` + `SINGLE` + not `mandatory` | Entry that empties the selection. |
| `texts.search` / `texts.noMatches` | string | `'Search options'` / `'No matching options'` | Text | `searchable` | Search field name and empty-result message. |
| `texts.more` | string | `'+{count}'` | Text with `{count}` | `CUSTOM` + `MULTIPLE` | Suffix for labels that do not fit in the closed field. |
| `texts.multipleHint` | string | `'Hold Ctrl or Cmd to select several.'` | Text | `showMultipleHint` | Native multiple hint. |
| `texts.errors.REQUIRED` | string | `'Select an option.'` | Text | `mandatory` | Required message. |

Native multiple selects are always-open list boxes on desktop (browsers cannot collapse them); use `CUSTOM` for a collapsed field. Custom-only options (`searchable`, `touchPresentation`, the colour tokens) with `NATIVE`, and `showMultipleHint` outside a native multiple select, are ignored with an `OPTION_IGNORED` warning.

### Callbacks

| Callback | Arguments | Fires when | Does not fire when |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `onValueChange` | `(values, instance)`, `values` a new array | A user action changes the selection (native change, choosing or toggling in the custom list, the clear entry). | Initial render, `setValue()`, reopening or closing the list without a change. |
| `onValidation` | `(result, instance)` with `result = { valid, errorLabel }` | The effective validation result changes (user change, blur, `validate()`, `setValue()`). | The result is unchanged. |

### Errors

| Label | Default message | Trigger | Visibility |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `EXTERNAL` | Message passed to `setError()`. | `setError(message)`, e.g. from a Form (server errors, cross-field rules). | Corrective |
| `REQUIRED` | Select an option. | Empty selection with `mandatory:true`; shown on blur after a change, `validate()` or `setValue()`. | Corrective |
| `UNIDENTIFIED` | An unidentified error occurred. | Unknown error label. | Dismissible |

Developer errors prevent rendering (`renderSelect()` returns `null`); warnings are logged and rendering continues. Console format: `Select "id" [LABEL]: message`.

| Label | Severity | Cause |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CONTAINER_REQUIRED` | error | No container passed. |
| `ID_REQUIRED` | error | `id` is empty. |
| `UNSAFE_ID` | error | `id` is not DOM-safe. |
| `DUPLICATE_ID` | error | An element with the same id already exists in the document. |
| `OPTIONS_REQUIRED` | error | No options. |
| `OPTION_VALUE_REQUIRED` | error | An option without `value`. |
| `OPTION_LABEL_REQUIRED` | error | An option without `label`. |
| `MULTIPLE_INITIAL_SELECTION` | error | More than one `selected:true` with `SINGLE`. |
| `INVALID_OPTION` | warning | Invalid enumerated value or token name; the default is used. |
| `OPTION_IGNORED` | warning | Option that does not apply to the presentation or selection mode. |
| `DUPLICATE_OPTION_VALUE` | warning | Duplicate option value dropped. |
| `UNKNOWN_VALUE` | warning | `setValue()` received values that are not options; ignored. |

### Accessibility

- `NATIVE`: a real `select` with `label for`; the browser provides keyboard use and announcements.
- `CUSTOM`: the ARIA select-only combobox pattern — a `button role="combobox"` (with `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, `aria-activedescendant`) and a `role="listbox"` of `role="option"` items with `aria-selected`/`aria-disabled`; groups use `role="group"` named by their heading; `aria-multiselectable` for multiple choice. The closed field's full value is available to screen readers even when shortened visually.
- With search, focus moves to the search field (`role="combobox"`, `aria-autocomplete="list"`) while arrow keys move through the options; "No matching options" is announced once.
- Keyboard: arrows, Home/End, type-ahead, Enter/Space choose, Escape closes and returns focus, Tab closes and moves on. The active option has an outline besides its colour; chosen options have a check mark.
- Mandatory status via `aria-required`; errors linked through `aria-describedby` and `aria-invalid`, not announced by the field (the consumer's error summary does that).

### Examples

Searchable country select with groups, restored from saved data, validated on submit:

```js
const country = renderSelect(countryHost,
{
    id:'delivery-country',
    label:'Country',
    presentation:'CUSTOM',
    searchable:true,
    mandatoryIndicator:'MANDATORY_ASTERISK',
    options:[
        { group:'Europe', options:[ { value:'RO', label:'Romania' }, { value:'PT', label:'Portugal' } ] },
        { group:'Africa', options:[ { value:'ST', label:'São Tomé and Príncipe' } ] }
    ],
    texts:{ errors:{ REQUIRED:'Select the delivery country.' } }
},( values ) => { order.country = values[0] ?? null; });

country.setValue(savedOrder.country ? [ savedOrder.country ] : []);   // programmatic: no onValueChange

form.addEventListener('submit',event => { if ( !country.validate().valid ) { event.preventDefault(); showErrorSummary([ { message:country.getError().message, focus:country.focus } ]); } });
```

Custom colours for chosen options (background and text changed together):

```js
renderSelect(host,{ id:'colours', label:'Colours', selectionMode:'MULTIPLE', presentation:'CUSTOM', mandatory:false,
    optionSelectedBackgroundToken:'--c-accent', optionSelectedColorToken:'--c-on-accent',
    options:[ { value:'RED', label:'Red' }, { value:'BLUE', label:'Blue' }, { value:'GREEN', label:'Green' } ] });
```

### Files

| File | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `selectIndex.js` | Public entry point; the only import surface. |
| `selectConfig.js` | Defaults, allowed values, option and group normalization, developer validation. |
| `selectComponent.js` | Lifecycle, selection, error lifecycle, custom listbox (open/close, positioning, keyboard, type-ahead, search), runtime API. |
| `selectHTML.js` | Native and custom markup (rendered once). |
| `selectEvents.js` | Native, custom and open-list listener registration. |
| `selectState.js` | Per-instance runtime state. |
| `selectValidation.js` | Required-selection rule. |
| `selectErrors.js` | User error catalog and developer error and warning catalog. |
| `select.css` | Presentation. |
| `selectTESTS.md` | Test plan: the cases that prove this README (automatic ones in `tests/components/select.test.mjs`). |


<!-- ===== source/components-js/sideNavigation/sideNavigationREADME.md ===== -->

# SideNavigation

## For business

### Overview

SideNavigation is the application's main menu at the side of the screen. It shows the pages as a tree with sections, highlights where the user is, and adapts to the space: it can shrink to icons only, and on phones it becomes a panel that slides in from the side. The application provides the list of pages; SideNavigation only shows it and reports the user's choices.

### When to use

- Use it for the application's main menu at the side of the screen, especially for many pages or more than two levels.
- Use TopNavigation for a few sections in a header bar, Breadcrumbs for the path to the current page, and TreeView for data organised in levels.

### Key features

- Pages as a tree with any number of levels, sections with headings and separators.
- The current page highlighted, with its parents opened.
- A collapsed rail with icons only, and a drawer on phones.
- Three level styles (indentation, tree lines, background), two open/close marks (arrow, + / −) and four corner sizes.
- Icons, counters, unavailable entries, external links and an optional search for large menus.

### Dependencies

| Dependency | Needed when | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Design system (`design-system.css`) | Always | Colours, spacing and typography. |
| SideNavigation styles (`sideNavigation.css`) | Always | Navigation, rail, flyout and drawer. |
| Button component and `button.css` | Always | Rail, close and menu (hamburger) buttons. |
| Message component and `message.css` | `search` | "No matching pages" message. |
| Font Awesome icon library | Always | Button icons and item icons. Loaded by the application page. |
| Tooltip component and `tooltip.css` | `tooltipMode` `TOOLTIP` | Tooltips (the Tooltip module is loaded only then). |

### Not included

The application loads the pages (e.g. from its server, filtered by permissions), converts them to the item format, keeps its own copy for routing, stores the remembered choices, and provides the page layout around the navigation (side area, logo, header). Top navigation is a separate component (TopNavigation, planned).

## For designers

### Structure

```text
nav#{id}.ui-side-nav.ui-side-nav-level-{indentation|tree|background}.ui-side-nav-indicator-{chevron|plus-minus}.ui-side-nav-radius-{none|small|medium|large}[.ui-side-nav-rail][.ui-side-nav-drawer-open][.ui-side-nav-searching]
├── div.ui-side-nav-header → Buttons: rail toggle (desktop), close (drawer)
├── div.ui-side-nav-search > input.ui-side-nav-search-input               (optional)
├── div.ui-side-nav-scroll                                                 (scrolls when needed)
│   ├── ul.ui-side-nav-list.ui-side-nav-root
│   │   ├── li.ui-side-nav-group > span.ui-side-nav-group-label + ul.ui-side-nav-list
│   │   ├── li.ui-side-nav-separator
│   │   └── li.ui-side-nav-item  (--ui-side-nav-level)
│   │       ├── div.ui-side-nav-row[.ui-side-nav-current][.ui-side-nav-has-children]
│   │       │   ├── a.ui-side-nav-link | button.ui-side-nav-link.ui-side-nav-parent | span.ui-side-nav-link.ui-side-nav-disabled
│   │       │   │   └── span.ui-side-nav-icon (icon, or an empty .ui-side-nav-initial space) + span.ui-side-nav-label + span.ui-side-nav-badge + external hint
│   │       │   └── button.ui-side-nav-toggle > span.ui-side-nav-chevron          (parent with own page)
│   │       └── div.ui-side-nav-children[.ui-side-nav-children-open] > ul.ui-side-nav-list
│   └── div.ui-side-nav-no-results → Message (INLINE, INFO)
└── div.ui-side-nav-flyout  popover                                        (rail sub-pages)
div.ui-side-nav-overlay                                                    (drawer backdrop)
```

Rows have the control height; hover uses the hover background, the current page the selected background with a bold label and accent icon. Badges are small accent pills. Branches open with a short height transition (none with reduced motion). The rail keeps only the top-level icons (a small dot marks parents), and its flyout shows full labels; the drawer slides in from the start side with a backdrop. The navigation fills the height of its container. Expand indicator PLUS_MINUS puts a + / − sign (two bars; the vertical one shrinks when the branch opens) in a column before the icon: inside the parent button, or as the open/close button placed before the link; rows without sub-pages keep an empty column of the same width (`.ui-side-nav-sign-space`), so icons and labels stay aligned; when no entry of the menu has an icon there is no icon column, so the label follows the sign directly; with TREE the lines join the signs. Corner radius applies to rows, links, open/close buttons and BACKGROUND lists (the search field and the rail flyout keep `--radius-control`). Level style TREE draws thin border-coloured lines from each parent to its sub-pages (├─, └─ for the last one), in the main list only; the rail flyout keeps indentation.

### Visual options

| Option | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Level style | Indentation, tree lines, background | `ui-side-nav-level-indentation`, `-tree` (lines: `::before` / `::after` of nested `.ui-side-nav-item`), `-background` |
| Expand indicator | Chevron, + / − | `ui-side-nav-indicator-chevron` (`.ui-side-nav-chevron`), `ui-side-nav-indicator-plus-minus` (`.ui-side-nav-sign`, `.ui-side-nav-sign-space`) |
| Corner radius | None, small, medium, large | `ui-side-nav-radius-none`, `-small`, `-medium`, `-large` |
| Width | Full, rail | —, `ui-side-nav-rail` |
| Entry | Link, parent | `a.ui-side-nav-link`, `.ui-side-nav-parent` |
| Extras | Badge, external, group, separator | `.ui-side-nav-badge`, `.ui-side-nav-external`, `.ui-side-nav-group`, `.ui-side-nav-separator` |

### States

| State | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Drawer (below 48rem) | Closed, open | —, `ui-side-nav-drawer-open` + `.ui-side-nav-overlay` |
| Entry | Disabled, current | `.ui-side-nav-disabled`, `.ui-side-nav-current` |

### Styling contract

`sideNavigation.css` has three parts, marked in the stylesheet. Restyle by writing the same selector with a new value in your own stylesheet, inside `@layer overrides` (preferred: library updates keep your changes), or by changing a value in your copy of the stylesheet. After each token come the parts it styles, named by their class without `ui-side-nav-` (as in Structure), with the option or state in brackets (joined by “+” when they apply together). Text uses the typography roles of `design-system.css`; border sides are physical (top, right, bottom, left).

**1. Appearance — change freely** (colours, type, borders, corners, motion: only the look changes)

- Colours
  - `--c-surface`: side navigation, search input, current, flyout
  - `--c-text`: side navigation, search input, row (hover), current (also hover), icon (also current), flyout
  - `--c-border`: search input, separator, item (level tree + root), flyout
  - `--c-muted`: group label, external, toggle, sign, flyout (title)
  - `--c-surface-hover`: row (hover), current (hover)
  - `--c-accent`: badge
  - `--c-on-accent`: badge
  - `--c-surface-muted`: toggle (hover), children (level background)
  - `--c-blue-60`: icon (rail + root + has children)
  - `--shadow-color`: overlay (narrow)
- Typography
  - `--font-ui`: side navigation
  - `--fw-ui`: side navigation, label
  - `--fs-control`: side navigation
  - `--fs-caption`: group label, badge, external, flyout (title)
  - `--fw-ui-strong`: group label, label (current), badge, flyout (title)
- Borders and corners
  - `--border-thin`: search input, separator, current, flyout
  - `--radius-control`: search input, row, link, toggle, children (level background), flyout
  - `--radius-pill`: badge
  - `--radius-control-small`: row (radius small), link (radius small), toggle (radius small), children (radius small)
  - `--radius-control-large`: row (radius large), link (radius large), toggle (radius large), children (radius large)
- Shadows
  - `--shadow-md`: flyout, side navigation (narrow)
- States and motion
  - `--opacity-disabled`: disabled
  - `--transition-1`: chevron, children, sign, side navigation (narrow, drawer open + narrow, drawer open + right-to-left + narrow)

**2. Dimensions — change with care** (sizes and spacing: the component keeps working, its size changes)

- Borders and corners
  - `--border-thin`: item (level tree + root)
  - `--border-thick`: sign
- Spacing
  - `--gap-tight`: header, scroll, group label, separator, badge, flyout (also title), item (level tree + root, level tree + indicator chevron + root, level tree + indicator plus minus + root)
  - `--gap-inline-items`: search, scroll, no results, group, group label, separator, link, side navigation (rail), flyout (title), item (level tree, level background, level tree + root, level tree + indicator chevron + root, level tree + indicator plus minus + root), row (indicator plus minus + root), toggle (indicator plus minus + root)
  - `--padding-control`: search input
  - `--gap-block`: item (also level indentation)
- Sizes
  - `--control-height`: search input, link, toggle, side navigation (rail), item (level tree + root + last, level tree + root)
  - `--ui-side-nav-indent` (defined in this stylesheet): link, row (indicator plus minus + root)
  - `--icon-size-large`: icon (also rail + root + has children), badge, item (level tree, level tree + root, level tree + indicator chevron + root, level tree + indicator plus minus + root)
  - `--space-sm-3`: chevron
  - `--size-md-2`: flyout
  - `--space-lg-3`: sign, sign space, toggle (indicator plus minus + root), item (level tree + indicator plus minus + root)
  - `--space-md-3`: sign, item (level tree + indicator plus minus + root)
  - `--size-md-3`: side navigation (narrow)

**3. Structure — don't change** (layout, behaviour, states, accessibility)

- Borders and corners
  - `--border-thick`: link (focus), toggle (focus)
  - `--border-thin`: chevron
  - `--radius-pill`: icon (rail + root + has children)
- States and motion
  - `--focus-outline`: search input (focus), link (focus), toggle (focus)
  - `--focus-offset`: search input (focus)
- Spacing
  - `--gap-block`: flyout
- Sizes
  - `--space-sm-2`: icon (rail + root + has children)

**Set by the component — don't change**

- Variables
  - `--ui-side-nav-level`: depth of each entry (drives the indentation)
  - `--ui-side-nav-flyout-left`, `--ui-side-nav-flyout-top`: position of the rail flyout (measured)

## For AI-assisted development

### Instructions

- Read this README before writing code. Import only from `sideNavigationIndex.js`.
- Load the navigation data in the application, map it to items `{ id, label, href?, icon?, badge?, disabled?, external?, children? }` (plus `{ type:'GROUP', label, children }` and `{ type:'SEPARATOR' }`), and pass them in `items`; keep your own copy for the router.
- Render into a container that has the full height of the side area; the page layout (side area, logo, header) belongs to the application.
- Pass `drawerToggleHost` (an element in the page header) so phones get the menu button.
- In single-page applications call `event.preventDefault()` in `onNavigate`, route, and call `setCurrent(id or href)`.
- Store `onRailChange` and `onExpandChange` results (e.g. in local storage) and pass them back as `railCollapsed` and `expandedIds`.
- Give every top-level item an `icon` if the rail should be available; without them the rail toggle is not shown (`RAIL_NEEDS_ICONS`).
- Give each navigation a unique, DOM-safe `id` and call `destroy()` before rendering into the same container again.

### Safety

- Labels and badges are displayed as text; do not pass HTML. Build `href`s from trusted routes only.
- Filter items by permission in the application; hiding a page in the menu does not protect it.
- Never remove `aria-current`, `aria-expanded` or the navigation label.

### Example prompts

```text
Render the application's SideNavigation from the navigation API response (mapped to items with icons), with sections Finance and Administration, a badge on Approvals, search above 15 entries, the rail and open branches remembered in local storage, and the menu button in the page header on phones.
```

## For developers

### Business analysis

> **Component**: the SideNavigation itself. **Consumer**: the developer who configures the SideNavigation in the application's code. **App**: the running application that uses the SideNavigation; it provides the data, performs the actions and stores the changes.

**Pages**

- App provides the pages as a tree, with sections that have headings, e.g. "Administration", and separators. <!-- BA-01 -->
- Component displays the current page highlighted, and opens its parent levels. <!-- BA-02 -->
- User clicks a page. <!-- BA-03 -->
  - Component reports the page to the App. <!-- BA-04 -->
  - App opens the page. <!-- BA-05 -->
- User clicks the open/close mark of a parent. <!-- BA-06 -->
  - Component opens or closes its sub-pages, independently of other parents. <!-- BA-07 -->
  - Component reports the open parents to the App. <!-- BA-08 -->
- User clicks a parent that is not a page itself. <!-- BA-09 -->
  - Component opens or closes its sub-pages. <!-- BA-10 -->

**Look**

- Consumer chooses how levels are shown: indentation (default), tree lines that join each sub-page to its parent, or a background for deeper levels. <!-- BA-11 -->
- Consumer chooses the open/close mark: an arrow at the end of the row (default) or a + / − sign before the icon. <!-- BA-12 -->
- Consumer chooses the corners of the rows: none, small, medium (default) or large. <!-- BA-13 -->
- Consumer provides icons and counters, e.g. "Approvals 3" (optional). <!-- BA-14 -->
- Component displays an unavailable entry and prevents opening it. <!-- BA-15 -->
- Component displays an external link with a visible and spoken "new tab" hint. <!-- BA-16 -->

**Rail** (optional)

- User clicks the rail button. <!-- BA-17 -->
  - Component displays only the icons of the top-level entries, and reports the change to the App. <!-- BA-18 -->
  - User hovers over an icon. <!-- BA-19 -->
  - Component displays the page name as a tooltip. <!-- BA-20 -->
  - User clicks the icon of a parent. <!-- BA-21 -->
  - Component opens a small panel with its sub-pages next to the icon. <!-- BA-22 -->
- Component displays the rail button only when every top-level entry has an icon. <!-- BA-23 -->

**Phones and narrow screens** (below 48rem)

- Component hides the menu and displays a menu button in the page header. <!-- BA-24 -->
  - User clicks the menu button. <!-- BA-25 -->
  - Component opens the menu as a drawer from the side, above the header, and keeps the focus inside it. <!-- BA-26 -->
  - Component closes the drawer when the user clicks the close button, presses Escape, clicks outside it, or chooses a page. <!-- BA-27 -->

**Search** (optional)

- Component displays a search field when the menu has more than a number of entries chosen by the Consumer. <!-- BA-28 -->
  - User types in the field. <!-- BA-29 -->
  - Component hides the pages that do not match, except their parents. <!-- BA-30 -->
  - Component displays and announces "No matching pages" when nothing matches. <!-- BA-31 -->

**Height**

- Component scrolls only the menu when it is taller than the available height. <!-- BA-32 -->

**Remembered choices**

- App stores the rail state and the open parents, and provides them again on the next visit. <!-- BA-33 -->

**Tooltips**

- Consumer chooses how the entry names in the rail shows on hover and keyboard focus: the browser's tooltip, a Tooltip or none (optional, on by default with the browser). <!-- BA-34 -->

### Contracts

**Contracts:** Styling: three parts (Styling contract) · Form field: no · Actions: no · Shared behaviour: yes, additions under Accessibility

### Public API

```js
import { renderSideNavigation, DEFAULT_SIDE_NAVIGATION_CONFIG, SIDE_NAVIGATION_TOOLTIP_MODES, SIDE_NAVIGATION_LEVEL_STYLES } from './sideNavigationIndex.js';

const navigation = renderSideNavigation(container, config, onNavigate); // null after a developer error
```

| Member | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | The configured id. |
| `setItems(items)` | — | Replaces the tree (e.g. after permissions changed). |
| `setCurrent(idOrHref)` | — | Marks the current page and opens its parents. |
| `setBadge(id, badge)` | — | Updates or removes (`''`/`null`) a badge. |
| `getExpandedIds()` | array | Ids of the open branches. |
| `isRail()` / `setRail(rail)` | boolean / — | Rail state; setting it programmatically is not reported. |
| `openDrawer()` / `closeDrawer()` | — | Opens or closes the drawer (narrow screens only). |
| `destroy()` | — | Removes listeners and Buttons, clears the container. |

### Configuration

| Parameter | Type | Default | Allowed values / format | Applies when | Usage / description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | — | Starts with a letter; letters, digits, `_ : . -`; unique in the document | Always | Required. Id of the `<nav>`. |
| `items` | array | `[]` | See Items | Always | Required. The navigation tree. |
| `currentId` | string | `''` | Item id | Always | Initial current page. |
| `levelStyle` | string | `'INDENTATION'` | `INDENTATION`, `TREE`, `BACKGROUND` | Always | How levels are shown; `TREE` joins each sub-page to its parent with lines. |
| `expandIndicator` | string | `'CHEVRON'` | `CHEVRON`, `PLUS_MINUS` | Always | Open/close mark of parents: an arrow at the end of the row, or a + / − sign before the icon. |
| `cornerRadius` | string | `'MEDIUM'` | `NONE`, `SMALL`, `MEDIUM`, `LARGE` | Always | Corners of the rows: none, `--radius-control-small`, `--radius-control`, `--radius-control-large`. |
| `allowRail` | boolean | `true` | — | Always | Shows the rail toggle on screens wider than 48rem, when every top-level item has an icon. |
| `railCollapsed` | boolean | `false` | — | `allowRail` | Initial rail state (remembered choice). |
| `expandedIds` | array | `[]` | Item ids | Always | Initially open branches (remembered choice); parents of the current page open anyway. |
| `search` | boolean | `false` | — | Always | Enables the search field … |
| `searchThreshold` | number | `15` | Integer ≥ 0 | `search` | … shown only with more entries than this. |
| `drawerToggleHost` | Element | `null` | Element in the page header | Always | Where the menu (hamburger) Button is rendered; used below 48rem, hidden on wider screens. |
| `tooltipMode` | string | `'TITLE'` | `NONE`, `TITLE`, `TOOLTIP` | Always | How the entry names in the rail (`TOOLTIP`: after the entry) shows on hover and keyboard focus: not at all, the browser's tooltip (`title`, mouse only) or a Tooltip (also on keyboard focus; needs `tooltip.css`, the Tooltip module is loaded only then). With `TOOLTIP` it also applies to the rail, close and menu buttons; with `TITLE` or `NONE` they show nothing (as before). |
| `texts.*` | string | English defaults | Text | Always | `navigation` ("Main"), `expand`/`collapse` ("Expand {label}"), `collapseRail`, `expandRail`, `openDrawer`, `closeDrawer`, `search`, `noResults`, `newTab`. |
| `onNavigate` | function | `null` | `(item, event, instance) => {}` | Always | Takes precedence over the third argument. |
| `onRailChange` | function | `null` | `(rail, instance) => {}` | Always | The user switched the rail. |
| `onExpandChange` | function | `null` | `(expandedIds, instance) => {}` | Always | The user opened or closed a branch. |

### Items

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | Required, unique. |
| `label` | string | Required. |
| `href` | string | Page address; parents with `href` are pages with a separate open/close button, parents without it open and close on click. |
| `icon` | string | Font Awesome classes; required on all top-level entries for the rail (sub-pages may have none). |
| `badge` | string \| number | Counter shown next to the label. |
| `disabled` | boolean | Shown but not selectable. |
| `external` | boolean | Opens in a new tab with a hint. |
| `children` | array | Sub-items. |
| `type` | string | `'GROUP'` (with `label` and `children`) or `'SEPARATOR'`. |

### Callbacks

| Callback | Arguments | Fires when | Does not fire when |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `onNavigate` | `({ id, label, href, external }, event, instance)` | A link is chosen (the drawer and flyout then close). Links navigate unless `event.preventDefault()` is called. | Disabled entries; parents opened in the rail (they show the flyout). |
| `onRailChange` | `(rail, instance)` | The user switches the rail. | `setRail()`. |
| `onExpandChange` | `(expandedIds, instance)` | The user opens or closes a branch. | Parents opened automatically for the current page. |

### Errors

SideNavigation has no user-facing errors. Developer errors prevent rendering; warnings are logged and rendering continues. Console format: `SideNavigation "id" [LABEL]: message`.

| Label | Severity | Cause |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CONTAINER_REQUIRED` | error | No container passed. |
| `ID_REQUIRED` | error | `id` is empty. |
| `UNSAFE_ID` | error | `id` is not DOM-safe. |
| `DUPLICATE_ID` | error | An element with the same id already exists in the document. |
| `ITEMS_REQUIRED` | error | No usable item (also in `setItems()`, which then keeps the previous tree). |
| `INVALID_ITEM` | warning | An item without id or label (or a group without label); dropped. |
| `DUPLICATE_ITEM_ID` | warning | Duplicate item id; the later item is dropped. |
| `RAIL_NEEDS_ICONS` | warning | `allowRail` with top-level items without icon; the rail is not offered. |
| `UNKNOWN_ITEM` | warning | `setCurrent()` or `setBadge()` names no item. |
| `INVALID_OPTION` | warning | Invalid `levelStyle`, `expandIndicator`, `cornerRadius` or `searchThreshold`; the default is used. |

The former `levelStyle` value `FONT_WEIGHT` (bold top level) was removed; it is still accepted without a warning and gives `TREE`.

### Accessibility

- A `<nav>` landmark with a name, nested lists, real links (open-in-new-tab works) and buttons with `aria-expanded`/`aria-controls` (the disclosure navigation pattern: Tab moves through entries, Enter/Space open and close).
- The current page has `aria-current="page"`; closed branches are not reachable with Tab.
- With the + / − sign, a parent that is also a page has its open/close button before the link, so Tab reaches the button first, in the visual order; the sign itself is hidden from screen readers (the button keeps its name, e.g. "Expand Projects", and `aria-expanded`).
- Groups are lists labelled by their heading; external links say "(opens in a new tab)".
- Rail: entries keep their names for screen readers (labels are only hidden visually) and show tooltips; parents open a flyout, Escape closes it and returns focus.
- Drawer: the menu Button reports `aria-expanded`; opening moves focus into the drawer, Tab stays inside, Escape or the close button closes it and returns focus to the menu Button.

### Examples

```js
const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('navigation') ?? '{}');
const items = mapNavigation(await api.navigation());   // application-specific mapping

const navigation = renderSideNavigation(sideArea,
{
    id:'main-nav', items, currentId:router.currentId(), search:true,
    railCollapsed:saved.rail ?? false, expandedIds:saved.expanded ?? [],
    drawerToggleHost:document.querySelector('#menu-button-host'),
    onRailChange:( rail ) => save({ rail }),
    onExpandChange:( expanded ) => save({ expanded })
},( item, event ) => { if ( !item.external ) { event.preventDefault(); router.go(item.href); navigation.setCurrent(item.id); } });
```

### Files

| File | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `sideNavigationIndex.js` | Public entry point; the only import surface. |
| `sideNavigationConfig.js` | Defaults, item-tree normalization, developer validation. |
| `sideNavigationComponent.js` | Drawing, current page, branches, rail and flyout, drawer, search, Buttons, reports. |
| `sideNavigationHTML.js` | Shell and item-tree markup. |
| `sideNavigationEvents.js` | Click, search, keyboard, outside-press and viewport listeners. |
| `sideNavigationState.js` | Per-instance state and tree helpers. |
| `sideNavigationErrors.js` | Developer error and warning catalog. |
| `sideNavigation.css` | Presentation. |
| `sideNavigationTESTS.md` | Test plan: the cases that prove this README (automatic ones in `tests/components/sideNavigation.test.mjs`). |


<!-- ===== source/components-js/stepper/stepperREADME.md ===== -->

# Stepper

## For business

### Overview

Stepper shows a task split into ordered steps: where the user is, what is done and what is left. Typical uses are sign-up, checkout, onboarding, approval flows and order tracking.

### When to use

- Use it for a task of about 3 to 7 steps that are done in order, completely or partly (some steps may be done in any order once the steps before them are complete).
- Use it without interaction to show the progress of a process the user only follows (an order, a request under review).
- Use Accordion or CollapsiblePanel for sections without an order; use TopNavigation or SideNavigation to move between pages; use ContentGroup to split one page into groups; use Loader for the progress of a single action (an upload, an export).

### Key features

- Each step with a number, an icon or a dot, a label, an optional description and a status: not started, in progress, done, skipped, needs attention, has errors, blocked or cancelled; the application keeps only the statuses it needs.
- Moves with Back, Next and Finish, and Skip for optional steps; before Next and Finish the application can check the step (also with a server answer).
- Steps in a fixed order, steps open in any order, or rules that open several steps at once after others are complete (parallel steps).
- Horizontal or vertical; in a narrow space the horizontal steps become a compact bar "Step 2 of 5" with a progress line.
- Optionally holds the content of each step (beside, below or under the current step), so the entered data is kept while the user moves.
- Informative mode: the steps only show the progress, without interaction.

### Dependencies

| Dependency | Needed when | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Design system (`design-system.css`) | Always | Colours, type, lines and spacing. |
| Stepper styles (`stepper.css`) | Always | Steps, markers, lines, content and button bar. |
| Button component and `button.css` | `showButtons` | Back, Skip, Next, Finish and the application's actions. |
| Loader component and `loader.css` | `showButtons` with `canLeave` | The line above the button bar while the application checks a step. |
| Font Awesome icon library | Status symbols, `ICON` markers, action icons | Icon glyphs. Loaded by the application page. |
| Tooltip component and `tooltip.css` | `tooltipMode` `TOOLTIP` | Tooltips (the Tooltip module is loaded only then). |

### Not included

The application provides the steps, checks the values of a step, saves the data and shows its own messages (e.g. with Message). Storing the progress between visits, routing (one address per step) and the content of the steps belong to the application.

## For designers

### Structure

```text
div#{id}.ui-stepper.ui-stepper-{horizontal|vertical}.ui-stepper-marker-{number|icon|dot}.ui-stepper-label-{end|below|hidden}.ui-stepper-navigation-{linear|free|none}[.ui-stepper-connectors][.ui-stepper-compact][.ui-stepper-with-content.ui-stepper-content-{separate|inline}][.ui-stepper-busy]
├── div.ui-stepper-compact-bar                                  (compactWhenNarrow; shown in narrow containers instead of the list)
│   ├── span.ui-stepper-compact-text                            ("Step 2 of 4: Payment")
│   └── span.ui-stepper-compact-track > span.ui-stepper-compact-fill
├── div.ui-stepper-body
│   ├── ol.ui-stepper-list  aria-label
│   │   └── li.ui-stepper-step[.ui-stepper-current][.ui-stepper-complete][.ui-stepper-locked][.ui-stepper-disabled]  data-status="{status}"
│   │       ├── button.ui-stepper-trigger  [aria-current="step"] [disabled]   (div.ui-stepper-trigger with navigation NONE)
│   │       │   ├── span.ui-stepper-marker > span.ui-stepper-number | i (icon or status symbol)
│   │       │   └── span.ui-stepper-text
│   │       │       ├── span.ui-stepper-label > span.ui-stepper-optional   (optional steps)
│   │       │       ├── span.ui-stepper-description                       (description)
│   │       │       └── span.ui-stepper-status                            (visually hidden without statusText)
│   │       ├── span.ui-stepper-connector                                 (connectors; not after the last step)
│   │       └── section.ui-stepper-panel [hidden] > div.ui-stepper-item    (showContent, contentPosition INLINE)
│   └── div.ui-stepper-panels > section.ui-stepper-panel [hidden] > div.ui-stepper-item   (showContent, SEPARATE)
├── div.ui-stepper-buttons                                      (showButtons)
│   ├── span.ui-stepper-loader-host → Loader (SMALL bar just above the bar, label for screen readers)   (canLeave)
│   ├── span.ui-stepper-button[data-button="back"] → Button
│   ├── span.ui-stepper-actions > span.ui-stepper-action → Button  (actions)
│   └── span.ui-stepper-forward > span.ui-stepper-button[data-button="skip|next|finish"] → Button   (the ones that do not apply are hidden)
└── div.ui-stepper-live                                         (polite announcements; not with navigation NONE)
```

The marker is a circle with the step number (or the step's icon); a status with a symbol replaces it: done ✓ (filled with the accent colour), skipped (dashed circle), needs attention !, has errors ×, blocked (lock), cancelled (crossed circle, label struck through). The current step has an accent ring and a bold label. The line after a complete step takes the accent colour. Steps that wait for others have a muted label; disabled steps are faded.

### Visual options

| Option | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Orientation | Horizontal, vertical | `ui-stepper-horizontal`, `ui-stepper-vertical` |
| Marker | Number, icon, dot | `ui-stepper-marker-number`, `-icon`, `-dot` |
| Label placement | After the marker, below the marker (horizontal), hidden (tooltip) | `ui-stepper-label-end`, `-below`, `-hidden` |
| Lines between steps | On, off | `ui-stepper-connectors`, — |
| Status text | Hidden (screen readers only), visible | `.ui-stepper-status` with or without `.ui-stepper-visually-hidden` |
| Narrow container (horizontal) | Compact bar, steps | `ui-stepper-compact` |
| Navigation | In order, free, none | `ui-stepper-navigation-linear`, `-free`, `-none` |
| Content | None, separate area, under the current step (vertical) | —, `ui-stepper-with-content` + `ui-stepper-content-separate`, `-inline` |
| Button bar | Off, on | —, `.ui-stepper-buttons` |

### States

| State | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Step | Current | `.ui-stepper-current`, `[aria-current="step"]` |
| Step | Complete, waiting for other steps, disabled | `.ui-stepper-complete`, `.ui-stepper-locked`, `.ui-stepper-disabled` |
| Step status | Not started, in progress, done, skipped, needs attention, has errors, blocked, cancelled | `[data-status="NOT_STARTED"]`, `"IN_PROGRESS"`, `"DONE"`, `"SKIPPED"`, `"WARNING"`, `"ERROR"`, `"BLOCKED"`, `"CANCELLED"` |
| Stepper | Busy (waiting for the application's check) | `ui-stepper-busy`, `[aria-busy="true"]` |

### Styling contract

`stepper.css` has three parts, marked in the stylesheet. Restyle by writing the same selector with a new value in your own stylesheet, inside `@layer overrides` (preferred: library updates keep your changes), or by changing a value in your copy of the stylesheet. After each token come the parts it styles, named by their class without `ui-stepper-` (as in Structure), with the option or state in brackets (joined by “+” when they apply together). Text uses the typography roles of `design-system.css`; border sides are physical (top, right, bottom, left).

**1. Appearance — change freely** (colours, type, borders, corners, motion: only the look changes)

- Colours
  - `--c-text`: stepper
  - `--c-surface-hover`: trigger (hover)
  - `--c-border`: marker (also marker dot), connector
  - `--c-surface`: marker
  - `--c-muted`: marker (also status skipped, status blocked, status cancelled), optional, description, status, label (status cancelled, locked)
  - `--c-accent`: marker (current, status in progress, status done, marker dot + status in progress, marker dot + status done, marker dot + current), connector (complete), compact fill
  - `--c-on-accent`: marker (status done)
  - `--c-warning`: marker (status warning, marker dot + status warning)
  - `--c-warning-soft`: marker (status warning)
  - `--c-warning-text`: marker (status warning), status (status warning)
  - `--c-danger`: marker (status error, marker dot + status error)
  - `--c-danger-soft`: marker (status error)
  - `--c-danger-text`: marker (status error), label (status error), status (status error)
  - `--c-surface-muted`: marker (status blocked, status cancelled), compact track
- Typography
  - `--font-ui`: stepper
  - `--fw-ui`: stepper, optional
  - `--fs-control`: stepper
  - `--lh-compact`: stepper
  - `--fs-caption`: marker, status
  - `--fw-ui-strong`: marker, label (current), compact text
  - `--fs-label`: description, compact text
- Borders and corners
  - `--radius-control`: trigger
  - `--border-thin`: marker (also current)
  - `--radius-pill`: compact track, compact fill
- States and motion
  - `--transition-1`: trigger, marker
  - `--opacity-disabled`: trigger (disabled)

**2. Dimensions — change with care** (sizes and spacing: the component keeps working, its size changes)

- Borders and corners
  - `--border-thick`: connector (horizontal, label below, vertical, vertical + marker dot, horizontal + marker dot, label below + marker dot)
- Spacing
  - `--gap-block`: stepper, step (vertical), body (vertical + content separate, horizontal)
  - `--gap-inline-items`: trigger, connector (horizontal, label below, label below + marker dot), panel (content inline), buttons, actions, forward
  - `--gap-tight`: trigger, connector (horizontal, label below, vertical, vertical + marker dot, horizontal + marker dot, label below + marker dot), panel (content inline), loader host, compact bar
  - `--space-lg-3`: marker, connector (horizontal, label below, vertical), panel (content inline)
  - `--space-md-3`: marker (marker dot), connector (vertical + marker dot, horizontal + marker dot, label below + marker dot)
  - `--space-md-1`: marker (marker dot), connector (vertical + marker dot, horizontal + marker dot, label below + marker dot)
  - `--space-sm-1`: text
  - `--space-sm-2`: text, compact track
  - `--gap-section`: body (vertical + content separate)
- Sizes
  - `--size-md-2`: list (vertical + content separate)

**3. Structure — don't change** (layout, behaviour, states, accessibility)

- States and motion
  - `--focus-outline`: trigger (focus)
  - `--focus-offset`: trigger (focus)

**Set by the component — don't change**

- Variables
  - `--ui-stepper-progress`: share of complete steps, from 0 to 1 (fills the compact bar)

## For AI-assisted development

### Instructions

- Read this README before writing code. Import only from `stepperIndex.js`.
- Check the configuration before adding code; configure instead of building step markup, Back / Next buttons or progress logic.
- Keep business logic (checking a step, saving, where the data goes) in the application: check a step in `canLeave` and show your messages yourself; don't modify the component for application needs.
- Use `navigation:'LINEAR'` (default) for wizards, `after` rules for steps that open together after others, `FREE` when the order does not matter, `NONE` to show the progress of a process the user only follows (set statuses with `setStepStatus()`).
- Keep only the statuses your process needs (`statuses`); set them from the application with `setStepStatus()` (e.g. `ERROR` when the server rejects a step).
- Respect conditional options: `contentPosition` needs `showContent`; `INLINE` and `labelPlacement:'BELOW'` depend on the orientation; `actions`, `onAction` need `showButtons`; nothing interactive applies with `NONE`.
- Application buttons in the bar follow the shared actions contract (guidelines §10.2): pass `actions` and handle `onAction(key, step)`; never add Buttons inside the component yourself.
- Callbacks report user actions only; `goTo()`, `setStepStatus()` and `setStepDisabled()` never fire them.
- Use unique ids (the Stepper's and the steps' within it), and call `destroy()` before rendering into the same container again.

### Safety

- Labels, descriptions and texts are inserted as text; string `content` is inserted as HTML: escape user-provided or external data first.
- Don't remove `aria-current`, the ordered list or the step buttons' names; don't make steps clickable with other elements.
- Don't trust `canLeave` alone for security: the server must check the data of every step again.

### Example prompts

```text
Turn the checkout page into a Stepper with the steps Cart, Address, Gift wrap (optional) and Payment, each holding its existing fields; Next checks the fields of the current step, Finish submits the order.
```

```text
Show the progress of a purchase request with a vertical Stepper in informative mode: Request, Legal review, Finance review, Sign-off, with statuses loaded from /api/requests/{id}/progress.
```

## For developers

### Business analysis

> **Component**: the Stepper itself. **Consumer**: the developer who configures the Stepper in the application's code. **App**: the running application that uses the Stepper; it provides the data, performs the actions and stores the changes.

**Steps**

- App provides the steps in their order, each with a label. <!-- BA-01 -->
- Consumer provides for each step a description, an icon and a status (optional). <!-- BA-02 -->
- Component displays each step with a marker, its label and its description. <!-- BA-03 -->
- Component marks the current step. <!-- BA-04 -->
- Component displays the status of each step with a symbol, a colour and a text for screen readers. <!-- BA-05 -->
  - Consumer chooses to display the status text on the screen (optional). <!-- BA-06 -->
- Consumer chooses the statuses the steps use. <!-- BA-07 -->
- Consumer chooses an optional step. <!-- BA-08 -->
  - Component displays "(Optional)" after its label. <!-- BA-09 -->

**Moving between steps**

- User clicks Next. <!-- BA-10 -->
  - Component asks the App whether the step is complete (optional). <!-- BA-11 -->
    - Component prevents other moves while the App checks. <!-- BA-12 -->
    - Component displays a thin line above the buttons when the check takes longer than a short delay. <!-- BA-13 -->
    - Component keeps the step open when the App refuses. <!-- BA-14 -->
  - Component marks the step as done (optional, on by default). <!-- BA-15 -->
  - Component opens the next step. <!-- BA-16 -->
  - Component reports the new current step to the App. <!-- BA-17 -->
- User clicks Back. <!-- BA-18 -->
  - Component opens the previous step that is open to the user. <!-- BA-19 -->
- User clicks Skip on an optional step. <!-- BA-20 -->
  - Component marks the step as skipped and opens the next step. <!-- BA-21 -->
- User clicks Finish on the last step. <!-- BA-22 -->
  - Component asks the App whether the step is complete (optional). <!-- BA-23 -->
  - Component reports the completion to the App. <!-- BA-24 -->
  - Component disables Finish while a required step is not complete. <!-- BA-25 -->
- User clicks a step that is open to the user. <!-- BA-26 -->
  - Component opens the step. <!-- BA-27 -->
- Component marks a step it opens as in progress (optional, on by default). <!-- BA-28 -->
- Component reports every status it changes to the App. <!-- BA-29 -->

**Order of the steps**

- Consumer chooses steps in a fixed order (on by default). <!-- BA-30 -->
  - Component opens a step when the steps before it are complete. <!-- BA-31 -->
  - Consumer chooses the steps after which a step opens (optional). <!-- BA-32 -->
    - Component opens several steps at once when they wait for the same steps (parallel steps). <!-- BA-33 -->
    - Component exposes the steps a step waits for. <!-- BA-34 -->
- Consumer chooses steps open in any order (optional). <!-- BA-35 -->
- Consumer chooses informative steps without interaction (optional). <!-- BA-36 -->
- App changes the status of a step. <!-- BA-37 -->
- App opens a step. <!-- BA-38 -->
- App disables a step. <!-- BA-39 -->

**Content and buttons**

- Consumer chooses to display the content of each step (optional). <!-- BA-40 -->
  - Component displays only the content of the current step and keeps the others. <!-- BA-41 -->
  - Consumer chooses the content beside or below the steps, or under the current step (vertical). <!-- BA-42 -->
- Consumer enables the button bar with Back, Skip, Next and Finish (optional, on with the content). <!-- BA-43 -->
- Consumer adds the App's own buttons to the bar (optional). <!-- BA-44 -->
  - User clicks such a button. <!-- BA-45 -->
    - Component reports it to the App with the current step. <!-- BA-46 -->

**Look**

- Consumer chooses horizontal or vertical steps. <!-- BA-47 -->
- Consumer chooses a number, an icon or a dot as the marker. <!-- BA-48 -->
- Consumer chooses the label after the marker, below it, or hidden with a tooltip. <!-- BA-49 -->
- Consumer chooses lines between the steps (on by default). <!-- BA-50 -->
- Component displays a compact bar "Step 2 of 5" with a progress line instead of horizontal steps in a narrow space (optional, on by default). <!-- BA-51 -->

**Keyboard additions**

- User presses the arrow keys, Home or End on a step to move between the steps that are open. <!-- BA-52 -->

**Screen readers**

- Component exposes the steps as an ordered list, with the current step, the status and the steps a step waits for. <!-- BA-53 -->
- Component announces the new step after the User moves. <!-- BA-54 -->

**Tooltips**

- Consumer chooses how the step labels when `labelPlacement` is `HIDDEN` shows on hover and keyboard focus: the browser's tooltip, a Tooltip or none (optional, on by default with the browser). <!-- BA-55 -->

### Contracts

**Contracts:** Styling: three parts (Styling contract) · Form field: no (container: `getChildren()`) · Actions: yes (`actions`, `onAction`) · Shared behaviour: yes, additions under Accessibility

### Public API

```js
import { renderStepper, DEFAULT_STEPPER_CONFIG, STEPPER_TOOLTIP_MODES, STEPPER_ORIENTATIONS, STEPPER_MARKERS, STEPPER_LABEL_PLACEMENTS, STEPPER_NAVIGATIONS, STEPPER_CONTENT_POSITIONS, STEPPER_STATUSES } from './stepperIndex.js';

const stepper = renderStepper(container, config); // null after a developer error
```

`container` is a dedicated, consumer-owned element. Rendering replaces its content; `destroy()` clears it.

| Member | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | The configured id. |
| `getCurrent()` | string \| null | Id of the current step (`null` when no step is open, e.g. informative steps without `current`). |
| `goTo(id)` | boolean | Opens a step without `canLeave`, without automatic status and without callbacks (also a step that waits for others). `false` for an unknown (`UNKNOWN_STEP`) or disabled step. |
| `getSteps()` | array | A copy of every step: `{ id, label, status, optional, disabled, available, complete, current }`, in display order. |
| `getStepStatus(id)` | string \| null | The step's status; `null` for an unknown id. |
| `setStepStatus(id, status)` | boolean | Sets a status from `statuses` (no callback); returns whether it changed. A status that is not in `statuses`: `INVALID_STATUS`, no change. A status other than `DONE` or `SKIPPED` makes a passed step incomplete again. |
| `setStepDisabled(id, disabled)` | boolean | Enables or disables a step; returns whether it changed. A disabled current step stays open until the user moves. |
| `setActionDisabled(key, disabled)` | boolean | Enables or disables an application action; `false` (with `UNKNOWN_ACTION`) for an unknown key. |
| `getChildren()` | array | The instances returned by the content render functions, in step order (a Form finds fields through it). |
| `focus()` | boolean | Moves focus to the step button that takes Tab. |
| `destroy()` | — | Removes the listeners, the Buttons and the content, clears the container. |

### Configuration

| Parameter | Type | Default | Allowed values / format | Applies when | Usage / description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | — | Starts with a letter; letters, digits, `_ : . -`; unique in the document | Always | Required. Root element id. |
| `steps` | array | `[]` | `{ id, label, description?, icon?, status?, optional?, disabled?, after?, content? }` | Always | Required, at least one valid step. Display order. Steps without `id` or `label` and duplicate ids are dropped. |
| `steps[].description` | string | `''` | Text | Always | A short line under the label. |
| `steps[].icon` | string | `''` | CSS class names | `ICON` | The marker of an `ICON` Stepper (the number when empty). |
| `steps[].status` | string | `'NOT_STARTED'` | One of `statuses` | Always | Start status (e.g. restored progress). `DONE` and `SKIPPED` make the step complete. |
| `steps[].optional` | boolean | `false` | — | Always | Shows "(Optional)"; the step can be skipped and does not block Finish. |
| `steps[].disabled` | boolean | `false` | — | Always | The step cannot be opened by the user. |
| `steps[].after` | array \| string | previous step | Step ids | `LINEAR` | The steps that must be complete before this one opens; `[]` opens it from the start. Unknown ids are dropped (`UNKNOWN_STEP`); circular rules are dropped (`CIRCULAR_AFTER`). |
| `steps[].content` | array \| string | `[]` | Static HTML strings or functions `(host, stepper) => instance \| null` | `showContent` | The step's content, rendered at start, one host per child. |
| `current` | string | first open step | A step id | Always | The step that starts open. `NONE`: the stage reached (no step is marked without it). |
| `ariaLabel` | string | `texts.stepper` | Text | Always | Name of the step list. |
| `orientation` | string | `'HORIZONTAL'` | `HORIZONTAL`, `VERTICAL` | Always | Direction of the steps. |
| `marker` | string | `'NUMBER'` | `NUMBER`, `ICON`, `DOT` | Always | What the circle shows; `DOT` shows no number and no status symbol. |
| `labelPlacement` | string | `'END'` | `END`, `BELOW`, `HIDDEN` | Always | `BELOW` only with `HORIZONTAL` (otherwise `END`, `OPTION_IGNORED`). `HIDDEN`: the label is the tooltip and stays for screen readers. |
| `connectors` | boolean | `true` | — | Always | Lines between the steps. |
| `statusText` | boolean | `false` | — | Always | Shows the status text (and "Available after: …") under the label; without it, the text is for screen readers only. |
| `compactWhenNarrow` | boolean | `true` | — | `HORIZONTAL` | Below a container width of 36rem, a compact bar "Step 2 of 5: Payment" with a progress line replaces the steps. |
| `navigation` | string | `'LINEAR'` | `LINEAR`, `FREE`, `NONE` | Always | `LINEAR`: a step opens when the steps it waits for are complete. `FREE`: every enabled step opens. `NONE`: the steps only inform (no buttons, no clicks, no callbacks). |
| `statuses` | array | all statuses | `NOT_STARTED`, `IN_PROGRESS`, `DONE`, `SKIPPED`, `WARNING`, `ERROR`, `BLOCKED`, `CANCELLED` | Always | The statuses this Stepper uses; `NOT_STARTED` is always included. Automatic statuses are set only when listed. |
| `autoStatus` | boolean | `true` | — | Not `NONE` | Next and Finish mark the step `DONE`, Skip `SKIPPED`, a step the user opens `IN_PROGRESS` (when it was `NOT_STARTED`). |
| `showContent` | boolean | `false` | — | Not `NONE` | Renders each step's `content` and shows the current one. |
| `contentPosition` | string | `'SEPARATE'` | `SEPARATE`, `INLINE` | `showContent` + `VERTICAL` | `SEPARATE`: one area beside the steps. `INLINE`: under the current step. `HORIZONTAL` always shows the content below the steps (`INLINE`: `OPTION_IGNORED`). |
| `showButtons` | boolean | value of `showContent` | — | Not `NONE` | The button bar: Back, the actions, Skip (optional steps), Next or Finish (on the last enabled step). |
