| `actions` | array | `[]` | `{ key, label, icon?, iconOnly?, hierarchy?, disabled? }` | `showButtons` | Application buttons in the bar after Back (guidelines §10.2); `TERTIARY` by default. Without `onAction` they are disabled (`ACTION_HANDLER_MISSING`). |
| `canLeave` | function | `null` | `(stepId, action, stepper) => boolean \| Promise<boolean>` | Not `NONE` | Asked before Next (`action` `'NEXT'`) and Finish (`'FINISH'`); `false` keeps the step open. A Promise makes the Stepper busy until it settles; a rejected Promise or an exception keeps the step open (`CAN_LEAVE_FAILED`). |
| `tooltipMode` | string | `'TITLE'` | `NONE`, `TITLE`, `TOOLTIP` | Always | How the step labels when `labelPlacement` is `HIDDEN` shows on hover and keyboard focus: not at all, the browser's tooltip (`title`, mouse only) or a Tooltip (also on keyboard focus; needs `tooltip.css`, the Tooltip module is loaded only then). With `TOOLTIP` it also applies to icon-only actions; with `TITLE` or `NONE` they show nothing (as before). |
| `texts.*` | object | English defaults | Text; `{index}`, `{count}`, `{label}`, `{steps}` placeholders | Always | `stepper`, `stepOf`, `announcement`, `optional`, `availableAfter`, `back`, `next`, `finish`, `skip`, `finishBlocked`, `checking` ("Checking the step…", the Loader's label), `statuses.{STATUS}`. |
| `onStepChange` | function | `null` | `(stepId, { previousId, reason }, stepper) => {}` | Not `NONE` | See Callbacks. |
| `onStatusChange` | function | `null` | `(stepId, status, stepper) => {}` | Not `NONE` | See Callbacks. |
| `onFinish` | function | `null` | `(stepper) => {}` | Not `NONE` | See Callbacks. |
| `onAction` | function | `null` | `(key, step, stepper) => {}` | `actions` | See Callbacks. |

Next opens the first open step after the current one that follows from it or is still to do (complete parallel steps are passed over), otherwise the first open step before it that is still to do. Back opens the nearest open step before the current one. Finish replaces Next on the last enabled step and is disabled (with the description `texts.finishBlocked`) while a required, enabled step other than the current one is not complete. A step is complete when the user passed it with Next, Finish or Skip, or when its status is `DONE` or `SKIPPED`. The bar's Buttons are size `MEDIUM`, like Form's, because they finish a page-level task. With `canLeave`, a Loader line appears just above the bar while a Promise from `canLeave` is pending longer than 0.4 s. Options that do not apply are ignored with `OPTION_IGNORED`.

### Callbacks

| Callback | Arguments | Fires when | Does not fire when |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `onStepChange` | `(stepId, { previousId, reason }, stepper)` | The user opens another step; `reason` is `'NEXT'`, `'BACK'`, `'SKIP'` or `'SELECT'` (a click on a step). Runs after `onStatusChange`. | `goTo()`; refused `canLeave`; busy Stepper. |
| `onStatusChange` | `(stepId, status, stepper)` | A user action changes a status automatically (`autoStatus`): `DONE` (Next, Finish), `SKIPPED` (Skip), `IN_PROGRESS` (a step the user opens). | `setStepStatus()`; statuses not in `statuses`. |
| `onFinish` | `(stepper)` | The user presses Finish and `canLeave` agrees (after the step is marked `DONE`). | Finish disabled; refused `canLeave`. |
| `onAction` | `(key, step, stepper)` | An application action is pressed; `step` as an entry of `getSteps()` (the current step). | Disabled actions; busy Stepper. |
| `canLeave` | `(stepId, action, stepper)` | Before Next and Finish (configuration function, not a report). | Back, Skip, clicks on steps, `goTo()`. |

### Errors

Stepper has no user-facing errors: checking a step is the application's job. Developer errors prevent rendering; warnings are logged and rendering continues. Console format: `Stepper "id" [LABEL]: message`.

| Label | Severity | Cause |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CONTAINER_REQUIRED` | error | No container passed. |
| `ID_REQUIRED` | error | `id` is empty. |
| `UNSAFE_ID` | error | `id` is not DOM-safe. |
| `DUPLICATE_ID` | error | An element with the same id already exists in the document. |
| `STEPS_REQUIRED` | error | `steps` is missing, empty, or has no valid step. |
| `INVALID_OPTION` | warning | Invalid enumerated value, or `statuses` that is not an array; the default is used. |
| `UNKNOWN_STATUS` | warning | A `statuses` entry that is not a status; dropped. |
| `OPTION_IGNORED` | warning | An option that does not apply (see Applies when), `BELOW` or `INLINE` with the other orientation, `after` without `LINEAR`, `content` without `showContent`. |
| `INVALID_ICON_CLASS` | warning | Invalid class names removed from an icon option. |
| `INVALID_STEP` | warning | A step without `id` or `label`; dropped. |
| `DUPLICATE_STEP_ID` | warning | A repeated step id; the later step is dropped. |
| `UNKNOWN_STEP` | warning | An id in `after`, `current`, `goTo()` or another method that is not a step. |
| `INVALID_STATUS` | warning | A status that is not in `statuses` (`steps[].status`: `NOT_STARTED` is used; `setStepStatus()`: no change). |
| `CIRCULAR_AFTER` | warning | `after` rules that lead back to their step; the rule is dropped. |
| `INVALID_CHILD` | warning | Content that is neither a string nor a function; ignored. |
| `CAN_LEAVE_FAILED` | warning | `canLeave` threw or its Promise was rejected; the step stays open. |
| `INVALID_ACTION` | warning | An action without `key` or `label`; dropped. |
| `DUPLICATE_ACTION_KEY` | warning | A repeated action key; the later action is dropped. |
| `UNKNOWN_ACTION` | warning | `setActionDisabled()` with an unknown key. |
| `ACTION_HANDLER_MISSING` | warning | `actions` without `onAction`; the action Buttons are rendered disabled. |

### Accessibility

- The steps are an ordered list named by `ariaLabel` (`texts.stepper`); the current step has `aria-current="step"`; each step button is named by its label, "(Optional)" and description, and described by its status and the steps it waits for ("Available after: Legal review").
- Steps that are not open are disabled buttons; one step button is in the Tab order (the current one); Left / Right (Up / Down when vertical, mirrored in right-to-left), Home and End move between the open steps.
- After a user move the new step is announced politely ("Step 2 of 4: Payment"); with content, focus moves to the step's panel (a region named by the step label).
- While `canLeave` answers, the Stepper sets `aria-busy` and ignores clicks; the Buttons keep their focus; after the Loader's delay a line appears above the bar and "Checking the step…" is announced.
- Status is shown by symbol and colour together, and by text for screen readers (or on screen with `statusText`); cancelled steps are also struck through.
- The compact bar keeps the step and the count as text; the progress line is decorative.
- Informative steps (`NONE`) are plain list entries, not buttons.

### Examples

Checkout wizard with content, a server check before Payment is left, and Finish:

```js
const checkout = renderStepper(host,
{
    id:'checkout', showContent:true,
    steps:
    [
        { id:'cart', label:'Cart', content:[ h => renderCart(h) ] },
        { id:'address', label:'Address', content:[ h => ( fields.address = renderTextInput(h,{ id:'street', name:'street', label:'Street' }) ) ] },
        { id:'gift', label:'Gift wrap', optional:true, content:[ '<p>Choose paper and card.</p>' ] },
        { id:'payment', label:'Payment', content:[ h => renderPayment(h) ] }
    ],
    canLeave:( stepId ) => ( stepId === 'address' ? fields.address.validate().valid : stepId === 'payment' ? api.checkCard().then(result => result.ok) : true ),
    onFinish:() => api.placeOrder(),
    texts:{ finish:'Place order' }
});
```

Approval with three reviews in any order after the request, and the sign-off after all of them:

```js
renderStepper(host,
{
    id:'approval', orientation:'VERTICAL', statusText:true, showButtons:true,
    statuses:[ 'IN_PROGRESS', 'DONE', 'ERROR' ],
    steps:
    [
        { id:'request', label:'Request' },
        { id:'legal', label:'Legal review', after:[ 'request' ] },
        { id:'finance', label:'Finance review', after:[ 'request' ] },
        { id:'security', label:'Security review', after:[ 'request' ], optional:true },
        { id:'signoff', label:'Sign-off', after:[ 'legal', 'finance', 'security' ] }
    ],
    onStatusChange:( stepId, status ) => api.saveProgress(stepId,status)
});
```

Order tracking (informative):

```js
const tracking = renderStepper(host,
{
    id:'order-1042', navigation:'NONE', marker:'ICON', statusText:true, current:'shipped',
    statuses:[ 'DONE', 'WARNING' ],
    steps:
    [
        { id:'ordered', label:'Ordered', icon:'fa-solid fa-receipt', status:'DONE' },
        { id:'shipped', label:'Shipped', icon:'fa-solid fa-truck', description:'Delayed at the depot', status:'WARNING' },
        { id:'delivered', label:'Delivered', icon:'fa-solid fa-house' }
    ]
});
tracking.setStepStatus('shipped','DONE'); tracking.goTo('delivered');
```

### Files

| File | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `stepperIndex.js` | Public entry point; the only import surface. |
| `stepperConfig.js` | Defaults, allowed values, normalization of the configuration, steps, statuses and actions, developer validation. |
| `stepperComponent.js` | Lifecycle, moving between steps, `canLeave` (with the Loader line), automatic statuses, content, Buttons, focus and announcements, runtime API. |
| `stepperState.js` | Current step, statuses, disabled and passed steps; which steps are open, where Next and Back lead, whether Finish is allowed; circular rules. |
| `stepperHTML.js` | Step list, markers, compact bar, panels, button bar and the Loader host. |
| `stepperEvents.js` | Clicks on steps and arrow keys between them. |
| `stepperErrors.js` | Developer error and warning catalog. |
| `stepper.css` | Presentation of the steps, markers, lines, compact bar, content and button bar. |
| `stepperTESTS.md` | Test plan: the cases that prove this README (automatic ones in `tests/components/stepper.test.mjs`). |


<!-- ===== source/components-js/table/tableREADME.md ===== -->

# Table

## For business

### Overview

Table shows lists of records (orders, customers, invoices) in rows and columns. It fits the screen before it is shown, and again when the space changes: it chooses which columns are visible, how many rows fit on a page, and on small screens turns each row into a card. Users sort columns, move between pages, select rows and act on them; the application decides what the actions do.

### When to use

- Use it for lists of records with several attributes: orders, customers, invoices.
- Use TreeView for data organised in levels, and Pagination with the application's own layout for lists that are not tables.

### Key features

- Small tables sorted and paged in the browser; large tables loaded page by page from the server.
- Columns that fit the screen by importance, and rows that become cards on narrow screens; both adapt when the window is resized.
- Sorting that follows the user's language and compares numbers by value.
- Optional row selection, including all items, with buttons for the selected rows.
- A counts line: items, rows visible now and selected rows.
- While a page loads, the rows already shown stay (dimmed) and a thin line runs under the column header, so the table does not jump.

### Dependencies

| Dependency | Needed when | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Design system (`design-system.css`) | Always | Colours, column widths, spacing and typography. |
| Table styles (`table.css`) | Always | Table, bar, cards. |
| Button component and `button.css` | Always | Selection links and actions, Retry. |
| Message component and `message.css` | Always | "No data" and load-error messages. |
| Pagination component and `pagination.css` | Pagination display | Page navigation. |
| Loader component and `loader.css` | Always | The line under the column header while data loads. |
| Font Awesome icon library | Always | Sort and button icons. Loaded by the application page. |
| ActionMenu, other components | When used in cells | Rendered by the application through `render()`. |
| Tooltip component and `tooltip.css` | `tooltipMode` `TOOLTIP` | Tooltips (the Tooltip module is loaded only then). |

### Not included

The application loads data (server mode), performs row and selection actions (with confirmations), formats dates and amounts (through `format`), and remembers user preferences. Column filters in the header, expandable rows, grouping, totals, inline editing, resizing and reordering, export and virtual scrolling are not part of this version.

## For designers

### Structure

```text
div#{id}.ui-table[.ui-table-sticky][.ui-table-cards][.ui-table-hover][.ui-table-alternate]
├── div.ui-table-bar
│   ├── span.ui-table-counts                      "600 items, 121–144 visible now, 12 selected"
│   ├── span.ui-table-selection-links → Buttons  "Select all 600 items", "Clear selection"   (selectable)
│   └── span.ui-table-actions > span.ui-table-action → Button   selection actions (shown with a selection)
├── table.ui-table-grid  (fixed layout; col widths from --table-column-* tokens)
│   ├── thead > tr > th.ui-table-select-cell (page checkbox) + th.ui-table-counter "#" + th[aria-sort] > button.ui-table-sort
│   │   └── tr.ui-table-progress > td.ui-table-progress-cell > div.ui-table-loader-host → Loader (EDGE: a line under the header while data loads)
│   └── tbody > tr[.ui-table-row-selected]
│       ├── td.ui-table-select-cell > input.ui-table-select-row
│       ├── td.ui-table-counter
│       └── td.ui-table-align-{start|center|end}[.ui-table-always] > span.ui-table-truncate[title]  (or consumer content)
│       tr.ui-table-message-{empty|loading|error}   ("Loading…" text, or → Message: INFO INLINE "No data"; INFO load error, BLOCK with Retry in server mode)
└── div.ui-table-footer > div.ui-table-pagination-host → Pagination
```

Headers are muted, bold and small; rows are separated by thin borders; the selected row uses the selected background; the counter is muted and aligned to the end. In card mode (`.ui-table-cards`) the header row is hidden (except the page checkbox) and each row becomes a bordered card of label/value pairs. With `.ui-table-sticky`, the bar sticks at `--page-sticky-offset` and the column header right below it, with the Loader line under the header. While data loads after rows were shown (`.ui-table-loading`), the rows are dimmed.

### Visual options

| Option | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Column width | S, M, L, XL | `--table-column-s`, `-m`, `-l`, `-xl` on `col` |
| Alignment | Start, center, end | `ui-table-align-start`, `-center`, `-end` |
| Row | Hover, alternate | `ui-table-hover`, `ui-table-alternate` |
| Layout | Table, cards | —, `ui-table-cards` |
| Sticky bar and header | Off, on | —, `ui-table-sticky` |

### States

| State | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Sort | None, ascending, descending | `th[aria-sort]`, icon `fa-up-down` (↕), `fa-arrow-up` (↑), `fa-arrow-down` (↓) |
| Row | Selected | `ui-table-row-selected` |
| Messages | Empty, loading (no rows shown yet), error | `ui-table-message-empty`, `-loading`, `-error` |
| Table | Loading with rows shown (rows dimmed, the Loader line runs) | `ui-table-loading`, `table[aria-busy="true"]` |

### Styling contract

`table.css` has three parts, marked in the stylesheet. Restyle by writing the same selector with a new value in your own stylesheet, inside `@layer overrides` (preferred: library updates keep your changes), or by changing a value in your copy of the stylesheet. After each token come the parts it styles, named by their class without `ui-table-` (as in Structure), with the option or state in brackets (joined by “+” when they apply together). Text uses the typography roles of `design-system.css`; border sides are physical (top, right, bottom, left).

**1. Appearance — change freely** (colours, type, borders, corners, motion: only the look changes)

- Colours
  - `--c-surface`: bar, grid, header cell
  - `--c-muted`: counts, header cell, counter, sort (icon), cell (message, cards)
  - `--c-border`: header cell (also sticky), cell, row (cards)
  - `--c-accent`: sort (icon + sorted)
  - `--c-surface-alt`: row (alternate)
  - `--c-info-soft`: row (hover)
  - `--c-selected`: row selected, row (hover + row selected)
- Typography
  - `--font-ui`: table
  - `--fw-ui`: table
  - `--fs-label`: counts, grid, cell (cards)
  - `--fs-caption`: header cell, sort (icon)
  - `--fw-ui-strong`: header cell, cell (cards)
- Borders and corners
  - `--border-thin`: header cell (also sticky), cell, row (cards)
  - `--radius-control`: row (cards)
- States and motion
  - `--opacity-muted`: cell (loading)
  - `--transition-1`: cell (loading)

**2. Dimensions — change with care** (sizes and spacing: the component keeps working, its size changes)

- Spacing
  - `--gap-inline-items`: bar, selection links, actions, header cell, cell (also cards), row (cards)
  - `--gap-tight`: bar, header cell, cell, sort, row (cards)
  - `--gap-block`: cell (message)
- Sizes
  - `--control-height`: bar

**3. Structure — don't change** (layout, behaviour, states, accessibility)

- States and motion
  - `--focus-outline`: sort (focus)
  - `--focus-offset`: sort (focus)
- Spacing
  - `--page-sticky-offset`: bar (sticky), header cell (sticky), progress cell (sticky)

**Set by the component — don't change**

- Variables
  - `--ui-table-col`: width of each column (a `--table-column-*` token, from the column's `width`)
  - `--ui-table-bar-height`: height of the sticky bar, so the column header stays below it (measured)
  - `--ui-table-head-height`: height of the column header, so the Loader line stays below it (measured)

**Used by the code** (the component's code names these tokens; change the token to change the result)

- Tokens
  - `--table-column-select`: width of the selection column
  - `--table-column-counter`: width of the row-number column
  - `--table-column-s`, `--table-column-m`, `--table-column-l`, `--table-column-xl`: column widths `S`, `M`, `L`, `XL`
  - `--page-sticky-offset`: read: space taken by a sticky AppHeader
  - `--control-height`, `--gap-form-field`: read: height of the bar below the table

## For AI-assisted development

### Instructions

- Read this README before writing code. Import only from `tableIndex.js`.
- Use `dataMode:'CLIENT'` (default) for small data sets passed in `rows`; use `'SERVER'` for large ones: load the requested page in `onDataRequest({ page, pageSize, sort })` and call `table.setRows(pageRows, totalItems)` (or `table.setError()` on failure).
- Every row needs a unique `id` when `selectable` is on.
- Mark the identifying columns `priority:'ALWAYS'`; give the others a priority (1 = most important) and a width (`S`–`XL`); add `compact` views (narrower width and shorter format) for columns such as dates.
- Put values' formatting in `format(value, row)` (plain text, escaped); put links, icon Buttons and ActionMenus in `render(host, row, context)` and return the instance (or an object with `destroy()`), so Table cleans up when the page or the layout changes.
- Never make whole rows clickable; actions belong in cells.
- Application buttons follow the shared actions contract (guidelines §10.2): pass `selectionActions` (`{ key, label, icon?, iconOnly?, hierarchy?, disabled? }`) and handle `onSelectionAction(key, selection)`; never create Buttons yourself inside the component.
- Handle selections in `onSelectionAction(key, selection)`: `scope:'IDS'` lists the ids; `scope:'ALL'` means every item except `excludedIds` — apply it on the server in server mode.
- Leave `itemsPerPage` empty for the automatic number of rows, or set a fixed number.
- Give each table a unique, DOM-safe `id` and `label`, and call `destroy()` before rendering into the same container again.

### Safety

- `format()` output is escaped; `render()` writes into the cell directly — escape any data you insert as HTML there.
- Check permissions and the "all items" scope on the server before bulk actions.
- Never remove `aria-sort`, the checkbox names or the table label.

### Example prompts

```text
Show the orders in a server-side Table with order number (link to the order page), customer, e-mail (mailto link), date (short date when space is tight), amount (euro, aligned to the end), status and actions (Edit and View icon buttons plus a "more" menu); make rows selectable with Export and Delete for the selection.
```

```text
Show a small client-side Table of the team members with name and role always visible, e-mail and phone only on wide screens, sorted by name.
```

## For developers

### Business analysis

> **Component**: the Table itself. **Consumer**: the developer who configures the Table in the application's code. **App**: the running application that uses the Table; it provides the data, performs the actions and stores the changes.

**Data**

- App provides all rows of a small table. <!-- BA-01 -->
  - Component sorts and pages them. <!-- BA-02 -->
- Component requests one page at a time from the App for a large table. <!-- BA-03 -->
  - Component displays a thin line under the column header while the page loads (after a short delay). <!-- BA-04 -->
  - Component keeps the rows already shown, dimmed and unavailable, until the new page arrives. <!-- BA-05 -->
  - Component displays "Loading…" in the table when no rows are shown yet. <!-- BA-06 -->
  - Component displays an error with a Retry button when loading fails. <!-- BA-07 -->

**Counts and row numbers**

- Component displays a line above the table with the number of items, the rows visible now and the selection, e.g. "600 items, 121–144 visible now, 12 selected". <!-- BA-08 -->
- Component displays row numbers as shown, continuing across pages, whatever the sort. <!-- BA-09 -->

**Sorting**

- User clicks a column header. <!-- BA-10 -->
  - Component sorts the column ascending, then descending, then back to the original order. <!-- BA-11 -->
- Component sorts text in the user's language, ignoring upper and lower case. <!-- BA-12 -->
- Component sorts numbers inside text by value, e.g. "ORD-9" before "ORD-10", and number and date columns by value. <!-- BA-13 -->
- Consumer provides the language rules for sorting and for the digit grouping of counts (optional; the page language by default). <!-- BA-14 -->

**Selection** (optional)

- User clicks the checkbox of a row. <!-- BA-15 -->
  - Component selects or clears the row and reports the selection to the App. <!-- BA-16 -->
- User clicks the header checkbox. <!-- BA-17 -->
  - Component selects the rows of the current page, and displays "Select all 600 items". <!-- BA-18 -->
  - User clicks "Select all 600 items". <!-- BA-19 -->
  - Component selects all items of the table. <!-- BA-20 -->
- User clicks "Clear selection". <!-- BA-21 -->
  - Component clears the selection. <!-- BA-22 -->
- Consumer adds buttons for the selected rows, e.g. Export, Delete. <!-- BA-23 -->
  - Component displays them in the counts line while rows are selected. <!-- BA-24 -->
  - User clicks a button. <!-- BA-25 -->
  - Component reports the action and the selection to the App. <!-- BA-26 -->
  - App performs the action. <!-- BA-27 -->

**Cells**

- Component reports no action for a click on a row; actions are inside the cells. <!-- BA-28 -->
- Consumer provides the cell content: values, links, icon buttons or a "more" menu. <!-- BA-29 -->
- Component shortens long texts with "…". <!-- BA-30 -->
  - User hovers over a shortened text. <!-- BA-31 -->
  - Component displays the full text as a tooltip. <!-- BA-32 -->

**Fitting the screen**

- Consumer chooses the columns that are always visible, and an importance order and a width (S, M, L, XL) for the others. <!-- BA-33 -->
- Component displays narrower views of columns first, e.g. a short date, then hides the least important columns, before the table appears. <!-- BA-34 -->
  - Component keeps this choice while the space for the table stays the same. <!-- BA-35 -->
  - Component adapts this choice when the space for the table changes, e.g. when the window is resized or a phone is turned, and keeps the data, the sort, the page and the selection. <!-- BA-42 -->
- Component displays each row as a card on narrow screens (below 40rem), with the always-visible columns. <!-- BA-36 -->
- Component displays as many rows per page as fit the screen height, rounded down to a multiple of 5 (at least 5), or a fixed number chosen by the Consumer. <!-- BA-37 -->
  - Component displays the page navigation at the bottom right. <!-- BA-38 -->
- Component keeps the counts line and the column headers visible while the page scrolls, below the page's own sticky header (optional). <!-- BA-39 -->

**Look** (optional)

- Component displays every second row in light grey, the row under the pointer in light blue, and selected rows in the brand tint. <!-- BA-40 -->

**Tooltips**

- Consumer chooses how the full text of cut-off cells shows on hover and keyboard focus: the browser's tooltip, a Tooltip or none (optional, on by default with the browser). <!-- BA-41 -->

### Contracts

**Contracts:** Styling: three parts (Styling contract) · Form field: no · Actions: yes (`selectionActions`, `onSelectionAction`) · Shared behaviour: yes, additions under Accessibility

### Public API

```js
import { renderTable, DEFAULT_TABLE_CONFIG, TABLE_TOOLTIP_MODES, TABLE_DATA_MODES, TABLE_DISPLAY_MODES, TABLE_COLUMN_TYPES, TABLE_ALIGNMENTS, TABLE_COLUMN_WIDTHS } from './tableIndex.js';

const table = renderTable(container, config); // null after a developer error
```

`container` is a dedicated, consumer-owned element; its width decides the layout, when the table is rendered and again whenever that width changes. Rendering replaces its content; `destroy()` clears it.

| Member | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | The configured id. |
| `setRows(rows, totalItems)` | — | Client: replaces all rows. Server: the rows of the requested page and the total number of items. |
| `setLoading()` | — | Shows the loading state: the Loader line, and the rows already shown dimmed (or the "Loading…" row when none are shown). |
| `setError(message?)` | — | Shows the load error (default text) as an INFO Message — announced — with a Retry action in server mode that requests the page again. |
| `getSelection()` | object | `{ scope:'IDS' \| 'ALL', ids, excludedIds, count }` (in client mode `ids` also lists all selected ids for `ALL`). |
| `setActionDisabled(key, disabled)` | boolean | Enables or disables an action Button; `false` (with `UNKNOWN_ACTION`) for an unknown key. |
| `clearSelection()` | — | Clears the selection (reports it). |
| `getSort()` / `setSort(field, direction)` | object / — | Current sort `{ field, direction:'ASC' \| 'DESC' \| null }`; setting it goes back to page 1. |
| `getPage()` / `setPage(page)` | number / — | Current page; moves to a page (server: requests it). |
| `getItemsPerPage()` | number | Rows per page in use (automatic or explicit). |
| `getVisibleColumns()` | array | Fields of the visible columns for the container's current width. |
| `destroy()` | — | Removes listeners, the resize observer, cell components, Buttons and the Pagination, clears the container. |

### Configuration

Enumerated values are canonical UPPER_CASE and accepted case-insensitively. An invalid value produces an `INVALID_OPTION` warning and the default is used.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Allowed values / format | Applies when | Usage / description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | — | Starts with a letter; letters, digits, `_ : . -`; unique in the document | Always | Required. |
| `label` | string | `''` | Text | Always | Accessible name of the table (recommended). |
| `columns` | array | `[]` | See Columns | Always | Required, at least one column. |
| `rows` | array | `[]` | Objects with `id` | `CLIENT` | Initial rows. |
| `dataMode` | string | `'CLIENT'` | `CLIENT`, `SERVER` | Always | Who holds, sorts and pages the data; see CLIENT and SERVER data below. |
| `displayMode` | string | `'PAGINATION'` | `PAGINATION`, `SCROLL` | Always | Pages with Pagination, or all rows (`SERVER` always pages). |
| `itemsPerPage` | number \| null | `null` (automatic) | Integer ≥ 1 | `PAGINATION` | Fixed rows per page; automatic = rows fitting the screen height, rounded down to 5, minimum 5. |
| `selectable` | boolean | `false` | — | Always | Checkbox column, selection links and actions. |
| `selectionActions` | array | `[]` | `{ key, label, icon?, iconOnly?, hierarchy?, disabled? }` | `selectable` | Application buttons (guidelines §10.2) shown in the bar when rows are selected; SECONDARY by default; `iconOnly` shows only the icon (the label is its name). Without `onSelectionAction` they are disabled (`ACTION_HANDLER_MISSING`). |
| `stickyHeader` | boolean | `true` | — | Always | The bar and the column header stick below `--page-sticky-offset`. |
| `rowHover` / `alternateRows` | boolean | `true` / `false` | — | Always | Row highlight on hover; alternating backgrounds. |
| `locale` | string | page language | BCP 47 tag, e.g. `'en'`, `'ro'`, `'de-AT'` | Always | Optional. The language whose rules Table uses to sort text columns and to write numbers. When empty, Table uses the page language (`<html lang>`), then the browser language. For example: • Language-specific sorting: in English (`en`) or German (`de`), names such as “Åsa” and “Örjan” sort with A and O; in Swedish (`sv`), they sort after Z. • Number format: 12000 items is written “12,000” in English, “12.000” in German and “12 000” in Swedish. |
| `tooltipMode` | string | `'TITLE'` | `NONE`, `TITLE`, `TOOLTIP` | Always | How the full text of cut-off cells (`TOOLTIP`: only when it is cut off) shows on hover and keyboard focus: not at all, the browser's tooltip (`title`, mouse only) or a Tooltip (also on keyboard focus; needs `tooltip.css`, the Tooltip module is loaded only then). With `TOOLTIP` it also applies to icon-only selection actions; with `TITLE` or `NONE` they show nothing (as before). |
| `texts.*` | string | English defaults | Text | Always | `items` ("{count} items"), `itemsSingular`, `visible` ("{from}–{to} visible now"), `selected`, `selectAll` ("Select all {count} items"), `clearSelection`, `noData`, `loading` (the "Loading…" row and the Loader's label), `loadError`, `retry`, `selectPage`, `selectRow` ("Select row {number}"), `rowNumber` ("#"), `pagination` (Pagination name). |
| `onDataRequest` | function | `null` | `({ page, pageSize, sort }, table) => {}` | `SERVER` | Load the page and call `setRows()` or `setError()`. |
| `onSelectionChange` | function | `null` | `(selection, table) => {}` | `selectable` | Selection changed. |
| `onSelectionAction` | function | `null` | `(key, selection, table) => {}` | `selectionActions` | A selection action Button was pressed. |

### CLIENT and SERVER data

The difference is **where the rows live and who sorts and pages them**.

| | `CLIENT` (default) | `SERVER` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Where the rows are | All rows are in the browser: the application passes them once in `rows` (or later with `setRows(rows)`). | Only the current page is in the browser; the rest stays on the server (database, API). |
| Who sorts and pages | Table, in the browser: instantly, without asking anyone. | The server: on every page change or sort, Table calls `onDataRequest({ page, pageSize, sort })`; the application asks the server for that page and passes it with `setRows(pageRows, totalItems)`. |
| What the user sees while waiting | Nothing: changes are immediate. | A line under the column header and the previous rows dimmed until the page arrives ("Loading…" in the table for the first page); on failure the application calls `setError()` and the user gets a Retry button. |
| Item count ("600 items") | Counted from `rows`. | The `totalItems` the server reports. |
| Sorting of text | With the user's language rules (`locale`). | The server's own order (its database collation). |
| "Select all 600 items" | Reported as `scope:'ALL'` with `excludedIds`; the application has every row and can apply the action itself. | Reported the same way, but the browser does not have all rows: the server must apply the action to "all except `excludedIds`". |
| Scrolling through all rows (`displayMode:'SCROLL'`) | Possible. | Not possible: always pages. |
| Use it for | Small, complete data sets, up to a few hundred rows (e.g. the members of a team, the lines of one order). | Large or growing data (e.g. all orders, all customers), or data that must stay on the server for security. |

Rule of thumb: if loading all rows at once is quick and they fit in memory, use `CLIENT`; otherwise use `SERVER`. Changing the mode later does not change how the table looks to the user, only who does the work.

### Columns

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `field` | string | — | Required, unique; the row property. |
| `label` | string | `field` | Header text (also the card label). |
| `type` | string | `'TEXT'` | `TEXT`, `NUMBER`, `DATE`: sort order (and `NUMBER` aligns to the end). |
| `sortable` | boolean | `true` | Header sort button. |
| `alignment` | string | `START` (`END` for numbers) | `START`, `CENTER`, `END`. |
| `priority` | string \| number | `1` | `'ALWAYS'` (never hidden, shown in cards) or 1, 2, 3… (higher numbers are hidden first). If no column is `ALWAYS`, the first one becomes it. |
| `width` | string | `'M'` | `S`, `M`, `L`, `XL` (design tokens). |
| `compact` | object | `null` | `{ width, format }`: narrower view used first when space is short. |
| `format` | function | `null` | `(value, row) => text`, escaped; not called for empty values. |
| `render` | function | `null` | `(host, row, { rowIndex, number, compact, table }) => instance \| null`; renders anything into the cell (links, Buttons, ActionMenu); returned instances are destroyed when the rows change. |
| `truncate` | boolean | `true` | Shortens long text with "…" and a tooltip (text cells). |

Layout decisions (visible columns, compact views, cards) are taken when the table is rendered and again whenever the container's width changes (window resized, phone turned, a side panel opened or closed). Each time, the table keeps its data, sort, page and selection, keeps keyboard focus on a sort button or row checkbox (when that element is gone or hidden, for example a header in card mode, focus moves to the table itself), and renders the components in `render()` cells again (their `destroy()` is called first; `context.compact` tells them which view to show). A message shown instead of rows ("Loading…", no data, a load error) stays as it is, so it is not announced again. Rows per page are decided once, at render time, from the window height, so the pages do not shift while the user reads; render the table again for a new page size.

### Callbacks

| Callback | Arguments | Fires when | Does not fire when |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `onDataRequest` | `({ page, pageSize, sort }, table)` | Server mode: first display, page change, sort change, Retry. | Client mode. |
| `onSelectionChange` | `(selection, table)` | A checkbox, "Select all", "Clear selection" or `clearSelection()`. | Page or sort changes (the selection is kept). |
| `onSelectionAction` | `(key, selection, table)` | A selection action Button. | — |

### Errors

Table has no user errors of its own; loading errors are shown through `setError()`. Developer errors prevent rendering (`renderTable()` returns `null`); warnings are logged and rendering continues. Console format: `Table "id" [LABEL]: message`.

| Label | Severity | Cause |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CONTAINER_REQUIRED` | error | No container passed. |
| `ID_REQUIRED` | error | `id` is empty. |
| `UNSAFE_ID` | error | `id` is not DOM-safe. |
| `DUPLICATE_ID` | error | An element with the same id already exists in the document. |
| `COLUMNS_REQUIRED` | error | No column with a field. |
| `INVALID_COLUMN` | warning | A column without field; dropped. |
| `DUPLICATE_COLUMN_FIELD` | warning | Duplicate field; dropped. |
| `NO_ALWAYS_COLUMN` | warning | No `ALWAYS` column; the first column becomes one. |
| `INVALID_OPTION` | warning | Invalid enumerated value, number or `locale` tag (the page language is used). |
| `OPTION_IGNORED` | warning | Option that does not apply (e.g. `SCROLL` with `SERVER`, `itemsPerPage` with `SCROLL`, actions without `selectable`). |
| `INVALID_ICON_CLASS` | warning | An action icon with invalid class tokens; they are dropped. |
| `INVALID_ACTION` | warning | An action without key or label; dropped. |
| `DUPLICATE_ACTION_KEY` | warning | A duplicate action key; the later action is dropped. |
| `UNKNOWN_ACTION` | warning | `setActionDisabled()` names no action. |
| `ACTION_HANDLER_MISSING` | warning | Actions without `onSelectionAction`; their Buttons are rendered disabled. |
| `ROW_ID_MISSING` | warning | Rows without `id` while `selectable`. |
| `DUPLICATE_ROW_ID` | warning | The same `id` on several rows while `selectable`. |

### Accessibility

- A real `<table>` with a label, column headers and `aria-sort` on sortable headers; sort controls are buttons, so keyboard use needs no extra keys; focus stays on the sort button after sorting (the header is not redrawn).
- Checkboxes have names ("Select all rows on this page", "Select row 121"); the page checkbox shows the partly-selected state.
- Rows are not clickable; actions are links and buttons inside cells, reachable with Tab.
- `aria-busy` while loading; the rows kept while a page loads are inert; the Loader announces "Loading…" when the line appears; "Loading…" (first page) is a text row; "No data" and load errors are INFO Messages inside the table area (load errors are announced politely).
- Truncated text keeps the full text as a tooltip (a native tooltip: not shown on touch screens).
- Card mode keeps the column labels next to the values.

### Examples

Server-side orders table with cell actions and selection actions:

```js
const table = renderTable(tableHost,
{
    id:'orders', label:'Orders', dataMode:'SERVER', selectable:true,
    selectionActions:[ { key:'export', label:'Export', icon:'fa-solid fa-file-export' }, { key:'delete', label:'Delete', icon:'fa-solid fa-trash' } ],
    columns:[
        { field:'id', label:'Order', priority:'ALWAYS', width:'S', render:( host, row ) => { host.innerHTML = `<a href="/orders/${encodeURIComponent(row.id)}">${escapeHTML(row.id)}</a>`; return null; } },
        { field:'customer', label:'Customer', priority:'ALWAYS' },
        { field:'date', label:'Date', type:'DATE', priority:2, format:formatLongDate, compact:{ width:'S', format:formatShortDate } },
        { field:'amount', label:'Amount', type:'NUMBER', priority:1, width:'S', format:formatEuro },
        { field:'actions', label:'Actions', priority:'ALWAYS', sortable:false, render:( host, row ) => renderActionMenu(host,{ id:`more-${row.id}`, label:`More actions for order ${row.id}`, items:orderActions(row) },( key ) => handleOrderAction(key,row)) }
    ],
    onDataRequest:async ( { page, pageSize, sort }, table ) =>
    {
        try { const result = await api.orders({ page, pageSize, sort }); table.setRows(result.items,result.total); }
        catch { table.setError(); }
    },
    onSelectionAction:( key, selection ) => api.bulk(key,selection)   // { scope:'IDS', ids } or { scope:'ALL', excludedIds }
});
```

### Files

| File | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `tableIndex.js` | Public entry point; the only import surface. |
| `tableConfig.js` | Defaults, column normalization, developer validation, row id checks. |
| `tableComponent.js` | Layout decision, data modes, sorting, selection, bar, body rendering with cell components, Pagination, the Loader while data loads. |
| `tableHTML.js` | Shell (with the progress row), rows, message and probe rows. |
| `tableEvents.js` | Sort and checkbox listeners. |
| `tableState.js` | Per-instance state, selection model, type-aware sorting. |
| `tableErrors.js` | Developer error and warning catalog. |
| `table.css` | Presentation (table, bar, sticky, cards). |
| `tableTESTS.md` | Test plan: the cases that prove this README (automatic ones in `tests/components/table.test.mjs`). |


<!-- ===== source/components-js/textArea/textAreaREADME.md ===== -->

# TextArea

## For business

### Overview

TextArea is a multi-line field for free text such as comments, descriptions, notes or reasons. It behaves like TextInput and adds a remaining-characters counter and a field that grows with its content.

### When to use

- Use it for free text over several lines: comments, descriptions, notes, reasons.
- Use TextInput for single-line values such as names, e-mail addresses or numbers.
- Use a rich-text editor (not part of UI Catalog) when the text needs formatting.

### Key features

- A remaining-characters counter that turns red and bold near the limit.
- A field that grows with its content up to a maximum number of lines, or that the user drags taller.
- Minimum and maximum length; text beyond the maximum is cut off with an explanation.
- Line breaks kept everywhere, also in read-only view; plain text only.

### Dependencies

| Dependency | Needed when | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Design system (`design-system.css`) | Always | Colors, spacing, borders and typography. |
| TextArea styles (`textArea.css`) | Always | Field appearance. |

### Not included

The application provides business rules, server checks, the explanation of the asterisk ("* Required field"), the form's error summary (which also announces errors to screen-reader users) and translations. It must also confirm that its server counts characters the same way (see Configuration).

## For designers

### Structure

```text
div.ui-text-area-wrapper.ui-text-area-width-{width}
├── label.ui-text-area-label
│   └── span.ui-text-area-optional  or  span.ui-text-area-mandatory   (mandatory indicator)
├── textarea.ui-text-area-field.ui-text-area-resize-{none|vertical}[.ui-text-area-auto-grow]
├── div.ui-text-area-footer                        (help and counter on one line; the error on its own line below)
│   ├── div.ui-text-area-help                      (optional; left, wraps when long)
│   ├── div.ui-text-area-error                     (hidden when there is no error; not a live region)
│   └── div.ui-text-area-counter[.ui-text-area-counter-warning]   (with maxLength; right; aria-hidden)
├── span.ui-text-area-visually-hidden              (limit text for screen readers)
└── span.ui-text-area-visually-hidden  aria-live="polite"   (counter announcements)
```

View state renders `p.ui-text-area-label` and `p.ui-text-area-view-value` (line breaks preserved); hidden state renders nothing. The field border turns to the accent color while focused and to the error color when `aria-invalid="true"`; keyboard focus adds the focus outline; disabled fields have a muted background. Auto-grow sets the local properties `--ui-text-area-height` and `--ui-text-area-overflow` inline.

### Visual options

| Option | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Label position | Top, left | `ui-text-area-label-top`, `ui-text-area-label-start`, or `INHERIT` inside an element with `ui-labels-start` |
| Width | Small, medium, large, full | `ui-text-area-width-small`, `-medium`, `-large`, `-full` |
| State | Edit, view, inactive, hidden | edit: default structure; view: `p.ui-text-area-view-value`; inactive: `textarea[disabled]`; hidden: no markup |
| Resize handle | Vertical, none | `ui-text-area-resize-vertical`, `ui-text-area-resize-none` (always none with auto-grow) |
| Auto-grow | On | `ui-text-area-auto-grow` |
| Mandatory indicator | None, optional text, mandatory asterisk | no element, `span.ui-text-area-optional`, `span.ui-text-area-mandatory` |

### States

| State | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Counter warning | Fewer than N characters left | `ui-text-area-counter-warning` (error color, bold) |
| Error | Shown | `textarea[aria-invalid="true"]`, visible `.ui-text-area-error` |

### Styling contract

`textArea.css` has three parts, marked in the stylesheet. Restyle by writing the same selector with a new value in your own stylesheet, inside `@layer overrides` (preferred: library updates keep your changes), or by changing a value in your copy of the stylesheet. After each token come the parts it styles, named by their class without `ui-text-area-` (as in Structure), with the option or state in brackets (joined by “+” when they apply together). Text uses the typography roles of `design-system.css`; border sides are physical (top, right, bottom, left).

The disabled rules use `:disabled`, so they also apply inside a disabled `fieldset`; the label and `*` of a disabled field use `--c-muted`.

**1. Appearance — change freely** (colours, type, borders, corners, motion: only the look changes)

- Colours
  - `--c-text`: label, field, view value
  - `--c-muted`: optional, field (disabled), label (disabled), mandatory (disabled), help, counter
  - `--c-danger-text`: mandatory, error, counter (warning)
  - `--c-border`: field
  - `--c-surface`: field
  - `--c-accent`: field (focus)
  - `--c-danger`: field (invalid)
  - `--c-surface-muted`: field (disabled)
- Typography
  - `--font-ui`: text area, field
  - `--fw-ui`: text area, field, optional
  - `--fs-label`: label, optional, help, error, counter
  - `--fw-ui-strong`: label, mandatory, error, counter (warning)
  - `--lh-compact`: label
  - `--fs-control`: field, view value
  - `--lh-body`: field, help, error, counter, view value
- Borders and corners
  - `--border-thin`: field
- States and motion
  - `--transition-1`: field

**2. Dimensions — change with care** (sizes and spacing: the component keeps working, its size changes)

- Spacing
  - `--gap-tight`: text area, footer
  - `--gap-section`: text area
  - `--gap-inline-items`: label, footer
  - `--padding-control`: field
- Sizes
  - `--control-height`: field
  - `--percentage-s`: text area (width small)
  - `--percentage-m`: text area (width medium)
  - `--percentage-l`: text area (width large)
  - `--percentage-full`: text area (width full)

**3. Structure — don't change** (layout, behaviour, states, accessibility)

- States and motion
  - `--focus-outline`: field (focus)
  - `--focus-offset`: field (focus)
- Spacing
  - `--gap-toolbar`: text area (label on the left, label on the left + width small, label on the left + width medium, label on the left + width large)
- Sizes
  - `--percentage-full`: text area (also label on the left + width small, label on the left + width medium, label on the left + width large)
  - `--form-label-width`: text area (label on the left, label on the left + width small, label on the left + width medium, label on the left + width large)
  - `--percentage-s`: text area (label on the left + width small)
  - `--percentage-m`: text area (label on the left + width medium)
  - `--percentage-l`: text area (label on the left + width large)
  - `--control-height`: label (label on the left)

**Set by the component — don't change**

- Variables
  - `--ui-text-area-height`, `--ui-text-area-overflow`: height and scrolling of an auto-growing field (measured while typing)

## For AI-assisted development

### Instructions

- Inside a Form, give the field a `name` (the key of its value) and leave `labelPosition` on `INHERIT`, so the Form (or a ContentGroup with the class `ui-labels-start`) decides label placement for all fields. Show server or cross-field messages with `setError(message)`; they clear when the user changes the value.
- Read this README before writing code. Import only from `textAreaIndex.js`.
- Use TextArea for every multi-line plain-text field; never write `textarea` markup, counters or error elements by hand.
- Fields are mandatory by default; set `mandatory:false` explicitly, normally with `mandatoryIndicator:'OPTIONAL_TEXT'`. Use the same indicator style for the whole form.
- Set a length limit with `validation:{ enabled:true, maxLength }`; the counter appears automatically. Match `maxLength` to what the server accepts.
- On submit, call `validate()` on every field, build the error summary from `getError()`, and let each summary link call `focus()`.
- Use `onValueChange` for the value and `onValidation` for validity; never read the DOM.
- `setValue()` is programmatic: no dirty flag, no `onValueChange`.
- Put forms in `<form novalidate>`; translate UI texts through `texts`.
- Give each field a unique `id` and call `destroy()` before rendering into the same container again.

### Safety

- Never add formatting (HTML, Markdown rendering) to TextArea values; treat the value as untrusted text and escape it wherever it is displayed.
- Never remove `aria-invalid`, `aria-describedby`, `aria-required` or the label association, and never make the error a live region.
- Never add native `required`, `minlength` or `maxlength` attributes.

### Example prompts

```text
Add a mandatory TextArea "Reason for cancellation" with a maximum of 500 characters and a warning when fewer than 20 characters are left, marked with an asterisk.
```

```text
Add an optional auto-growing TextArea "Internal notes" (3 to 10 lines) to the order form, marked "(Optional)", and show its text read-only with line breaks for users without edit rights.
```

## For developers

### Business analysis

> **Component**: the TextArea itself. **Consumer**: the developer who configures the TextArea in the application's code. **App**: the running application that uses the TextArea; it provides the data, performs the actions and stores the changes.

**Text**

- User types or pastes text over several lines. <!-- BA-01 -->
  - Component reports each change to the App. <!-- BA-02 -->
- Consumer provides the label, a placeholder and a help text (optional). <!-- BA-03 -->
- Component keeps line breaks, also in read-only view. <!-- BA-04 -->
- Component wraps very long words instead of widening the page. <!-- BA-05 -->
- Component keeps the text exactly as typed, without formatting. <!-- BA-06 -->

**Length**

- Consumer provides a maximum length (optional). <!-- BA-07 -->
  - Component displays the characters left below the field, e.g. "12 characters left". <!-- BA-08 -->
  - Component displays the counter in red and bold when fewer than 5 characters are left (the number is chosen by the Consumer). <!-- BA-09 -->
  - Component removes text beyond the maximum and displays a short message. <!-- BA-10 -->
- Consumer provides a minimum length (optional). <!-- BA-11 -->
  - Component checks the length and displays the error message. <!-- BA-12 -->

**Size**

- Consumer provides the starting number of lines. <!-- BA-13 -->
- Component adapts the height of the field to its content, up to a maximum number of lines, then scrolls (optional). <!-- BA-14 -->
- User drags the corner of the field to make it taller (when the field does not grow by itself). <!-- BA-15 -->

**Browser help**

- Component checks the spelling (optional, on by default). <!-- BA-16 -->
- Component displays the browser's suggestions of earlier entries (optional). <!-- BA-17 -->

**Display**

- Consumer chooses one of four widths. <!-- BA-18 -->

### Contracts

**Contracts:** Styling: three parts (Styling contract) · Form field: yes · Actions: no · Shared behaviour: yes, additions under Accessibility

### Public API

```js
import { renderTextArea, DEFAULT_TEXTAREA_CONFIG, TEXTAREA_STATES, TEXTAREA_WIDTHS, TEXTAREA_MANDATORY_INDICATORS, TEXTAREA_RESIZE_MODES } from './textAreaIndex.js';

const notes = renderTextArea(container, config, onValueChange, onValidation); // null after a developer error
```

`container` is a dedicated, consumer-owned element. Rendering replaces its content; `destroy()` clears it. The configuration is immutable after rendering; `config.value` remains the initial value.

| Member | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | The configured id. |
| `name` | string | The configured `name` (the key of the value in a Form). |
| `getLabelPosition()` | `'TOP'` \| `'START'` | Effective label position (`INHERIT` resolved from the surroundings). |
| `getLabel()` | string | The visible label; Form prefixes error-summary entries with it. |
| `getMandatoryState()` | object | `{ mandatory, indicator }`; Form shows "* Required field" when an asterisk is shown. |
| `setError(message)` | `{ valid, errorLabel }` | Shows an external error (server or cross-field rule, label `EXTERNAL`) until the user changes the value or `clearError()` is called; own validation errors take precedence. |
| `clearError()` | — | Removes an external error; own validation errors stay. |
| `getValue()` | string | Current value (line breaks as `\n`). |
| `getError()` | object \| null | Copy of the current error `{ errorLabel, message, source, severity, visibility }`. |
| `setValue(value)` | `{ valid, errorLabel }` | Sets the value (truncated to `maxLength` when validation is enabled), updates counter and height, runs final validation. |
| `setValue(value, { quiet:true })` | object | Quiet variant used by Form's quiet reset: sets the value without validating, removes any shown error and the changed state. |
| `validate()` | `{ valid, errorLabel }` | Runs final validation, shows or clears the error. |
| `isDirty()` | boolean | Whether the user has changed the value. |
| `focus()` | boolean | Moves focus to the field; `false` in view, hidden or inactive state. |
| `destroy()` | — | Removes listeners, timers and the resize observer, clears the container. |

### Configuration

Enumerated values are canonical UPPER_CASE and accepted case-insensitively. An invalid value produces an `INVALID_OPTION` warning and the default is used.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Allowed values / format | Applies when | Usage / description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | — | Starts with a letter; letters, digits, `_ : . -`; unique in the document | Always | Required. Native `id` of the textarea. |
| `name` | string | value of `id` | Text | `EDIT`, `INACTIVE` | Native `name`. |
| `label` | string | `''` | Text | Always | Visible label. |
| `value` | string | `''` | Text | Always | Initial value; truncated to `maxLength` when validation is enabled. |
| `placeholder` | string | `''` | Text | `EDIT`, `INACTIVE` | Placeholder. |
| `help` | string | `''` | Text | `EDIT`, `INACTIVE` | Help text, linked through `aria-describedby`. |
| `state` | string | `'EDIT'` | `EDIT`, `VIEW`, `INACTIVE`, `INVISIBLE` | Always | Display mode. |
| `width` | string | `'FULL'` | `SMALL`, `MEDIUM`, `LARGE`, `FULL` | Always | Field width. |
| `mandatory` | boolean | `true` | — | Always | `true`: empty (or whitespace-only) value is a `REQUIRED` error; sets `aria-required`. |
| `mandatoryIndicator` | string | `'NONE'` | `NONE`, `OPTIONAL_TEXT`, `MANDATORY_ASTERISK` | `label` | Marker next to the label. |
| `labelPosition` | string | `'INHERIT'` | `TOP`, `START`, `INHERIT` | Always | Label above the field (`TOP`), on its left (`START`), or as set by the surrounding Form/ContentGroup (`INHERIT`: left inside an element with the class `ui-labels-start`, otherwise on top). `START` needs a surrounding container at least 36rem wide (Form, ContentGroup, CollapsiblePanel, or any element with `container-type:inline-size`); narrower, the label moves on top. |
| `autoFocus` | boolean | `false` | — | `EDIT` | Focuses the field once, after the first render. |
| `autocomplete` | string | `'off'` | Native token list | `EDIT`, `INACTIVE` | `'off'`: no browser suggestions of earlier entries; `'on'` allows them. |
| `spellcheck` | boolean | `true` | — | `EDIT`, `INACTIVE` | Browser spellcheck. |
| `rows` | number | `4` | Integer 1–50 | Always | Initial visible lines (minimum height with auto-grow). |
| `autoGrow` | boolean | `false` | — | `EDIT`, `INACTIVE` | Grows with the content up to `maxRows`, then scrolls; forces `resize:'NONE'`. |
| `maxRows` | number | `12` | Integer 1–100, ≥ `rows` | `autoGrow` | Maximum lines before scrolling (`MAX_ROWS_CLAMPED` when smaller than `rows`). |
| `resize` | string | `'VERTICAL'` | `VERTICAL`, `NONE` | Not `autoGrow` | User resize handle. |
| `validation.enabled` | boolean | `false` | — | Always | Enables length rules and the counter (not `mandatory`). |
| `validation.minLength` | number | `0` | Integer ≥ 0, ≤ `maxLength` | `validation.enabled` | Minimum length (`MIN_LENGTH`). |
| `validation.maxLength` | number | `1000` | Integer ≥ 1 | `validation.enabled` | Maximum length; longer input is truncated. |
| `showCounter` | boolean | `true` | — | `validation.enabled` + `EDIT` | Shows the remaining-characters counter. |
| `counterWarningThreshold` | number | `5` | Integer ≥ 0 | `showCounter` | Warning style when fewer than this many characters are left. |
| `errorVisibilityDuration` | number | `5000` | ms, 0–60000 | `validation.enabled` | How long `MAX_LENGTH` stays visible. |
| `locale` | string | page language | BCP 47 tag, e.g. `'en'`, `'de'` | `showCounter` | Optional. The language whose rules TextArea uses to write the number in the counter. When empty, the page language (`<html lang>`), then the browser language. For example: with `maxLength:5000`, the counter reads “4,800 characters left” in English (`en`) and “4.800 characters left” in German (`de`). |
| `texts.optional` | string | `'(Optional)'` | Text | `mandatory:false` + `OPTIONAL_TEXT` | Optional marker. |
| `texts.counter` / `texts.counterSingular` | string | `'{remaining} characters left'` / `'{remaining} character left'` | Text with `{remaining}` | `showCounter` | Counter text (singular for exactly 1). |
| `texts.limit` | string | `'Maximum {maxLength} characters.'` | Text with `{maxLength}` | `validation.enabled` | Limit description for screen readers. |
| `texts.errors.{LABEL}` | string | see Errors | Text with `{minLength}`, `{maxLength}` | Always | Message for each user error label. |

Counting: characters are counted as the browser counts them (`value.length`): a line break counts 1; some emoji and combined characters count 2. Line breaks are normalized to `\n`. `resize` with auto-grow, `maxRows` without auto-grow and counter options without validation are ignored with an `OPTION_IGNORED` warning.

### Callbacks

| Callback | Arguments | Fires when | Does not fire when |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `onValueChange` | `(value, instance)` | A user edit changes the value, including input truncated to `maxLength` that still changes it. | Initial value, `setValue()`, input rejected without changing the value, during IME composition. |
| `onValidation` | `(result, instance)` with `result = { valid, errorLabel }` | The effective validation result changes (while typing, on blur after a change, on `validate()` or `setValue()`). | The result is unchanged; blur without a change; the temporary `MAX_LENGTH` message alone. |

### Errors

User errors are shown below the field and returned by `getError()`. Messages come from `texts.errors`.

| Label | Default message | Trigger | Visibility |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `EXTERNAL` | Message passed to `setError()`. | `setError(message)`, e.g. from a Form (server errors, cross-field rules). | Corrective |
| `REQUIRED` | Required. | Empty or whitespace-only value with `mandatory:true`. | Corrective |
| `MIN_LENGTH` | Minimum {minLength} characters. | Shorter than `minLength`. | Corrective |
| `MAX_LENGTH` | Maximum {maxLength} characters. | Input truncated to `maxLength`. | Temporary (`errorVisibilityDuration`) |
| `UNIDENTIFIED` | An unidentified error occurred. | Unknown error label. | Dismissible |

Timing: errors are shown on `validate()`, `setValue()` and on blur once the user has changed the value. While typing, a visible corrective error is updated or cleared immediately, but new errors are not shown.

Developer errors prevent rendering (`renderTextArea()` returns `null`); warnings are logged and rendering continues. Console format: `TextArea "id" [LABEL]: message`.

| Label | Severity | Cause |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CONTAINER_REQUIRED` | error | No container passed. |
| `ID_REQUIRED` | error | `id` is empty. |
| `UNSAFE_ID` | error | `id` is not DOM-safe. |
| `DUPLICATE_ID` | error | An element with the same id already exists in the document. |
| `INVALID_OPTION` | warning | Invalid enumerated value, number, `autocomplete` or `locale` tag; the default (for `locale`, the page language) is used. |
| `OPTION_IGNORED` | warning | `resize` with `autoGrow`, `maxRows` without `autoGrow`, or counter options without validation. |
| `MIN_LENGTH_CLAMPED` | warning | `minLength` greater than `maxLength`. |
| `MAX_ROWS_CLAMPED` | warning | `maxRows` smaller than `rows`. |

### Accessibility

- Native `textarea` linked to its label with `for`; mandatory fields have `aria-required="true"`; the asterisk is `aria-hidden`.
- Help, the limit ("Maximum N characters.") and a visible error are linked through `aria-describedby`; an error sets `aria-invalid="true"` and is read when the user reaches the field (not a live region).
- The visual counter is `aria-hidden`; screen readers hear one polite announcement when the warning zone is entered and one when the limit is reached, not on every keystroke.
- The warning is shown by color and bold weight together with the count in words.
- `dir="auto"` aligns right-to-left text correctly; IME composition is never interrupted by truncation or validation.

### Examples

Reason field with a larger warning zone, validated on submit with other inputs:

```js
const reason = renderTextArea(reasonHost,
{
    id:'cancel-reason',
    label:'Reason for cancellation',
    mandatoryIndicator:'MANDATORY_ASTERISK',
    rows:3, autoGrow:true, maxRows:8,
    validation:{ enabled:true, minLength:10, maxLength:500 },
    counterWarningThreshold:20,
    texts:{ errors:{ REQUIRED:'Enter a reason for the cancellation.', MIN_LENGTH:'Enter at least {minLength} characters.' } }
},( value ) => { order.cancelReason = value; });

cancelForm.addEventListener('submit',event =>
{
    const invalid = [ reason, confirmCheckbox ].filter(field => !field.validate().valid);
    if ( invalid.length ) { event.preventDefault(); showErrorSummary(invalid.map(field => ({ message:field.getError().message, focus:field.focus }))); }
});
```

### Files

| File | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `textAreaIndex.js` | Public entry point; the only import surface. |
| `textAreaConfig.js` | Defaults, allowed values, normalization, truncation, developer validation. |
| `textAreaComponent.js` | Lifecycle, error lifecycle, counter, auto-grow, runtime API. |
| `textAreaHTML.js` | Markup generation (rendered once). |
| `textAreaEvents.js` | Input (IME-aware) and blur listener registration. |
| `textAreaState.js` | Per-instance runtime state. |
| `textAreaValidation.js` | Validation rules (pure functions). |
| `textAreaErrors.js` | User error catalog and developer error and warning catalog. |
| `textArea.css` | Presentation. |
| `textAreaTESTS.md` | Test plan: the cases that prove this README (automatic ones in `tests/components/textArea.test.mjs`). |


<!-- ===== source/components-js/textInput/textInputREADME.md ===== -->

# TextInput

## For business

### Overview

TextInput is a single-line field where the user types a value: text, e-mail address, password, web address, phone number or number. It shows a label, optional help text and clear error messages, and can also display a value read-only.

### When to use

- Use it for single-line values: text, e-mail address, password, web address, phone number or number.
- Use TextArea for longer text over several lines, Calendar for dates and times, and Select for a choice from a list.
- Use SearchBox for searching data.

### Key features

- Six types: text, e-mail, password, web address, phone and number.
- Length, number and format rules with their own error messages.
- A show/hide button for passwords.
- An icon or one action button at the end of the field, e.g. "Search" or "Copy".
- Five widths, from small to full width or fitted to the content.

### Dependencies

| Dependency | Needed when | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Design system (`design-system.css`) | Always | Colors, spacing, borders and typography. |
| TextInput styles (`textInput.css`) | Always | Field appearance. |
| Button component and `button.css` | Password fields or an action button | Password show/hide and trailing action button. |
| Font Awesome icon library | Password fields, icons or action buttons | Icon glyphs. Loaded by the application page. |
| Tooltip component and `tooltip.css` | `tooltipMode` `TOOLTIP` | Tooltips (the Tooltip module is loaded only then). |

### Not included

The application provides business rules (e.g. "e-mail already registered"), server checks, value formatting, translations, the explanation of the asterisk (e.g. "* Required field") and the form's error summary, which also announces errors to screen-reader users.

## For designers

### Structure

```text
div.ui-text-input-wrapper.ui-text-input-width-{width}
├── label.ui-text-input-label
│   └── span.ui-text-input-optional  or  span.ui-text-input-mandatory   (mandatory indicator)
├── div.ui-text-input-control
│   ├── input.ui-text-input-field[.ui-text-input-number-no-spinner]
│   └── div.ui-text-input-icon-area                       (optional)
│       ├── i.ui-text-input-static-icon.{icon}            (static icon)
│       └── div.ui-text-input-icon-button-host[.ui-text-input-action] → Button   (password toggle, or the action)
├── div.ui-text-input-help                                (optional)
└── div.ui-text-input-error                               (hidden when there is no error; not a live region)
```

View state renders `div.ui-text-input-wrapper` with `p.ui-text-input-label` and `p.ui-text-input-view-value`. Hidden state renders nothing. The field border turns to the error color when `aria-invalid="true"` and to the accent color while focused. When the field is disabled — state `INACTIVE`, or inside a disabled `fieldset` (e.g. a ContentGroup with `disabled:true`) — the box background turns muted and the typed text, the label and the `*` use the secondary text color; the help text is secondary already and the error message keeps the error color. Number fields hide the spinner unless integer steps greater than 1 are configured.

### Visual options

| Option | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Label position | Top, left | `ui-text-input-label-top`, `ui-text-input-label-start`, or `INHERIT` inside an element with `ui-labels-start` |
| Width | Small, medium, large, full, fit content | `ui-text-input-width-small`, `-medium`, `-large`, `-full`, `-fit-content` |
| State | Edit, view, inactive, hidden | edit: default structure; view: `p.ui-text-input-view-value`; inactive: `input[disabled]` (a field inside `fieldset[disabled]` looks the same), muted box, text, label and `*`; hidden: no markup |
| Mandatory indicator | None, optional text, mandatory asterisk | no element, `span.ui-text-input-optional` (non-mandatory fields), `span.ui-text-input-mandatory` (mandatory fields, `aria-hidden`) |
| Number spinner | Hidden | `ui-text-input-number-no-spinner` |

### States

| State | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Error | Shown | `input[aria-invalid="true"]`, visible `.ui-text-input-error` |

### Styling contract

`textInput.css` has three parts, marked in the stylesheet. Restyle by writing the same selector with a new value in your own stylesheet, inside `@layer overrides` (preferred: library updates keep your changes), or by changing a value in your copy of the stylesheet. After each token come the parts it styles, named by their class without `ui-text-input-` (as in Structure), with the option or state in brackets (joined by “+” when they apply together). Text uses the typography roles of `design-system.css`; border sides are physical (top, right, bottom, left).

The disabled rules use `:disabled`, so they also apply inside a disabled `fieldset`; the label and `*` of a disabled field use `--c-muted`. The field's minimum height subtracts the top and bottom border widths, so keep them in step.

**1. Appearance — change freely** (colours, type, borders, corners, motion: only the look changes)

- Colours
  - `--c-text`: label, field, view value
  - `--c-muted`: optional, field (disabled), label (disabled), mandatory (disabled), help
  - `--c-danger-text`: mandatory, error
  - `--c-border`: control
  - `--c-surface`: control
  - `--c-accent`: control (focus)
  - `--c-danger`: control (invalid)
  - `--c-surface-muted`: control (disabled)
- Typography
  - `--font-ui`: text input, field
  - `--fw-ui`: text input, field, optional
  - `--fs-label`: label, optional, help, error
  - `--fw-ui-strong`: label, mandatory, error
  - `--lh-compact`: label
  - `--fs-control`: field, view value
  - `--lh-body`: help, error
- Borders and corners
  - `--border-thin`: control
- States and motion
  - `--transition-1`: control

**2. Dimensions — change with care** (sizes and spacing: the component keeps working, its size changes)

- Borders and corners
  - `--border-thin`: control, field
- Spacing
  - `--gap-tight`: text input, icon area
  - `--gap-section`: text input
  - `--gap-inline-items`: label
  - `--padding-control`: field
- Sizes
  - `--control-height`: control, field
  - `--percentage-s`: text input (width small)
  - `--percentage-m`: text input (width medium)
  - `--percentage-l`: text input (width large)
  - `--percentage-full`: text input (width full)

**3. Structure — don't change** (layout, behaviour, states, accessibility)

- Spacing
  - `--gap-toolbar`: text input (label on the left, label on the left + width small, label on the left + width medium, label on the left + width large)
- Sizes
  - `--percentage-full`: text input (also label on the left + width small, label on the left + width medium, label on the left + width large)
  - `--form-label-width`: text input (label on the left, label on the left + width small, label on the left + width medium, label on the left + width large)
  - `--percentage-s`: text input (label on the left + width small)
  - `--percentage-m`: text input (label on the left + width medium)
  - `--percentage-l`: text input (label on the left + width large)

## For AI-assisted development

### Instructions

- Inside a Form, give the field a `name` (the key of its value) and leave `labelPosition` on `INHERIT`, so the Form (or a ContentGroup with the class `ui-labels-start`) decides label placement for all fields. Show server or cross-field messages with `setError(message)`; they clear when the user changes the value.
- Read this README before writing code. Import only from `textInputIndex.js`.
- Application buttons follow the shared actions contract (guidelines §10.2): pass `actions` (`{ key, label, icon?, iconOnly?, hierarchy?, disabled? }`) and handle `onAction(key)`; never create Buttons yourself inside the component. Inside the field only one icon-only action fits.
- Check whether the configuration already provides the requested behavior before adding code.
- Never write input markup, error elements or styles by hand; use `renderTextInput()`.
- Use `type:'TEL'` for phone numbers and `validation.pattern` for fixed formats (postal codes, customer numbers); country-specific phone checks and formatting stay in the consuming code.
- Use `mandatory` and `validation` for generic rules; implement business rules (uniqueness, cross-field checks, server checks) in the consuming code.
- Fields are mandatory by default; set `mandatory:false` explicitly, normally together with `mandatoryIndicator:'OPTIONAL_TEXT'`. Use the same `mandatoryIndicator` for every input of a form, and add the asterisk explanation when using `MANDATORY_ASTERISK`.
- On submit, call `validate()` on every field, build an error summary from `getError()` at the top of the form, move focus to it, and let each summary link call that field's `focus()`. Do not re-implement required, length or number checks.
- Use `onValueChange` for the value and `onValidation` for validity; never read the DOM. Keep the submit Button enabled and validate on submit.
- `setValue()` is programmatic: it does not mark the field dirty and does not call `onValueChange`.
- Put forms that contain TextInputs in `<form novalidate>`; TextInput does not use native browser validation.
- Translate UI texts through `texts`, not by editing the component.
- Give each field a unique `id` and call `destroy()` before rendering into the same container again.

### Safety

- Never remove `aria-invalid`, `aria-describedby`, `aria-required` or the label association.
- Never add native `required`, `minlength` or `maxlength` attributes, and never make field errors live regions (`role="alert"`, `aria-live`); announcing errors is the error summary's job.
- Do not use `INVISIBLE` to hide sensitive values; the value is still in the application state.

### Example prompts

```text
Add mandatory e-mail and password TextInputs to the login form, marked with an asterisk. On submit, validate both, show an error summary above the form with links that focus the fields, and send the form only when both are valid.
```

```text
Add a non-mandatory integer TextInput "Quantity", marked "(optional)", between 1 and 99 with step 1, and show "Quantity must be between 1 and 99" in German when the value is out of range.
```

## For developers

### Business analysis

> **Component**: the TextInput itself. **Consumer**: the developer who configures the TextInput in the application's code. **App**: the running application that uses the TextInput; it provides the data, performs the actions and stores the changes.

**Value**

- User types, pastes or edits the value. <!-- BA-01 -->
  - Component reports each change to the App. <!-- BA-02 -->
- Consumer provides the label, a placeholder and a help text (optional). <!-- BA-03 -->
- Consumer chooses the type: text, e-mail, password, web address, phone or number. <!-- BA-04 -->

**Rules**

- Consumer provides a minimum and a maximum length (optional). <!-- BA-05 -->
  - Component removes characters beyond the maximum and displays a short message. <!-- BA-06 -->
- Consumer provides number rules: whole numbers only, a minimum and a maximum value (optional). <!-- BA-07 -->
  - Component displays step buttons for whole numbers with a step other than 1. <!-- BA-08 -->
- Component prevents characters other than digits, spaces, "+", "-" and brackets in a phone field. <!-- BA-09 -->
  - Component displays the numeric keypad on phones. <!-- BA-10 -->
- Consumer provides a required format with its own error message, e.g. a 6-digit postal code (optional). <!-- BA-11 -->
- Component checks the rules and displays the matching error message. <!-- BA-12 -->

**Password**

- Component displays a show/hide button in a password field (optional, on by default). <!-- BA-13 -->
- User clicks the button. <!-- BA-14 -->
  - Component displays or hides the password. <!-- BA-15 -->

**End of the field** (optional)

- Consumer provides a decorative icon, or one action button, e.g. "Search". <!-- BA-16 -->
- User clicks the action button. <!-- BA-17 -->
  - Component reports the action to the App. <!-- BA-18 -->
  - App performs the action. <!-- BA-19 -->

**Display**

- Consumer chooses one of five widths: small, medium, large, full width or fitted to the content. <!-- BA-20 -->

**Tooltips**

- Consumer chooses how the password toggle and an icon-only action show their names on hover and keyboard focus: the browser's tooltip, a Tooltip or none (optional). <!-- BA-21 -->

### Contracts

**Contracts:** Styling: three parts (Styling contract) · Form field: yes · Actions: yes, one icon-only action in the field (`actions`, `onAction`) · Shared behaviour: yes, additions under Accessibility

### Public API

```js
import { renderTextInput, DEFAULT_TEXTINPUT_CONFIG, TEXTINPUT_TOOLTIP_MODES, TEXTINPUT_STATES, TEXTINPUT_TYPES, TEXTINPUT_WIDTHS, TEXTINPUT_NUMBER_TYPES, TEXTINPUT_INPUT_MODES } from './textInputIndex.js';

const field = renderTextInput(container, config, onValueChange, onValidation); // null after a developer error
```

`container` is a dedicated, consumer-owned element. Rendering replaces its content; `destroy()` clears it. The configuration is immutable after rendering; `config.value` remains the initial value.

| Member | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | The configured id. |
| `name` | string | The configured `name` (the key of the value in a Form). |
| `getLabelPosition()` | `'TOP'` \| `'START'` | Effective label position (`INHERIT` resolved from the surroundings). |
| `getLabel()` | string | The visible label; Form prefixes error-summary entries with it. |
| `getMandatoryState()` | object | `{ mandatory, indicator }`; Form shows "* Required field" when an asterisk is shown. |
| `setError(message)` | `{ valid, errorLabel }` | Shows an external error (server or cross-field rule, label `EXTERNAL`) until the user changes the value or `clearError()` is called; own validation errors take precedence. |
| `clearError()` | — | Removes an external error; own validation errors stay. |
| `getValue()` | string | Current value. |
| `getError()` | object \| null | Copy of the current error `{ errorLabel, message, source, severity, visibility }`. |
| `setValue(value)` | `{ valid, errorLabel }` | Sets the value (truncated to `maxLength` when text validation is enabled), runs final validation and returns its result. |
| `setValue(value, { quiet:true })` | object | Quiet variant used by Form's quiet reset: sets the value without validating, removes any shown error and the changed state. |
| `validate()` | `{ valid, errorLabel }` | Runs final validation, shows or clears the error and returns its result. |
| `isDirty()` | boolean | Whether the user has changed the value. |
| `focus()` | boolean | Moves focus to the input; `false` when there is no focusable input (view, hidden, inactive). |
| `setActionDisabled(key, disabled)` | boolean | Enables or disables the action Button; `false` (with `UNKNOWN_ACTION`) for an unknown key. |
| `destroy()` | — | Removes listeners, timers and the child Button, clears the container. |

### Configuration

Enumerated values are canonical UPPER_CASE and accepted case-insensitively. An invalid value or number produces an `INVALID_OPTION` warning and the default is used.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Allowed values / format | Applies when | Usage / description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | — | Starts with a letter; letters, digits, `_ : . -`; unique in the document | Always | Required. Native `id` of the input. |
| `name` | string | value of `id` | Text | `EDIT`, `INACTIVE` | Native `name`. |
| `label` | string | `''` | Text | Always | Visible label. |
| `value` | string | `''` | Text | Always | Initial value; truncated to `maxLength` when text validation is enabled. |
| `placeholder` | string | `''` | Text | `EDIT`, `INACTIVE` | Placeholder. |
| `help` | string | `''` | Text | `EDIT`, `INACTIVE` | Help text, linked through `aria-describedby`. |
| `state` | string | `'EDIT'` | `EDIT`, `VIEW`, `INACTIVE`, `INVISIBLE` | Always | Display mode; see Visual options. |
| `type` | string | `'TEXT'` | `TEXT`, `EMAIL`, `PASSWORD`, `NUMBER`, `URL`, `TEL` | Always | Native input type. `TEL` also defaults `inputMode` to `TEL` and `autocomplete` to `'tel'`. |
| `width` | string | `'FULL'` | `SMALL`, `MEDIUM`, `LARGE`, `FULL`, `FIT_CONTENT` | Always | Field width. |
| `mandatory` | boolean | `true` | — | Always | `true`: empty value is a `REQUIRED` error, independent of `validation.enabled`; sets `aria-required`. |
