| `mandatoryIndicator` | string | `'NONE'` | `NONE`, `OPTIONAL_TEXT`, `MANDATORY_ASTERISK` | `label` | `OPTIONAL_TEXT`: `texts.optional` next to non-mandatory fields (recommended with `mandatory:false`). `MANDATORY_ASTERISK`: `*` next to mandatory fields. `NONE`: no marker. |
| `labelPosition` | string | `'INHERIT'` | `TOP`, `START`, `INHERIT` | Always | Label above the field (`TOP`), on its left (`START`), or as set by the surrounding Form/ContentGroup (`INHERIT`: left inside an element with the class `ui-labels-start`, otherwise on top). `START` needs a surrounding container at least 36rem wide (Form, ContentGroup, CollapsiblePanel, or any element with `container-type:inline-size`); narrower, the label moves on top. |
| `trimStart` | boolean | `false` | — | Not `NUMBER` | Removes leading whitespace from user input. |
| `autoFocus` | boolean | `false` | — | `EDIT` | Focuses the input once, after the first render. |
| `autocomplete` | string | `'off'` (`'tel'` for `TEL`) | Native token | `EDIT`, `INACTIVE` | Native `autocomplete`. |
| `inputMode` | string | `''` (none; `TEL` for `TEL`) | `TEXT`, `DECIMAL`, `NUMERIC`, `TEL`, `SEARCH`, `EMAIL`, `URL` | `EDIT`, `INACTIVE` | Native `inputmode` (virtual keyboard). |
| `passwordToggle` | boolean | `true` | — | `PASSWORD` + `EDIT` | Show/hide password Button. |
| `errorVisibilityDuration` | number | `5000` | ms, ≥ 0 | `validation.enabled` + not `NUMBER` | How long `MAX_LENGTH` stays visible. |
| `iconArea.staticIcon` | string | `''` | CSS class names | Not `PASSWORD`, `EDIT` | Decorative trailing icon. |
| `actions` | array | `[]` | `[{ key, label, icon, hierarchy?, disabled? }]` (at most one) | Not `PASSWORD`, `EDIT` | The trailing action Button (guidelines §10.2; a single slot inside the field): always icon-only, named by `label`; `icon` required; TERTIARY by default. Takes precedence over `staticIcon` (`OPTIONS_CONFLICT`). Extra entries, or an action without icon, are ignored (`OPTION_IGNORED`). Without `onAction` it is disabled (`ACTION_HANDLER_MISSING`). |
| `tooltipMode` | string | `'NONE'` | `NONE`, `TITLE`, `TOOLTIP` | Always | How the password toggle and an icon-only action show their names on hover and keyboard focus: not at all, the browser's tooltip (`title`, mouse only) or a Tooltip (also on keyboard focus; needs `tooltip.css`, the Tooltip module is loaded only then). |
| `onAction` | function | `null` | `(key, instance) => {}` | `actions` | The action Button was pressed. |
| `validation.enabled` | boolean | `false` | — | Always | Enables the rules below (not `mandatory`). |
| `validation.minLength` | number | `0` | Integer ≥ 0, ≤ `maxLength` | Not `NUMBER` | Minimum length (`MIN_LENGTH`). Clamped to `maxLength` with a warning. |
| `validation.maxLength` | number | `255` | Integer ≥ 0 | Not `NUMBER` | Maximum length; input is truncated. |
| `validation.numberType` | string | `'REAL'` | `REAL`, `INTEGER` | `NUMBER` | Number kind. |
| `validation.minValue` | number \| null | `null` | Number | `NUMBER` | Minimum value (`MIN_VALUE`). |
| `validation.maxValue` | number \| null | `null` | Number | `NUMBER` | Maximum value (`MAX_VALUE`). |
| `validation.step` | number | `1` | Integer ≥ 1 | `NUMBER` + `INTEGER` | Step; values > 1 show the native spinner. |
| `validation.pattern` | string \| RegExp | `''` (none) | Regular expression, matched against the whole value | Not `NUMBER` | Required format (`PATTERN`); e.g. `'[0-9]{6}'`. An invalid expression is ignored with `INVALID_PATTERN`. |
| `texts.optional` | string | `'(Optional)'` | Text | `mandatory:false` + `OPTIONAL_TEXT` | Optional marker. |
| `texts.showPassword` / `texts.hidePassword` | string | `'Show password'` / `'Hide password'` | Text | `passwordToggle` | Toggle accessible names. |
| `texts.errors.{LABEL}` | string | see Errors | Text with `{minLength}`, `{maxLength}`, `{minValue}`, `{maxValue}` | Always | Message for each user error label. |

For `PASSWORD`, `iconArea.staticIcon` and `actions` are ignored, and for `NUMBER`, `validation.pattern` is ignored, each with an `OPTION_IGNORED` warning.

### Callbacks

| Callback | Arguments | Fires when | Does not fire when |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `onValueChange` | `(value, instance)` | A user edit changes the value, including input truncated to `maxLength` that still changes it. | Initial value, `setValue()`, input rejected without changing the value. |
| `onValidation` | `(result, instance)` with `result = { valid, errorLabel }` | The effective validation result changes (while typing, on blur after a change, on `validate()` or `setValue()`). | The result is unchanged; blur without a change; the temporary `MAX_LENGTH` message alone. |
| `onAction` | `(key, instance)` | The action Button is pressed. | Disabled action; `PASSWORD` fields. |

### Errors

User errors are shown below the field and returned by `getError()`. Messages come from `texts.errors`.

| Label | Default message | Trigger | Visibility |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `EXTERNAL` | Message passed to `setError()`. | `setError(message)`, e.g. from a Form (server errors, cross-field rules). | Corrective |
| `REQUIRED` | Required. | Empty value with `mandatory:true`. | Corrective |
| `MIN_LENGTH` | Minimum {minLength} characters. | Shorter than `minLength`. | Corrective |
| `MAX_LENGTH` | Maximum {maxLength} characters. | Input truncated to `maxLength`. | Temporary (`errorVisibilityDuration`) |
| `INVALID_NUMBER` | Enter a valid number. | `NUMBER` value not numeric. | Corrective |
| `INTEGER_REQUIRED` | Enter an integer. | Decimal value with `INTEGER`. | Corrective |
| `MIN_VALUE` | Minimum value is {minValue}. | Below `minValue`. | Corrective |
| `MAX_VALUE` | Maximum value is {maxValue}. | Above `maxValue`. | Corrective |
| `INVALID_PHONE` | Enter a valid phone number. | `TEL` value (with `validation.enabled`) with characters other than digits, spaces, `+`, `-`, `(`, `)`, or without digits. | Corrective |
| `PATTERN` | Enter a value in the required format. | Value does not match `validation.pattern`. | Corrective |
| `UNIDENTIFIED` | An unidentified error occurred. | Unknown error label. | Dismissible |

Timing: errors are shown on `validate()`, `setValue()` and on blur once the user has changed the value; tabbing through an untouched field shows nothing. While the user types, a visible corrective error is updated or cleared immediately, but new errors are not shown. Number rules are checked only on blur and final validation. Errors are not announced by the field; the consumer's error summary announces them.

Developer errors prevent rendering (`renderTextInput()` returns `null`); warnings are logged and rendering continues. Console format: `TextInput "id" [LABEL]: message`.

| Label | Severity | Cause |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CONTAINER_REQUIRED` | error | No container passed. |
| `ID_REQUIRED` | error | `id` is empty. |
| `UNSAFE_ID` | error | `id` is not DOM-safe. |
| `DUPLICATE_ID` | error | An element with the same id already exists in the document. |
| `INVALID_OPTION` | warning | Invalid enumerated value or number; the default is used. |
| `INVALID_ICON_CLASS` | warning | Invalid class names removed from an icon option. |
| `MIN_LENGTH_CLAMPED` | warning | `minLength` greater than `maxLength`. |
| `OPTION_IGNORED` | warning | `iconArea.staticIcon` or `actions` with `PASSWORD`, `validation.pattern` with `NUMBER`, more than one action, or an action without icon. |
| `OPTIONS_CONFLICT` | warning | `iconArea.staticIcon` and `actions` both set; the action is shown. |
| `INVALID_ACTION` | warning | An action without key or label; dropped. |
| `DUPLICATE_ACTION_KEY` | warning | A duplicate action key; the later action is dropped. |
| `UNKNOWN_ACTION` | warning | `setActionDisabled()` names no action. |
| `ACTION_HANDLER_MISSING` | warning | An action without `onAction`; its Button is rendered disabled. |
| `INVALID_PATTERN` | warning | `validation.pattern` is not a valid regular expression; ignored. |

### Accessibility

- The label is linked with `for`; mandatory fields have `aria-required="true"`. The asterisk is `aria-hidden` (announced through `aria-required`); the optional text is part of the label.
- Help and visible error are linked through `aria-describedby`; an error sets `aria-invalid="true"`. The error is read when the user reaches the field; it is not a live region, so leaving a field or submitting never produces a burst of announcements.
- The consumer provides the error summary (announced, with links) and uses `focus()` to move the user to a field.
- The password toggle is a Button with `aria-pressed` and a translated accessible name; focus returns to the input after toggling.
- Errors are updated in place, so focus, cursor position and typing are never interrupted.
- A disabled field (native `disabled`, also through a disabled `fieldset`) is announced as unavailable; its label and text use `--c-muted`, which keeps about 4.9:1 contrast on the page background (above the 4.5:1 minimum).

### Examples

Login form with an error summary (the summary markup and styles belong to the application):

```js
const fields = [
    { label:'E-mail', instance:renderTextInput(emailHost,{ id:'login-email', label:'E-mail', type:'EMAIL', mandatoryIndicator:'MANDATORY_ASTERISK', autocomplete:'username', texts:{ errors:{ REQUIRED:'Enter your e-mail address.' } } }) },
    { label:'Password', instance:renderTextInput(passwordHost,{ id:'login-password', label:'Password', type:'PASSWORD', mandatoryIndicator:'MANDATORY_ASTERISK', autocomplete:'current-password', texts:{ errors:{ REQUIRED:'Enter your password.' } } }) }
];

loginForm.addEventListener('submit',event =>
{
    const invalid = fields.filter(field => !field.instance.validate().valid);
    if ( invalid.length === 0 ) { summary.hidden = true; return; }
    event.preventDefault();
    summary.innerHTML = `<h2 id="summary-title" tabindex="-1">There is a problem</h2><ul>${invalid.map(( field,index ) => `<li><a href="#" data-index="${index}">${field.instance.getError().message}</a></li>`).join('')}</ul>`;
    summary.hidden = false;
    summary.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(link => link.addEventListener('click',linkEvent => { linkEvent.preventDefault(); invalid[link.dataset.index].instance.focus(); }));
    summary.querySelector('#summary-title').focus();
});
```

Moving focus to the summary heading makes screen readers read it once. The form also contains the line "* Required field" and uses `<form novalidate>`.

Phone number and postal code with a required format:

```js
renderTextInput(phoneHost,{ id:'phone', label:'Phone', type:'TEL', validation:{ enabled:true, maxLength:20 } });
renderTextInput(postalHost,{ id:'postal-code', label:'Postal code', validation:{ enabled:true, pattern:'[0-9]{6}' }, texts:{ errors:{ PATTERN:'Enter the 6-digit postal code.' } } });
```

Translated number rules:

```js
renderTextInput(host,
{
    id:'quantity', label:'Menge', type:'NUMBER', inputMode:'NUMERIC', mandatory:false, mandatoryIndicator:'OPTIONAL_TEXT',
    validation:{ enabled:true, numberType:'INTEGER', minValue:1, maxValue:99 },
    texts:{ optional:'(optional)', errors:{ INTEGER_REQUIRED:'Bitte eine ganze Zahl eingeben.', MIN_VALUE:'Mindestens {minValue}.', MAX_VALUE:'Höchstens {maxValue}.' } }
});
```

### Files

| File | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `textInputIndex.js` | Public entry point; the only import surface. |
| `textInputConfig.js` | Defaults, allowed values, normalization, developer validation. |
| `textInputComponent.js` | Lifecycle, error lifecycle, child Button composition, runtime API. |
| `textInputHTML.js` | Markup generation (rendered once). |
| `textInputEvents.js` | Input and blur listener registration. |
| `textInputState.js` | Per-instance runtime state. |
| `textInputValidation.js` | Validation rules (pure functions). |
| `textInputErrors.js` | User error catalog and developer error and warning catalog. |
| `textInput.css` | Presentation. |
| `textInputTESTS.md` | Test plan: the cases that prove this README (automatic ones in `tests/components/textInput.test.mjs`). |


<!-- ===== source/components-js/toggle/toggleREADME.md ===== -->

# Toggle

## For business

### Overview

Toggle captures one yes/no decision. It comes in two forms: a **switch** (a slider that is on or off, typical for settings that take effect immediately) and a **pair of radio buttons** (e.g. "Yes" / "No", typical for questions that need an explicit answer).

### When to use

- Use the switch for a setting that takes effect immediately, e.g. "Email notifications".
- Use the pair of radio buttons for a yes/no question that needs an explicit answer, e.g. in a form.
- Use CheckboxRadio for more than two options, and a one-option checkbox for consent ("I accept the terms").

### Key features

- Two forms: a switch (always on or off) or a pair of radio buttons ("Yes" / "No").
- Custom value texts, e.g. "Active" / "Inactive", shown as the current value or both values around the switch.
- A busy state while the application saves an immediate change, and a way back when saving fails.
- On and off colours from the design system, two sizes.

### Dependencies

| Dependency | Needed when | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Design system (`design-system.css`) | Always | Colours (including the switch tokens), spacing and typography. |
| Toggle styles (`toggle.css`) | Always | Switch and layout. |

### Not included

The application saves immediate changes, shows save errors and reverts the switch when saving fails, explains the asterisk, and shows the form's error summary.

## For designers

### Structure

```text
SWITCH
div.ui-toggle.ui-toggle-switch.ui-toggle-size-{small|medium}[.ui-toggle-display-both][.ui-toggle-busy]
├── label.ui-toggle-label
├── div.ui-toggle-row
│   ├── span.ui-toggle-side.ui-toggle-side-off                      (BOTH; aria-hidden, clickable)
│   ├── span.ui-toggle-control
│   │   ├── input.ui-toggle-input  type="checkbox" role="switch"   (native, transparent, on top of the track)
│   │   └── span.ui-toggle-track > span.ui-toggle-knob             (aria-hidden)
│   ├── span.ui-toggle-side.ui-toggle-side-on                       (BOTH; aria-hidden, clickable)
│   └── span.ui-toggle-state                                        (CURRENT; aria-hidden; not with NONE)
└── div.ui-toggle-help                                              (optional)

RADIO
fieldset.ui-toggle.ui-toggle-radio.ui-toggle-{horizontal|vertical}[.ui-toggle-invalid]  role="radiogroup"
├── legend.ui-toggle-label  (+ span.ui-toggle-optional | span.ui-toggle-mandatory)
├── div.ui-toggle-options
│   └── label.ui-toggle-option > input.ui-toggle-radio-input type="radio" + span.ui-toggle-option-label   (×2)
├── div.ui-toggle-help                                              (optional)
└── div.ui-toggle-error                                             (hidden when there is no error)

VIEW
div.ui-toggle.ui-toggle-view > p.ui-toggle-label + p.ui-toggle-view-value
```

The track colour changes between the local properties `--ui-toggle-off-bg` and `--ui-toggle-on-bg` (mapped to `--toggle-track-off-bg` / `--toggle-track-on-bg` or to the tokens configured per instance) and the knob moves from start to end (logical properties, so it mirrors in right-to-left languages). Keyboard focus draws the focus outline around the track; disabled reduces its opacity. While busy, the knob becomes a spinner (static with reduced motion). With both values visible, "Off" is placed before and "On" after the switch, so the knob moves toward the active value (mirrored in right-to-left languages); the active value is bold in the text colour, the other muted. Radio buttons use native rendering; a shown error colours the question.

### Visual options

| Option | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Label position | Top, left | `ui-toggle-label-top`, `ui-toggle-label-start`, or `INHERIT` inside an element with `ui-labels-start` |
| Presentation | Switch, radio buttons | `ui-toggle-switch`, `ui-toggle-radio` |
| Size (switch) | Small, medium | `ui-toggle-size-small`, `ui-toggle-size-medium` |
| State text | None, On/Off, custom | no state text, or its text |
| State display (switch) | Current value, both values | `span.ui-toggle-state`, `ui-toggle-display-both` + `span.ui-toggle-side-*` |
| Track colours (switch) | Design tokens | `--ui-toggle-on-bg`, `--ui-toggle-off-bg` (inline) |
| Direction (radio) | Horizontal, vertical | `ui-toggle-horizontal`, `ui-toggle-vertical` |

### States

| State | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Value | Off, on | `input:not(:checked)`, `input:checked` |
| Busy (switch) | On | `ui-toggle-busy` |

### Styling contract

`toggle.css` has three parts, marked in the stylesheet. Restyle by writing the same selector with a new value in your own stylesheet, inside `@layer overrides` (preferred: library updates keep your changes), or by changing a value in your copy of the stylesheet. After each token come the parts it styles, named by their class without `ui-toggle-` (as in Structure), with the option or state in brackets (joined by “+” when they apply together). Text uses the typography roles of `design-system.css`; border sides are physical (top, right, bottom, left).

**1. Appearance — change freely** (colours, type, borders, corners, motion: only the look changes)

- Colours
  - `--c-text`: label, view value, state, side (on + display both + checked, off + display both), option
  - `--c-muted`: optional, help, label (disabled), mandatory (disabled), side
  - `--c-danger-text`: mandatory, error, label (invalid)
  - `--toggle-knob-bg`: knob
  - `--c-border`: knob (busy)
  - `--c-accent`: knob (busy)
- Typography
  - `--font-ui`: toggle
  - `--fw-ui`: toggle, optional
  - `--fs-label`: label, help, error
  - `--fw-ui-strong`: label, error, side (on + display both + checked, off + display both)
  - `--lh-compact`: label
  - `--lh-body`: help, error
  - `--fs-control`: view value, state, side, option
- Borders and corners
  - `--radius-pill`: track, knob
  - `--border-thick`: knob (busy)
- Shadows
  - `--shadow-sm`: knob
- States and motion
  - `--transition-1`: track, knob
  - `--opacity-disabled`: track (disabled), side (display both + disabled), option (disabled)
  - `--spinner-duration`: knob (busy)

**2. Dimensions — change with care** (sizes and spacing: the component keeps working, its size changes)

- Borders and corners
  - `--border-thick`: knob (also checked)
- Spacing
  - `--gap-tight`: toggle, options (vertical)
  - `--gap-section`: toggle
  - `--gap-inline-items`: row, option
  - `--gap-toolbar`: options
- Sizes
  - `--toggle-track-width`: toggle (size medium)
  - `--toggle-track-height`: toggle (size medium)
  - `--toggle-track-width-small`: toggle (size small)
  - `--toggle-track-height-small`: toggle (size small)
  - `--ui-toggle-height` (defined in this stylesheet): knob (also checked)
  - `--ui-toggle-width` (defined in this stylesheet): knob (checked)

**3. Structure — don't change** (layout, behaviour, states, accessibility)

- States and motion
  - `--focus-outline`: track (focus)
  - `--focus-offset`: track (focus)
- Spacing
  - `--gap-toolbar`: toggle (label on the left)
- Sizes
  - `--ui-toggle-width` (defined in this stylesheet): control
  - `--ui-toggle-height` (defined in this stylesheet): control
  - `--form-label-width`: toggle (label on the left)

**Set by the component — don't change**

- Variables
  - `--ui-toggle-on-bg`, `--ui-toggle-off-bg`: track colours (from `onBackgroundToken`, `offBackgroundToken`)

**Used by the code** (the component's code names these tokens; change the token to change the result)

- Tokens
  - `--toggle-track-on-bg`, `--toggle-track-off-bg`: default track colours (`onBackgroundToken`, `offBackgroundToken`)

## For AI-assisted development

### Instructions

- Inside a Form, give the field a `name` (the key of its value) and leave `labelPosition` on `INHERIT`, so the Form (or a ContentGroup with the class `ui-labels-start`) decides label placement for all fields. Show server or cross-field messages with `setError(message)`; they clear when the user changes the value.
- Read this README before writing code. Import only from `toggleIndex.js`.
- Use Toggle for every single yes/no decision; never build switches or yes/no radio pairs by hand.
- Use `presentation:'SWITCH'` for settings (always on or off) and `'RADIO'` for questions that need an explicit answer (value `null` until answered).
- For immediate-effect switches: in `onValueChange`, call `setBusy(true)`, save, then `setBusy(false)`; on failure call `setValue(previousValue)` (no `onValueChange`) and show the error in the page.
- RADIO questions are mandatory by default; set `mandatory:false` explicitly. On submit call `validate()` and use `getError()`/`focus()` in the error summary.
- Choose the texts with `stateText` (`ON_OFF`, `CUSTOM` with `texts.customOn`/`texts.customOff` — e.g. "Yes"/"No" —, or `NONE` for switches) and translate through `texts`. Use `stateDisplay:'BOTH'` to show both values around the switch.
- Change track colours only through `onBackgroundToken`/`offBackgroundToken` with design-token names; keep enough contrast against the surface.
- Give each toggle a unique, DOM-safe `id` and call `destroy()` before rendering into the same container again.

### Safety

- Never remove `role="switch"`, the label association or the radio group's legend.
- Never signal the state by colour alone; keep the knob movement (and state text when the label does not make the state obvious). Never pass literal colours.
- Never leave a switch showing a value that failed to save: revert it with `setValue()`.

### Example prompts

```text
Add a switch "Email notifications" to the settings page that saves immediately through the API, shows the busy state while saving and switches back with an error message if the save fails.
```

```text
Add a mandatory Yes/No question "Do you have a company car?" as two radio buttons marked with an asterisk, and validate it on submit.
```

## For developers

### Business analysis

> **Component**: the Toggle itself. **Consumer**: the developer who configures the Toggle in the application's code. **App**: the running application that uses the Toggle; it provides the data, performs the actions and stores the changes.

**Switch**

- User clicks the switch, or presses Space. <!-- BA-01 -->
  - Component changes the switch to on or off. <!-- BA-02 -->
  - Component reports the new value to the App. <!-- BA-03 -->
- Component displays the state by the knob position and colour, and by a text (optional): "On" / "Off" or a pair chosen by the Consumer, e.g. "Yes" / "No". <!-- BA-04 -->
- Consumer chooses the current value only, or both values around the switch ("Off – switch – On", the active one emphasized). <!-- BA-05 -->
  - User clicks a value. <!-- BA-06 -->
  - Component selects it. <!-- BA-07 -->
- Consumer chooses the on and off colours from the design system, and one of two sizes. <!-- BA-08 -->

**Saving immediate changes**

- App marks the switch as busy while it saves. <!-- BA-09 -->
  - Component prevents another change until the App ends the busy state. <!-- BA-10 -->
- App changes the switch back when saving fails. <!-- BA-11 -->

**Radio buttons**

- Component displays two radio buttons side by side or stacked, labelled "On" / "Off" or a pair chosen by the Consumer. <!-- BA-12 -->
- Component selects nothing until the user or the App sets an answer. <!-- BA-13 -->
- Component checks that a required question has an answer. <!-- BA-14 -->
  - Component displays the error message until the user chooses an answer. <!-- BA-15 -->

**Read-only display**

- Component displays the value as text, e.g. "On", or "—" when there is no answer. <!-- BA-16 -->

### Contracts

**Contracts:** Styling: three parts (Styling contract) · Form field: yes · Actions: no · Shared behaviour: yes, additions under Accessibility

### Public API

```js
import { renderToggle, DEFAULT_TOGGLE_CONFIG, TOGGLE_PRESENTATIONS, TOGGLE_STATES, TOGGLE_STATE_TEXTS, TOGGLE_STATE_DISPLAYS, TOGGLE_SIZES, TOGGLE_DIRECTIONS, TOGGLE_MANDATORY_INDICATORS } from './toggleIndex.js';

const toggle = renderToggle(container, config, onValueChange, onValidation); // null after a developer error
```

`container` is a dedicated, consumer-owned element. Rendering replaces its content; `destroy()` clears it. The configuration is immutable; `config.value` remains the initial value.

| Member | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | The configured id. |
| `name` | string | The configured `name` (the key of the value in a Form). |
| `getLabelPosition()` | `'TOP'` \| `'START'` | Effective label position (`INHERIT` resolved from the surroundings). |
| `getLabel()` | string | The visible label; Form prefixes error-summary entries with it. |
| `getMandatoryState()` | object | `{ mandatory, indicator }`; Form shows "* Required field" when an asterisk is shown. |
| `setError(message)` | `{ valid, errorLabel }` | Shows an external error (server or cross-field rule, label `EXTERNAL`) until the user changes the value or `clearError()` is called; own validation errors take precedence. |
| `clearError()` | — | Removes an external error; own validation errors stay. |
| `getValue()` | boolean \| null | `true`, `false`, or `null` (radio unanswered). |
| `getError()` | object \| null | Copy of the current error (radio `REQUIRED` only). |
| `setValue(value)` | `{ valid, errorLabel }` | Sets the value programmatically (`null` only for radio); no dirty flag, no `onValueChange`. |
| `setValue(value, { quiet:true })` | object | Quiet variant used by Form's quiet reset: sets the value without validating, removes any shown error and the changed state. |
| `validate()` | `{ valid, errorLabel }` | Radio: shows or clears the required error. Switch: always valid. |
| `isDirty()` | boolean | Whether the user has changed the value. |
| `focus()` | boolean | Moves focus to the switch, or to the chosen (else first) radio. |
| `setBusy(busy)` | — | Switch: shows the busy state, sets `aria-busy` and blocks toggling. |
| `destroy()` | — | Removes listeners, clears the container. |

### Configuration

Enumerated values are canonical UPPER_CASE and accepted case-insensitively. An invalid value produces an `INVALID_OPTION` warning and the default is used.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Allowed values / format | Applies when | Usage / description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | — | Starts with a letter; letters, digits, `_ : . -`; unique in the document | Always | Required. Id of the switch input or of the radio group. |
| `name` | string | value of `id` | Text | Always | Native `name`. |
| `label` | string | — | Text | Always | Required. Switch label or question (radio group label). |
| `help` | string | `''` | Text | Always | Help text, linked through `aria-describedby`. |
| `presentation` | string | `'SWITCH'` | `SWITCH`, `RADIO` | Always | Switch or two radio buttons. |
| `state` | string | `'EDIT'` | `EDIT`, `VIEW`, `INACTIVE`, `INVISIBLE` | Always | Display mode. |
| `value` | boolean \| null | `false` (switch), `null` (radio) | `true`, `false`; `null` only for radio | Always | Initial value. |
| `stateText` | string | `'ON_OFF'` | `NONE`, `ON_OFF`, `CUSTOM` | Always | Switch state text or radio labels; `NONE` only for switches. |
| `stateDisplay` | string | `'CURRENT'` | `CURRENT`, `BOTH` | `SWITCH` + not `stateText:NONE` | `CURRENT`: the current value next to the switch. `BOTH`: off value before, on value after the switch; both clickable. |
| `onBackgroundToken` / `offBackgroundToken` | string | `'--toggle-track-on-bg'` / `'--toggle-track-off-bg'` | Design-token name | `SWITCH` | Track colours when on / off. |
| `size` | string | `'MEDIUM'` | `SMALL`, `MEDIUM` | `SWITCH` | Switch size. |
| `direction` | string | `'HORIZONTAL'` | `HORIZONTAL`, `VERTICAL` | `RADIO` | Radio arrangement. |
| `mandatory` | boolean | `true` | — | `RADIO` | `true`: unanswered is a `REQUIRED` error. |
| `mandatoryIndicator` | string | `'NONE'` | `NONE`, `OPTIONAL_TEXT`, `MANDATORY_ASTERISK` | `RADIO` | Marker next to the question. |
| `labelPosition` | string | `'INHERIT'` | `TOP`, `START`, `INHERIT` | Always | Label above the field (`TOP`), on its left (`START`), or as set by the surrounding Form/ContentGroup (`INHERIT`: left inside an element with the class `ui-labels-start`, otherwise on top). `START` needs a surrounding container at least 36rem wide (Form, ContentGroup, CollapsiblePanel, or any element with `container-type:inline-size`); narrower, the label moves on top. |
| `autoFocus` | boolean | `false` | — | `EDIT` | Focuses the control once, after the first render. |
| `texts.on` / `texts.off` | string | `'On'` / `'Off'` | Text | `stateText:ON_OFF`, `VIEW` | State texts (in `VIEW` also with `NONE`). |
| `texts.customOn` / `texts.customOff` | string | `''` | Text, both required | `CUSTOM` | Custom pair; missing texts fall back with `CUSTOM_TEXTS_MISSING`. |
| `texts.optional` | string | `'(Optional)'` | Text | `RADIO`, `mandatory:false` + `OPTIONAL_TEXT` | Optional marker. |
| `texts.unanswered` | string | `'—'` | Text | `VIEW` | Shown for `null`. |
| `texts.errors.REQUIRED` | string | `'Select an answer.'` | Text | `RADIO` + `mandatory` | Required message. |

`mandatory`, `mandatoryIndicator` and `direction` with a switch; `size`, `stateDisplay` and the colour tokens with radios; `stateText:'NONE'` with radios and `stateDisplay:'BOTH'` with `stateText:'NONE'` are ignored with an `OPTION_IGNORED` warning.

### Callbacks

| Callback | Arguments | Fires when | Does not fire when |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `onValueChange` | `(value, instance)`, `value` `true` / `false` | The user flips the switch (also by clicking a visible value) or picks an answer. | `setValue()`, clicks while busy, clicking the already active value, initial render. |
| `onValidation` | `(result, instance)` with `result = { valid, errorLabel }` | The effective result changes (radio answered, `validate()`, `setValue()`). | The result is unchanged; switches (always valid) after the first report. |

### Errors

| Label | Default message | Trigger | Visibility |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `EXTERNAL` | Message passed to `setError()`. | `setError(message)`, e.g. from a Form (server errors, cross-field rules). | Corrective |
| `REQUIRED` | Select an answer. | Mandatory radio unanswered; shown on `validate()`, `setValue()`, or when the user leaves the question after changing it; cleared as soon as an answer is chosen. | Corrective |
| `UNIDENTIFIED` | An unidentified error occurred. | Unknown error label. | Dismissible |

Developer errors prevent rendering (`renderToggle()` returns `null`); warnings are logged and rendering continues. Console format: `Toggle "id" [LABEL]: message`.

| Label | Severity | Cause |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CONTAINER_REQUIRED` | error | No container passed. |
| `ID_REQUIRED` | error | `id` is empty. |
| `UNSAFE_ID` | error | `id` is not DOM-safe. |
| `DUPLICATE_ID` | error | An element with the same id already exists in the document. |
| `LABEL_REQUIRED` | error | `label` is empty. |
| `INVALID_OPTION` | warning | Invalid enumerated value, token name, `value` or `setValue()` argument. |
| `OPTION_IGNORED` | warning | Option that does not apply to the presentation. |
| `CUSTOM_TEXTS_MISSING` | warning | `stateText:'CUSTOM'` without both custom texts. |

### Accessibility

- Switch: native `input type="checkbox"` with `role="switch"` (announced as "switch, on/off"), label linked with `for`, Space toggles; the visual track and state texts (also the clickable values of `BOTH`, a pointer convenience) are `aria-hidden` so the state is not read twice; `aria-busy` while saving.
- Radio: native radios in a `fieldset` with `role="radiogroup"` named by the question (legend), `aria-required` when mandatory; help and a visible error are linked to the radios through `aria-describedby` with `aria-invalid`.
- State is shown by knob position and colour (and optional text), never colour alone; the off track meets 3:1 contrast against the surface.
- Errors are not announced by the field; the consumer's error summary does that.

### Examples

Immediate-effect setting with busy state and revert on failure:

```js
renderToggle(settingHost,{ id:'email-notifications', label:'Email notifications', value:user.emailNotifications },async ( value, toggle ) =>
{
    toggle.setBusy(true);
    try { await saveSetting('emailNotifications',value); }
    catch { toggle.setValue(!value); showPageError('The setting could not be saved.'); }
    finally { toggle.setBusy(false); }
});
```

Mandatory question validated on submit:

```js
const companyCar = renderToggle(questionHost,{ id:'company-car', label:'Do you have a company car?', presentation:'RADIO', stateText:'CUSTOM', texts:{ customOn:'Yes', customOff:'No' }, mandatoryIndicator:'MANDATORY_ASTERISK' });
form.addEventListener('submit',event => { if ( !companyCar.validate().valid ) { event.preventDefault(); showErrorSummary([ { message:companyCar.getError().message, focus:companyCar.focus } ]); } });
```

### Files

| File | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `toggleIndex.js` | Public entry point; the only import surface. |
| `toggleConfig.js` | Defaults, allowed values, state texts, normalization, developer validation. |
| `toggleComponent.js` | Lifecycle, switch behaviour and busy state, radio error lifecycle, runtime API. |
| `toggleHTML.js` | Switch, radio and view markup. |
| `toggleEvents.js` | Switch change, busy guard and value clicks; radio change and focus leave. |
| `toggleState.js` | Per-instance runtime state (value, dirty, busy, error). |
| `toggleErrors.js` | User error catalog and developer error and warning catalog. |
| `toggle.css` | Presentation. |
| `toggleTESTS.md` | Test plan: the cases that prove this README (automatic ones in `tests/components/toggle.test.mjs`). |


<!-- ===== source/components-js/tooltip/tooltipREADME.md ===== -->

# Tooltip

## For business

### Overview

Tooltip shows a short text next to an element when the user points at it or reaches it with the keyboard: the name of an icon-only button ("Delete"), the full text of a cut-off name, or a short explanation ("Fill in the required fields first"). Typical uses are toolbars of icon buttons, navigation rails, table cells and unavailable actions.

### When to use

- Use it for a short, plain text that names or explains an element; the user only reads it.
- Use the element's visible text when there is room, and a field's help text for anything the user needs to fill in a field.
- Use Message for information the user must not miss, and a dialog (Message `MODAL`) for content with buttons or links: a tooltip holds no controls.

### Key features

- Appears after a short pause under the pointer, at once on keyboard focus, and at once when the user moves on to the next tooltip; one at a time.
- Stays while the pointer is on it, hides with Escape (focus stays), when the pointer or focus leaves, or when the element is pressed.
- Above, below, before or after the element, with an arrow; it moves to the other side when there is no room and stays inside the window, never cut off by panels or tables.
- One tooltip for a single element, or for every element of a group (e.g. all cut-off names of a list), optionally only when the text is cut off.
- A keyboard shortcut shown after the text ("Save Ctrl+S"); dark (default) or light look.
- Optional long press on touch screens.

### Dependencies

| Dependency | Needed when | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Design system (`design-system.css`) | Always | Colours, type, spacing and corners. |
| Tooltip styles (`tooltip.css`) | Always | The bubble, arrow and shortcut; also the hosts other components create (`.ui-tooltip-host`). |

### Not included

The application provides the texts. Buttons, links or other content inside the bubble (a popover), tooltips that follow the pointer and tooltips on chart points are not part of this version.

## For designers

### Structure

```text
div#{id}.ui-tooltip.ui-tooltip-tone-{inverse|surface}[.ui-tooltip-with-arrow][.ui-tooltip-open]  role="tooltip" (aria-hidden="true" with targets)  popover="manual"  data-side="{TOP|BOTTOM|LEFT|RIGHT}"
├── span.ui-tooltip-text
├── kbd.ui-tooltip-shortcut [hidden]          (shortcut)
└── span.ui-tooltip-arrow                     (arrow)
On the target (one element): aria-describedby="{id}" (DESCRIPTION) or aria-labelledby="{id}" (LABEL)
Other components: span.ui-tooltip-host → the Tooltip's container (tooltipMode TOOLTIP; takes no place)
```

The bubble is drawn above every other layer (the browser's top layer), positioned in the window next to its target. `INVERSE` uses the text colour as background and the surface colour as text (dark on light pages, light in the dark theme); `SURFACE` is a light panel with a thin border and a small shadow. The shortcut is set in the code font, in a thin frame. The arrow is a small turned square on the side facing the target.

### Visual options

| Option | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tone | Inverse, surface | `ui-tooltip-tone-inverse`, `-surface` |
| Arrow | On, off | `ui-tooltip-with-arrow`, — |
| Placement | Top, bottom, start, end | `data-side` (the physical side used: `TOP`, `BOTTOM`, `LEFT`, `RIGHT`) |
| Shortcut | Off, on | `.ui-tooltip-shortcut[hidden]`, `.ui-tooltip-shortcut` |

### States

| State | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tooltip | Shown | `ui-tooltip-open`, `:popover-open` |
| Side | Moved to the other side for lack of room | `data-side` differs from the placement |

### Styling contract

`tooltip.css` has three parts, marked in the stylesheet. Restyle by writing the same selector with a new value in your own stylesheet, inside `@layer overrides` (preferred: library updates keep your changes), or by changing a value in your copy of the stylesheet. After each token come the parts it styles, named by their class without `ui-tooltip-` (as in Structure), with the option or state in brackets (joined by “+” when they apply together). Text uses the typography roles of `design-system.css`; border sides are physical (top, right, bottom, left).

**1. Appearance — change freely** (colours, type, borders, corners, motion: only the look changes)

- Colours
  - `--c-text`: tooltip (tone inverse, tone surface), arrow (tone inverse, tone surface)
  - `--c-surface`: tooltip (tone inverse, tone surface), arrow (tone inverse, tone surface)
  - `--c-border`: tooltip (tone surface), arrow (tone surface + side top, tone surface + side bottom, tone surface + side left, tone surface + side right)
- Typography
  - `--font-ui`: tooltip
  - `--fw-ui`: tooltip
  - `--fs-caption`: tooltip, shortcut
  - `--lh-compact`: tooltip
  - `--font-code`: shortcut
- Borders and corners
  - `--radius-xs`: tooltip, shortcut
  - `--border-thin`: tooltip (tone surface), arrow (tone surface + side top, tone surface + side bottom, tone surface + side left, tone surface + side right), shortcut
- Shadows
  - `--shadow-sm`: tooltip (tone surface)
- States and motion
  - `--transition-1`: tooltip
  - `--opacity-muted`: shortcut

**2. Dimensions — change with care** (sizes and spacing: the component keeps working, its size changes)

- Spacing
  - `--gap-tight`: tooltip
  - `--space-sm-2`: tooltip, shortcut
- Sizes
  - `--size-md-2`: tooltip
  - `--space-md-1`: tooltip, arrow

**3. Structure — don't change** (layout, behaviour, states, accessibility)

- No tokens.

**Set by the component — don't change**

- Variables
  - `--ui-tooltip-left`, `--ui-tooltip-top`: position of the tooltip in the window (measured from the target)
  - `--ui-tooltip-arrow`: distance of the arrow from the tooltip's left or top edge, so it points at the target (measured)

**Used by the code** (the component's code names these tokens; change the token to change the result)

- Tokens
  - `--space-md-1`: read: gap between the target and the tooltip, and margin from the window edges
  - `--space-md-3`: read: smallest distance of the arrow from a corner

## For AI-assisted development

### Instructions

- Read this README before writing code. Import only from `tooltipIndex.js`.
- Check the configuration before adding code; configure instead of building hover bubbles, delays, positioning or Escape handling.
- Give the tooltip its own container next to the target, never inside a button or link (`CONTAINER_IN_TARGET`); for many elements use one Tooltip with `targets` and `data-tooltip` or `targets.text`.
- Use `purpose:'LABEL'` only when the tooltip is the element's only name (icon-only controls); otherwise keep `DESCRIPTION`.
- Keep the text short and plain; never put information the user must act on only in a tooltip (touch users may never see it).
- For an unavailable control that explains why, use `aria-disabled="true"` instead of `disabled` (a `disabled` element receives no pointer or focus events).
- In other components, prefer their `tooltipMode` option to adding Tooltips yourself.
- Use unique ids, and call `destroy()` before rendering into the same container again.

### Safety

- Texts are inserted as text.
- Don't remove `role="tooltip"` or the `aria-describedby` / `aria-labelledby` link the component sets.
- Don't hide essential instructions or errors in a tooltip.

### Example prompts

```text
Give every icon button in the report toolbar a tooltip with its name and keyboard shortcut.
```

```text
Show the full customer name in a tooltip when it is cut off in the narrow list on the dashboard.
```

## For developers

### Business analysis

> **Component**: the Tooltip itself. **Consumer**: the developer who configures the Tooltip in the application's code. **App**: the running application that uses the Tooltip; it provides the data, performs the actions and stores the changes.

**Showing and hiding**

- User hovers over the element. <!-- BA-01 -->
  - Component displays the tooltip after a short pause. <!-- BA-02 -->
  - Component displays it at once when another tooltip was just displayed. <!-- BA-03 -->
- User presses Tab to reach the element. <!-- BA-04 -->
  - Component displays the tooltip at once. <!-- BA-05 -->
- User hovers over the tooltip. <!-- BA-06 -->
  - Component keeps the tooltip. <!-- BA-07 -->
- User presses Escape. <!-- BA-08 -->
  - Component hides the tooltip and keeps the focus where it is. <!-- BA-09 -->
- User leaves the element and the tooltip, or moves the focus away. <!-- BA-10 -->
  - Component hides the tooltip after a short pause. <!-- BA-11 -->
- User clicks the element. <!-- BA-12 -->
  - Component hides the tooltip. <!-- BA-13 -->
- Component displays one tooltip at a time. <!-- BA-14 -->
- Consumer enables long press on touch screens (optional). <!-- BA-15 -->
  - User presses the element for half a second. <!-- BA-16 -->
    - Component displays the tooltip for a moment and prevents the click that ends the press. <!-- BA-17 -->

**Content and position**

- App provides the text of the tooltip. <!-- BA-18 -->
- Consumer provides a keyboard shortcut shown after the text (optional). <!-- BA-19 -->
- Consumer chooses the side: above, below, before or after the element. <!-- BA-20 -->
  - Component moves the tooltip to the opposite side when there is no room. <!-- BA-21 -->
  - Component keeps the tooltip inside the window. <!-- BA-22 -->
- Consumer chooses a dark or a light look, with or without an arrow. <!-- BA-23 -->
- Consumer chooses one tooltip for a group of elements, each with its own text (optional). <!-- BA-24 -->
- Consumer chooses to display the tooltip only when the element's text is cut off (optional). <!-- BA-25 -->
- App changes the text. <!-- BA-26 -->
- App disables the tooltip. <!-- BA-27 -->

**Screen readers**

- Component exposes the tooltip as the element's description, or as its name for elements that have no other name. <!-- BA-28 -->
- Component hides a group's tooltip from screen readers, because the elements already carry their text. <!-- BA-29 -->

### Contracts

**Contracts:** Styling: three parts (Styling contract) · Form field: no · Actions: no · Shared behaviour: yes, additions under Accessibility

### Public API

```js
import { renderTooltip, DEFAULT_TOOLTIP_CONFIG, TOOLTIP_PURPOSES, TOOLTIP_PLACEMENTS, TOOLTIP_TONES } from './tooltipIndex.js';

const tooltip = renderTooltip(container, config); // null after a developer error
```

`container` is a dedicated, consumer-owned element next to the target (not inside it when the target is a button or link). Rendering replaces its content; `destroy()` clears it and removes the link from the target.

| Member | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | The configured id. |
| `setText(text)` | — | Changes the text (`target`); an empty text hides the tooltip. With `targets`: `OPTION_IGNORED`. |
| `show(element?)` | boolean | Shows the tooltip now (next to `target`, or next to `element` with `targets`); `false` without text, when disabled, or when `onlyWhenTruncated` and nothing is cut off. |
| `hide()` | — | Hides the tooltip now. |
| `setDisabled(disabled)` | — | Turns the tooltip off (it hides and no longer shows) or on. |
| `getState()` | object | `{ visible, text, disabled }`. |
| `destroy()` | — | Removes the listeners and the link from the target, clears the container. |

### Configuration

| Parameter | Type | Default | Allowed values / format | Applies when | Usage / description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | — | Starts with a letter; letters, digits, `_ : . -`; unique in the document | Always | Required. Id of the bubble (also the value of the target's `aria-describedby` / `aria-labelledby`). |
| `target` | Element | `null` | An element | Always | The element the tooltip belongs to. Required unless `targets` is given (`TARGET_REQUIRED`). |
| `targets` | object | `null` | `{ within, selector, text? }` | not `target` | One tooltip for every element matching `selector` inside `within` (also added later). The text is `text(element)`, else the element's `data-tooltip`, else its own text. The tooltip is visual only: the elements must carry their text for screen readers. |
| `text` | string | `''` | Text | `target` | The text; without it the tooltip does not show (`TEXT_REQUIRED`) until `setText()`. |
| `shortcut` | string | `''` | Text, e.g. `'Ctrl+S'` | Always | A keyboard shortcut shown after the text. |
| `purpose` | string | `'DESCRIPTION'` | `DESCRIPTION`, `LABEL` | `target` | `DESCRIPTION`: the target's description (`aria-describedby`). `LABEL`: its name (`aria-labelledby`), for elements without another name. |
| `placement` | string | `'TOP'` | `TOP`, `BOTTOM`, `START`, `END` | Always | Preferred side; `START` / `END` follow the text direction. The opposite side is used when there is no room. |
| `arrow` | boolean | `true` | — | Always | An arrow pointing at the target. |
| `tone` | string | `'INVERSE'` | `INVERSE`, `SURFACE` | Always | Dark bubble (the text colour as background) or a light panel with a border. |
| `onlyWhenTruncated` | boolean | `false` | — | Always | Shows only when the element's text (or the text of an element inside it) is cut off. |
| `longPress` | boolean | `false` | — | Always | On touch screens a press of half a second shows the tooltip for 1.5 s; the click that ends the press is not sent and no context menu opens. |
| `showDelayMs` | number | `500` | 0 or more | Always | Pause before showing under the pointer (keyboard focus and the next tooltip right after another: at once). |
| `hideDelayMs` | number | `100` | 0 or more | Always | Pause before hiding after the pointer leaves (time to move onto the tooltip). |
| `disabled` | boolean | `false` | — | Always | Starts turned off (`setDisabled()` turns it on). |

The tooltip shows on keyboard focus only when the browser shows a focus ring (`:focus-visible`), not after a mouse click. Elements with `disabled` receive no events, so use `aria-disabled="true"` on an unavailable control that needs an explanation. Options that do not apply are ignored with `OPTION_IGNORED`.

### Errors

Tooltip has no user-facing errors. Developer errors prevent rendering; warnings are logged and rendering continues. Console format: `Tooltip "id" [LABEL]: message`.

| Label | Severity | Cause |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CONTAINER_REQUIRED` | error | No container passed. |
| `ID_REQUIRED` | error | `id` is empty. |
| `UNSAFE_ID` | error | `id` is not DOM-safe. |
| `DUPLICATE_ID` | error | An element with the same id already exists in the document. |
| `TARGET_REQUIRED` | error | Neither `target` (an element) nor valid `targets` (`within` an element, a `selector`). |
| `CONTAINER_IN_TARGET` | error | The container is inside the target. |
| `INVALID_OPTION` | warning | Invalid enumerated value or delay; the default is used. |
| `OPTION_IGNORED` | warning | An option that does not apply (`targets` with `target`, `purpose` or `text` with `targets`, `setText()` with `targets`). |
| `TEXT_REQUIRED` | warning | `target` without `text`; nothing shows until `setText()`. |

### Accessibility

- One target: `role="tooltip"`, linked from the target with `aria-describedby` (`DESCRIPTION`) or `aria-labelledby` (`LABEL`) for the whole life of the component, so screen readers read it whether it is shown or not.
- `targets`: the bubble is `aria-hidden` (the elements already carry their text, e.g. a cut-off name).
- Follows WCAG 1.4.13: the pointer can move onto the tooltip, Escape hides it without moving focus (and stops the Escape from reaching other components, e.g. a dialog), and it stays until the pointer or focus leaves.
- The tooltip never takes focus and holds no controls.
- With reduced motion it appears without fading.

### Examples

An icon button named by its tooltip, with a shortcut:

```js
renderButton(saveHost,{ id:'save', buttonVariant:'ICON_BUTTON', icon:'fa-solid fa-floppy-disk', ariaLabel:'Save' });
renderTooltip(saveTipHost,{ id:'save-tip', target:document.getElementById('save'), text:'Save', shortcut:'Ctrl+S', purpose:'LABEL' });
```

(Button can do this itself: `tooltipMode:'TOOLTIP'`.)

Full names in a narrow list, only when cut off:

```js
renderTooltip(listTipHost,{ id:'names-tip', targets:{ within:list, selector:'.name' }, onlyWhenTruncated:true });
```

Why an action is unavailable, also on touch screens:

```js
publish.setAttribute('aria-disabled','true');
renderTooltip(publishTipHost,{ id:'publish-tip', target:publish, text:'Fill in the required fields first', longPress:true });
```

### Files

| File | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `tooltipIndex.js` | Public entry point; the only import surface. |
| `tooltipConfig.js` | Defaults, allowed values, normalization, developer validation. |
| `tooltipComponent.js` | Lifecycle, showing and hiding (delays, one at a time, Escape, long press), the text, the link from the target, positioning, runtime API. |
| `tooltipPosition.js` | Side, opposite side, shift inside the window and arrow offset (pure). |
| `tooltipEvents.js` | Pointer, focus, touch, Escape, scroll and resize listeners; the document events that keep one tooltip at a time. |
| `tooltipHTML.js` | Bubble markup. |
| `tooltipErrors.js` | Developer error and warning catalog. |
| `tooltip.css` | Presentation of the bubble, arrow and shortcut; the hosts of other components. |
| `tooltipTESTS.md` | Test plan: the cases that prove this README (automatic ones in `tests/components/tooltip.test.mjs`). |


<!-- ===== source/components-js/topNavigation/topNavigationREADME.md ===== -->

# TopNavigation

## For business

### Overview

TopNavigation is the application's main navigation as a horizontal bar, usually inside the page header. It opens the sub-pages of each section in a dropdown panel and adapts to the width of the page.

### When to use

- Use it for the application's main navigation as a horizontal bar in the page header, with up to two levels.
- Use SideNavigation for deeper menus or many sections, and Breadcrumbs to show where the user is in the page hierarchy.
- Use ActionMenu for actions, not for pages.

### Key features

- Main sections in a bar; sub-pages in dropdown panels opened by click or keyboard, never by hover.
- Two panel types per section: a simple list or a wide "mega menu" with columns and descriptions.
- The current page marked, its section highlighted as an underline, a pill or a raised tab.
- Sections that do not fit move into "More"; on phones the bar becomes a menu button.
- Icons, counters, unavailable pages and external links with a "new tab" hint.

### Dependencies

| Dependency | Needed when | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Design system (`design-system.css`) | Always | Colours, spacing and typography. |
| TopNavigation styles (`topNavigation.css`) | Always | Bar, panels, "More", narrow-screen panel. |
| Button component and `button.css` | Always | The menu button on narrow screens. |
| Font Awesome icon library | Always | Menu button, external-link and item icons. Loaded by the application page. |
| Tooltip component and `tooltip.css` | `tooltipMode` `TOOLTIP` | Tooltips (the Tooltip module is loaded only then). |

### Not included

The application loads the pages (e.g. filtered by permissions), converts them to the item format, keeps its own copy for routing, and provides the header layout around the navigation (logo, search, user menu, sticky behaviour). Deeper levels than two belong in SideNavigation.

## For designers

### Structure

```text
nav#{id}.ui-top-nav.ui-top-nav-current-{underline|pill|tab}
├── span.ui-top-nav-menu-host → Button (menu)                          (below 48rem)
├── ul.ui-top-nav-bar
│   ├── li.ui-top-nav-item[.ui-top-nav-current-branch]
│   │   ├── a.ui-top-nav-link | button.ui-top-nav-link.ui-top-nav-trigger (+ span.ui-top-nav-chevron)
│   │   ├── button.ui-top-nav-toggle                                   (section that is also a page)
│   │   └── div.ui-top-nav-panel.ui-top-nav-panel-{list-style|mega}    (hidden until opened)
│   │       ├── LIST: ul.ui-top-nav-panel-list > li > a.ui-top-nav-entry | li.ui-top-nav-group | li.ui-top-nav-separator
│   │       └── MEGA: div.ui-top-nav-column > p.ui-top-nav-group-label + ul > li > a.ui-top-nav-entry (label + description)
│   └── li.ui-top-nav-item.ui-top-nav-more > button.ui-top-nav-more-button + div.ui-top-nav-panel   (when needed)
└── div.ui-top-nav-mobile > ul.ui-top-nav-mobile-list                  (below 48rem, expandable sections)
```

Bar items have the control height and focus outline. Under the pointer each current-page style uses its own shape: underline a muted bar under the item (no background), pill the same pill shape and wider side padding as the current item, tab a background with square bottom corners like the tab. The current section is bold and, depending on the style, underlined with an accent bar, on a soft pill background, or raised as a tab on the bar's bottom line. "More" is an outlined accent pill. Panels are cards with a shadow below their item, aligned to its start (to its end, or above it, when they would not fit in the window); the mega panel spans the navigation's width with a responsive column grid. On narrow screens the bar is replaced by the menu button and a full-width panel.

### Visual options

| Option | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Current page style | Underline, pill, tab | `ui-top-nav-current-underline`, `-pill`, `-tab` |
| Panel | List, mega menu | `ui-top-nav-panel-list-style`, `ui-top-nav-panel-mega` |
| Overflow | — | `.ui-top-nav-more` (outlined pill) |
| Entry | Link, external, badge | `a.ui-top-nav-entry`, `.ui-top-nav-external`, `.ui-top-nav-badge` |

### States

| State | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Entry | Current, disabled | `[aria-current="page"]`, `.ui-top-nav-disabled` |

### Styling contract

`topNavigation.css` has three parts, marked in the stylesheet. Restyle by writing the same selector with a new value in your own stylesheet, inside `@layer overrides` (preferred: library updates keep your changes), or by changing a value in your copy of the stylesheet. After each token come the parts it styles, named by their class without `ui-top-nav-` (as in Structure), with the option or state in brackets (joined by “+” when they apply together). Text uses the typography roles of `design-system.css`; border sides are physical (top, right, bottom, left).

**1. Appearance — change freely** (colours, type, borders, corners, motion: only the look changes)

- Colours
  - `--c-text`: link, toggle, entry, mobile (link)
  - `--c-muted`: toggle, icon, description, external, item (current underline + hover), group label, mobile (group)
  - `--c-surface-hover`: link (hover), toggle (hover), entry (hover)
  - `--c-accent`: badge, more button, current branch (current underline), link (current tab + current branch), trigger (current tab + current branch)
  - `--c-on-accent`: badge
  - `--c-selected`: link (current pill + current branch), trigger (current pill + current branch), more button (current branch + more), entry (current), mobile (link + current)
  - `--c-border`: bar (current tab), current branch (current tab), panel, separator, mobile
  - `--c-surface`: current branch (current tab), panel, mobile
- Typography
  - `--font-ui`: top navigation
  - `--fw-ui`: top navigation
  - `--fs-control`: top navigation
  - `--fs-caption`: description, badge, external, group label, mobile (group)
  - `--fw-ui-strong`: badge, more button, link (current branch), trigger (current branch), entry (current), group label, mobile (link + current, group)
- Borders and corners
  - `--radius-control`: link, toggle, current branch (current tab), panel
  - `--radius-pill`: badge, more button, current branch (current underline), link (current pill + current branch, current pill), trigger (current pill + current branch), item (current underline + hover), toggle (current pill)
  - `--border-thin`: more button, bar (current tab), current branch (current tab), panel, separator, mobile
  - `--border-thick`: current branch (current underline), item (current underline + hover)
  - `--radius-control-small`: entry, mobile (link)
- Shadows
  - `--shadow-md`: panel, mobile
- States and motion
  - `--opacity-disabled`: disabled
  - `--transition-1`: chevron

**2. Dimensions — change with care** (sizes and spacing: the component keeps working, its size changes)

- Spacing
  - `--gap-tight`: bar, link, toggle, badge, panel, entry, group label, separator, mobile (also group)
  - `--gap-inline-items`: link, toggle, item (current underline), entry, group label, mobile (link)
  - `--space-md-3`: link (current pill)
  - `--gap-block`: panel (mega), mobile (sub, group)
- Sizes
  - `--control-height`: link, toggle, entry
  - `--icon-size-large`: badge
  - `--space-sm-3`: chevron
  - `--size-md-2`: panel
  - `--size-lg-4`: panel (mega)
  - `--size-md-1`: panel (mega)
  - `--control-height-touch`: mobile (link)

**3. Structure — don't change** (layout, behaviour, states, accessibility)

- Borders and corners
  - `--border-thick`: link (focus), toggle (focus), entry (focus), mobile (link + focus)
  - `--border-thin`: chevron
- States and motion
  - `--focus-outline`: link (focus), toggle (focus), entry (focus), mobile (link + focus)

## For AI-assisted development

### Instructions

- Read this README before writing code. Import only from `topNavigationIndex.js`.
- Load the navigation data in the application, map it to two-level items `{ id, label, href?, icon?, badge?, disabled?, external?, panel?, children? }` (children may be `{ type:'GROUP', label, children }`, `{ type:'SEPARATOR' }`, and entries with `description` for mega panels), and keep your own copy for the router.
- Render TopNavigation into a flexible area of the page header; the header itself (logo, search, user menu) is built by the application.
- Use `panel:'MEGA'` for sections with many grouped pages; keep the default list otherwise.
- In single-page applications call `event.preventDefault()` in `onNavigate`, route, and call `setCurrent(id or href)`.
- Give each navigation a unique, DOM-safe `id` and call `destroy()` before rendering into the same container again.

### Safety

- Labels, descriptions and badges are displayed as text; do not pass HTML. Build `href`s from trusted routes only.
- Filter items by permission in the application; hiding a page in the menu does not protect it.
- Never remove `aria-current`, `aria-expanded` or the navigation label.

### Example prompts

```text
Add a TopNavigation to the page header with Dashboard, Projects (list panel), Products (mega menu with Hardware, Software and Services columns and short descriptions) and Settings, highlighting the current section with the pill style.
```

## For developers

### Business analysis

> **Component**: the TopNavigation itself. **Consumer**: the developer who configures the TopNavigation in the application's code. **App**: the running application that uses the TopNavigation; it provides the data, performs the actions and stores the changes.

**Sections**

- App provides the pages: main sections and their sub-pages (two levels). <!-- BA-01 -->
- User clicks a section with sub-pages. <!-- BA-02 -->
  - Component opens its panel and closes any other one. <!-- BA-03 -->
- User presses Escape, clicks outside the panel, or leaves it with the keyboard. <!-- BA-04 -->
  - Component closes the panel. <!-- BA-05 -->
- User clicks a page. <!-- BA-06 -->
  - Component reports the page to the App. <!-- BA-07 -->
  - App opens the page. <!-- BA-08 -->

**Panels**

- Consumer chooses the panel type per section: a simple list or a wide "mega menu" with a column per group. <!-- BA-09 -->
- Consumer provides headings or lines that group the sub-pages (optional). <!-- BA-10 -->
- Consumer provides a short description under each page of a mega menu (optional). <!-- BA-11 -->
- Consumer provides a page for a section itself (optional). <!-- BA-12 -->
  - Component displays its name as a link and a small arrow that opens the panel. <!-- BA-13 -->

**Current page**

- Component displays the current page marked. <!-- BA-14 -->
- Component displays its main section highlighted as an underline (default), a pill or a raised tab, chosen by the Consumer. <!-- BA-15 -->

**Width**

- Component moves the last sections into "More" when the bar is too narrow. <!-- BA-16 -->
  - Component displays "More" as an outlined pill, and highlights it when the current page is inside it. <!-- BA-17 -->
  - Component moves the sections back when the width grows. <!-- BA-18 -->
- Component displays a menu button on phones and narrow screens (below 48rem). <!-- BA-19 -->
  - User clicks the menu button. <!-- BA-20 -->
  - Component opens a panel with all sections as expandable blocks, the section of the current page open. <!-- BA-21 -->

**Entries**

- Consumer provides icons and counters for entries (optional). <!-- BA-22 -->
- Component displays an unavailable page and prevents opening it. <!-- BA-23 -->
- Component displays an external link with a visible and spoken "new tab" hint. <!-- BA-24 -->

**Tooltips**

- Consumer chooses how the menu button shows its name on hover and keyboard focus: the browser's tooltip, a Tooltip or none (optional). <!-- BA-25 -->

### Contracts

**Contracts:** Styling: three parts (Styling contract) · Form field: no · Actions: no · Shared behaviour: yes, additions under Accessibility

### Public API

```js
import { renderTopNavigation, DEFAULT_TOP_NAVIGATION_CONFIG, TOP_NAVIGATION_TOOLTIP_MODES, TOP_NAVIGATION_CURRENT_STYLES, TOP_NAVIGATION_PANELS } from './topNavigationIndex.js';

const navigation = renderTopNavigation(container, config, onNavigate); // null after a developer error
```

| Member | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | The configured id. |
| `setItems(items)` | — | Replaces the items (e.g. after permissions changed). |
| `setCurrent(idOrHref)` | — | Marks the current page and its section. |
| `setBadge(id, badge)` | — | Updates or removes (`''`/`null`) a badge. |
| `close()` | — | Closes any open panel and the narrow-screen panel. |
| `destroy()` | — | Removes listeners and the menu Button, clears the container. |

### Configuration

| Parameter | Type | Default | Allowed values / format | Applies when | Usage / description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | — | Starts with a letter; letters, digits, `_ : . -`; unique in the document | Always | Required. Id of the `<nav>`. |
| `items` | array | `[]` | See Items | Always | Required. Two-level tree. |
| `currentId` | string | `''` | Item id | Always | Initial current page. |
| `currentStyle` | string | `'UNDERLINE'` | `UNDERLINE`, `PILL`, `TAB` | Always | How the current section is highlighted. |
| `tooltipMode` | string | `'NONE'` | `NONE`, `TITLE`, `TOOLTIP` | Always | How the menu button (narrow screens) shows its name on hover and keyboard focus: not at all, the browser's tooltip (`title`, mouse only) or a Tooltip (also on keyboard focus; needs `tooltip.css`, the Tooltip module is loaded only then). |
| `texts.*` | string | English defaults | Text | Always | `navigation` ("Main"), `more` ("More"), `menu` ("Menu"), `subMenu` ("{label} pages", name of a section's arrow button), `newTab`. |
| `onNavigate` | function | `null` | `(item, event, instance) => {}` | Always | Takes precedence over the third argument. |

### Items

| Field | Level | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id`, `label` | Both | Required; ids unique. |
| `href` | Both | Page address; a section with `href` is a page with a separate arrow button, without it the whole item opens the panel. |
| `icon`, `badge`, `disabled`, `external` | Both | Icon classes, counter, unavailable, opens in a new tab. |
| `panel` | Section | `LIST` (default) or `MEGA`. |
| `children` | Section | Sub-pages, `{ type:'GROUP', label, children }` (a column in mega panels) and `{ type:'SEPARATOR' }`. |
| `description` | Sub-page | Short text under the label in mega panels. |

Sub-items below the second level are ignored with `DEPTH_LIMIT`.

### Callbacks

| Callback | Arguments | Fires when | Does not fire when |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `onNavigate` | `({ id, label, href, external }, event, instance)` | A link is chosen in the bar, a panel, "More" or the narrow-screen panel (panels then close). Links navigate unless `event.preventDefault()` is called. | Disabled entries; opening or closing panels. |

### Errors

TopNavigation has no user-facing errors. Developer errors prevent rendering; warnings are logged and rendering continues. Console format: `TopNavigation "id" [LABEL]: message`.

| Label | Severity | Cause |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CONTAINER_REQUIRED` | error | No container passed. |
| `ID_REQUIRED` | error | `id` is empty. |
| `UNSAFE_ID` | error | `id` is not DOM-safe. |
| `DUPLICATE_ID` | error | An element with the same id already exists in the document. |
| `ITEMS_REQUIRED` | error | No usable top-level item (also in `setItems()`, which then keeps the previous items). |
| `INVALID_ITEM` | warning | An item without id or label; dropped. |
| `DUPLICATE_ITEM_ID` | warning | Duplicate item id; the later item is dropped. |
| `DEPTH_LIMIT` | warning | Sub-items below the second level; ignored. |
| `UNKNOWN_ITEM` | warning | `setCurrent()` or `setBadge()` names no item. |
| `INVALID_OPTION` | warning | Invalid `currentStyle` or `panel`; the default is used. |

### Accessibility

- A `<nav>` landmark with a name; the disclosure navigation pattern: real links, and buttons with `aria-expanded`/`aria-controls` that open panels by click, Enter or Space (ArrowDown opens and moves focus into the panel); Escape closes and returns focus; panels close when focus leaves the navigation.
- No hover-opening, so touch and keyboard users get the same behaviour as mouse users.
- The current page has `aria-current="page"`; its section is highlighted by weight plus underline, background or tab shape (not colour alone).
- Groups are lists labelled by their headings; external links say "(opens in a new tab)".
- Narrow screens: the menu Button reports `aria-expanded`; sections are buttons with `aria-expanded`; Escape closes the panel and returns focus to the menu Button.

### Examples

```js
const navigation = renderTopNavigation(headerNavHost,
{
    id:'top-nav', currentStyle:'PILL', currentId:router.currentId(),
    items:[
        { id:'dashboard', label:'Dashboard', href:'/dashboard' },
        { id:'projects', label:'Projects', href:'/projects', children:[ { id:'active', label:'Active', href:'/projects/active' }, { id:'archive', label:'Archive', href:'/projects/archive' } ] },
        { id:'products', label:'Products', panel:'MEGA', children:[
            { type:'GROUP', label:'Hardware', children:[ { id:'laptops', label:'Laptops', href:'/p/laptops', description:'Business laptops and docks' } ] },
            { type:'GROUP', label:'Software', children:[ { id:'office', label:'Office suite', href:'/p/office', description:'Documents, sheets and mail' } ] }
        ] }
    ]
},( item, event ) => { if ( !item.external ) { event.preventDefault(); router.go(item.href); navigation.setCurrent(item.id); } });
```

### Files

| File | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `topNavigationIndex.js` | Public entry point; the only import surface. |
| `topNavigationConfig.js` | Defaults, two-level item normalization, developer validation. |
| `topNavigationComponent.js` | Drawing, panels, "More" (priority+), narrow-screen panel, menu Button, reports. |
| `topNavigationHTML.js` | Bar, panels, "More" and narrow-screen markup. |
| `topNavigationEvents.js` | Click, keyboard, focus, outside-press, resize and viewport listeners. |
| `topNavigationErrors.js` | Developer error and warning catalog. |
| `topNavigation.css` | Presentation. |
| `topNavigationTESTS.md` | Test plan: the cases that prove this README (automatic ones in `tests/components/topNavigation.test.mjs`). |


<!-- ===== source/components-js/treeView/treeViewREADME.md ===== -->

# TreeView

## For business

### Overview

TreeView shows information that has parents and children — folders and files, departments and people, categories and products — as a list the user opens level by level. The user can browse it, pick one item or tick several, search it and, when allowed, reorganise it.

### When to use

- Use it for data with parents and children that users browse or choose from: folders and files, departments and people, categories and products.
- Use SideNavigation for the application's page menu, and Table for flat lists of records.

### Key features

- Pick one item, or tick several with checkboxes; ticking a parent ticks everything under it.
- Search the tree; matches stay visible with the levels above them.
- Load large trees level by level, only when a level is opened.
- Reorganise the tree: add, rename, delete and move items (optional).
- Add the application's own actions for the current item, such as Open or Print.
- Use it inside forms like any other field.

### Dependencies

| Dependency | Needed when | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Design system (`design-system.css`) | Always | Colours, spacing and typography. |
| TreeView styles (`treeView.css`) | Always | Tree appearance. |
| Button component and `button.css` | Editing or application actions | Toolbar buttons. |
| Message component and `message.css` | Search or editing | "No matching items" and the delete confirmation. |
| Loader component and `loader.css` | `loadChildren` | The small ring next to a parent whose sub-items load. |
| Font Awesome icon library | Item icons, editing, action icons | Item icons and toolbar icons. Loaded by the application page. |
| Tooltip component and `tooltip.css` | `tooltipMode` `TOOLTIP` | Tooltips (the Tooltip module is loaded only then). |

### Not included

The application provides the data (and, for levels loaded on demand, fetches them), saves edits (to a server, for example), decides which moves and actions are allowed, and performs its actions (opening, viewing, printing an item). Copy and paste, several items moved at once, undo, renaming checks such as unique names, and showing tens of thousands of items at once are not part of this version.

## For designers

### Structure

```text
div#{id}.ui-tree-view.ui-tree-view-selection-{none|single|multiple}[.ui-tree-view-lines][.ui-tree-view-editable][.ui-tree-view-searching][.ui-tree-view-invalid][.ui-tree-view-label-{top|start}]
├── div.ui-tree-view-label                                   (label; .ui-tree-view-optional / .ui-tree-view-mandatory)
├── div.ui-tree-view-toolbar  role="group"                   (actions or editable)
│   ├── span.ui-tree-view-action → Button                    (one per application action)
│   ├── span.ui-tree-view-toolbar-separator                  (actions and editable)
│   └── span.ui-tree-view-tool → Button                      (editable: Add, Add sub-item, Rename, Delete, Move up, Move down, Move into the item above, Move out of the parent)
├── div.ui-tree-view-search > input.ui-tree-view-search-input (search)
├── div.ui-tree-view-body
│   ├── ul.ui-tree-view-tree  role="tree"
│   │   └── li.ui-tree-view-item  role="treeitem"  [aria-expanded] [aria-selected | aria-checked] [aria-disabled] [aria-busy] [draggable] [hidden]
│   │       ├── div.ui-tree-view-row  [data-drop="before|after|inside"]
│   │       │   ├── span.ui-tree-view-toggle             (arrow; empty space for items without sub-items)
│   │       │   ├── span.ui-tree-view-check              (MULTIPLE)
│   │       │   ├── span.ui-tree-view-icon               (icon)
│   │       │   ├── span.ui-tree-view-text  → mark.ui-tree-view-match (search) or input.ui-tree-view-rename (renaming)
│   │       │   ├── span.ui-tree-view-badge              (badge)
│   │       │   ├── span.ui-tree-view-status             ("Loading…" for screen readers while loading, load error)
│   │       │   └── span.ui-tree-view-loader → Loader (RING, SMALL)   (while sub-items load; not displayed while the ring is hidden)
│   │       └── ul.ui-tree-view-group  role="group"  [hidden]   (sub-items)
│   └── div.ui-tree-view-no-results → Message (INLINE, INFO)
├── div.ui-tree-view-help                                    (help)
├── div.ui-tree-view-error  [hidden]
└── div.ui-tree-view-dialog → Message (MODAL, DANGER)        (delete confirmation)
```

Rows indent by one arrow column per level; the selected item (SINGLE) has the selected background and a bold text; ticked and partly ticked boxes are filled with the accent colour (check mark or dash). Guide lines run under the parent's arrow. While dragging, a line before or after a row, or a framed row (inside), shows where the item will go. The current item (`.ui-tree-view-current`, one at a time) has a thin accent frame in every selection mode. Focus is shown on the row.

### Visual options

| Option | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Selection | None, single, multiple | `ui-tree-view-selection-none`, `-single`, `-multiple` (`.ui-tree-view-check`) |
| Guide lines | Off, on | —, `ui-tree-view-lines` |
| Toolbar | Application actions, editing tools | `.ui-tree-view-toolbar` with `.ui-tree-view-action` hosts, `.ui-tree-view-toolbar-separator`, `.ui-tree-view-tool` hosts |
| Editing | Off, on | —, `ui-tree-view-editable` |
| Search | Off, on | —, `.ui-tree-view-search` |
| Label position | Inherit, top, start | —, `ui-tree-view-label-top`, `ui-tree-view-label-start` |

### States

| State | Values | CSS class or attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Search | Searching | `ui-tree-view-searching` |
| Item | Open, current, selected, ticked, partly ticked, disabled, loading, load error | `[aria-expanded="true"]`, `.ui-tree-view-current`, `[aria-selected="true"]`, `[aria-checked="true"]`, `[aria-checked="mixed"]`, `[aria-disabled="true"]`, `[aria-busy="true"]`, `.ui-tree-view-load-error` |
| Drag and drop | Dragged item, drop before / after / inside | `.ui-tree-view-dragging`, `.ui-tree-view-row[data-drop="before\|after\|inside"]` |

### Styling contract

`treeView.css` has three parts, marked in the stylesheet. Restyle by writing the same selector with a new value in your own stylesheet, inside `@layer overrides` (preferred: library updates keep your changes), or by changing a value in your copy of the stylesheet. After each token come the parts it styles, named by their class without `ui-tree-view-` (as in Structure), with the option or state in brackets (joined by “+” when they apply together). Text uses the typography roles of `design-system.css`.

**1. Appearance — change freely** (colours, type, borders, corners, motion: only the look changes)

- Colours
  - `--c-text`: tree view, search input, row (selected), rename
  - `--c-muted`: optional, toggle, check, icon, status, help
  - `--c-danger-text`: mandatory, status (load error), label (invalid), error
  - `--c-border`: search input, toolbar separator, group (lines)
  - `--c-surface`: search input, check, rename
  - `--c-surface-hover`: row (hover)
  - `--c-selected`: row (selected, drop inside)
  - `--c-accent`: check (checked, partly checked), badge, rename, row (current, drop before, drop after, drop inside)
  - `--c-on-accent`: check (checked, partly checked), badge
- Typography
  - `--font-ui`: tree view
  - `--fw-ui`: tree view, optional
  - `--fs-control`: tree view
  - `--lh-compact`: tree view
  - `--fs-label`: label, help, error
  - `--fw-ui-strong`: label, text (selected), badge, error
  - `--fw-ui-emphasis`: match
  - `--fs-caption`: badge, status
  - `--lh-body`: help, error
- Borders and corners
  - `--border-thin`: search input, toggle, check, rename, row (current)
  - `--radius-control`: search input, row
  - `--radius-control-small`: check, rename
  - `--border-thick`: check (checked), row (drop before, drop after, drop inside)
  - `--radius-pill`: badge
- States and motion
  - `--opacity-disabled`: row (disabled, dragging)
  - `--transition-1`: toggle

**2. Dimensions — change with care** (sizes and spacing: the component keeps working, its size changes)

- Borders and corners
  - `--border-thin`: toolbar separator, group (lines)
  - `--border-thick`: check (partly checked)
- Spacing
  - `--gap-tight`: tree view, toolbar separator, no results, row, badge, rename, group (lines)
  - `--gap-inline-items`: toolbar, row, toggle
  - `--padding-control`: search input
  - `--space-lg-3`: row, toggle, group (lines)
- Sizes
  - `--icon-size-large`: toolbar separator, icon, badge
  - `--control-height`: search input
  - `--space-sm-3`: toggle
  - `--icon-size-medium`: check, icon
  - `--space-sm-2`: check (checked)
  - `--space-md-1`: check (checked, partly checked)

**3. Structure — don't change** (layout, behaviour, states, accessibility)

- Borders and corners
  - `--border-thick`: row (focus)
- States and motion
  - `--focus-outline`: search input (focus), rename (focus), row (focus)
  - `--focus-offset`: search input (focus), rename (focus)
- Spacing
  - `--space-sm-2`: check
  - `--gap-toolbar`: tree view (label on the left)
- Sizes
  - `--form-label-width`: tree view (label on the left)

**Set by the component — don't change**

- Variables
  - `--ui-tree-view-level`: depth of each item (drives the indentation and the guide lines)

## For AI-assisted development

### Instructions

- Read this README before writing code. Import only from `treeViewIndex.js`.
- Check the configuration before adding code; configure instead of reproducing markup, styles, keyboard handling, selection, validation or drag and drop.
- Keep business logic (where the data comes from, saving edits, naming rules) in the application; don't modify the component for application needs — propose reusable framework changes instead.
